games.title: Orangeblood
games.shortDescription: 'WELCOME TO NEW KOZA' It's the end of the 20th century, on a historic timeline different from that which we know. A manmade island off the coast of Okinawa is humming with a dirty, exotic vibe - and it's awesome!

games.title: Unsouled
games.shortDescription: Unsouled is a 2D action RPG game requiring immense elaborate control. Take a break from repetitive attack and dodge action by challenging yourself with the world of Unsouled.

games.title: Candy Disaster - Tower Defense
games.shortDescription: Candy Disaster is 3D trap-style tower defense game where you guard candies against alien thieves! Unlock powerful and clever traps, choose your arsenal for different bases, and find the deadliest trap combination - then watch those space goons walk into their death!

games.title: Swarm
games.shortDescription: The Network has been infested. Face a giant creature ruled by music to cleanse it. Fight while switching between 2 complementary Game Modes!

games.title: Everafter Falls
games.shortDescription: Rediscover the simple life. Farm, fish, forge and fight to restore the peace in an all-new farming adventure. Features split-screen coop, a helpful pet, automated drones, resourceful pixies, a card-eating progression system, and dangerous dungeons to delve into!

games.title: Farlanders: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Prepare for your journey to Mars by building and managing a colony within the safety of Earth’s atmosphere. Hone your abilities to create a thriving community, terraform the land to suit your needs, and prove your capability for a larger mission. Get ready to launch in this prologue to Farlanders.

games.title: Angry Angry Shark
games.shortDescription: Play with friends against endless waves of man eater sharks.

games.title: Quarantineer
games.shortDescription: For the glory of Motherland, the truth shall never be revealed. None of us expected this, Yet history is repeating itself.

games.title: Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2
games.shortDescription: This is a 'Mysterious Dungeon' style roguelike game where the terrain changes with each challenge. Make the monsters your 'Friends' and go on a new adventure!

games.title: The Walking Dead: Destinies
games.shortDescription: Change the course of AMC’s The Walking Dead history. Fight walkers, relive iconic moments, and change the destiny of The Walking Dead Universe as your choices separate heroes from villains, and the living from the dead. Will you make the same choices as Rick, or will you forge your own path?

games.title: MechDefender - Tower Defense
games.shortDescription: MechDefender is an innovative fusion of two gaming genres - seamlessly blending the intense action of a top-down shooter with the strategic depth of tower defense.

games.title: Rising Hell
games.shortDescription: Rising Hell is a vertical platformer rogue-lite filled with adrenaline-pumping action and tons of heavy gothic metal shreds. Climb out from the ever-changing hell while you fight hordes of blood-lusting demons.

games.title: Zniw Adventure
games.shortDescription: Zniw Adventure is a hand-drawn point and click adventure game with a strong 90's vibe and cartoon animations. Play as Zniw - a yellow female dinosaur who is on a mission to find the ultimate gift for her mother's hatchday!

games.title: Memories Off -Innocent Fille- for Dearest
games.shortDescription: 『メモリーズオフ -Innocent Fille-』のファンディスクは、これまでのシリーズ作品と同様に各エンディングの続きをお届けするオムニバスストーリー。

games.title: Mask of the Rose
games.shortDescription: A marvellous romance with a hint of murder, where every playthrough is different! Seek love, friendship, or more... intimate encounters. Help a murdered man find justice. And watch out for the bats.

games.title: The Plague Doctor of Wippra
games.shortDescription: The plague spreads agony and fear in the small town of Wippra. As a plague doctor, you bring healing and relief wherever you can. But ignorance, superstition, and religious zeal make for a deadly threat in this retro medieval medical adventure!

games.title: Seed Hunter 猎源
games.shortDescription: Seed Hunter is a 2D Platformer with Roguelite element. You’re the alien finding the missing source around universe, but you get into some trouble on the planet of Earth.

games.title: Submarine Titans
games.shortDescription: Submarine Titans is a real-time strategy video game that takes place in the year 2115 after a comet has struck Earth, driving two human factions, the militant White Sharks and the scientific Black Octopi, to establish underwater bases and fight for dominance over the oceans.

games.title: KillSteel
games.shortDescription: Kill as many cars as you can in this action-packed free student game!

games.title: Pluviophile
games.shortDescription: Pluviophile is a very short experience about the mood of rain in the woods.

games.title: Monster Harvest
games.shortDescription: Monster Harvest is a monster collecting and farming action RPG with a twist! Grow, collect and mutate your crops then take them into battle! Filled with places to discover and multiple ways to build your farm, get ready to craft, explore and battle across the vibrant world of Planimal Point.

games.title: Garden Simulator
games.shortDescription: PLANT - DESIGN - HARVEST - With Garden Simulator you’ll get your own allotment, place deco elements and cultivate plants to harvest and sell them. Get ready for a beautiful time in nature. Always remember: A garden is a delight to the eye and a solace for the soul.

games.title: Wet steps
games.shortDescription: Have a relationship with a charming priestess! An urban fantasy short and brisk visual novel with elements of slavic mythology.

games.title: Victory Heat Rally
games.shortDescription: Welcome to VHR! Unlock the secrets of speed in this turbocharged neo super scaler arcade racing experience. Dominate the track drift your way to the finish line on the road to becoming the VHRC champion.

games.title: Kingdom of Atham: Crown of the Champions
games.shortDescription: 'Kingdom of Atham: Crown of the Champions - Embark on a medieval fantasy survival odyssey. Reclaim the stolen Crown, battle dark forces, and explore diverse lands. Uncover secrets, wield magic, and craft your destiny. Will you become the true champion of Atham?'

games.title: KallaX
games.shortDescription: Kallax is a chaotic furniture-building 2 to 6 players co-op game in which only one player can read the instruction manual at a time. Experience what should have been a one person's job and lose friendships forever.

games.title: Super Alloy Ranger
games.shortDescription: Super Alloy Ranger is a 2D side-scrolling action game. Play as Marksman Kelly or Combat Robot No.2 to challenge different levels within the dangerous Machine Empire and unlock new weapons. Use Kelly’s shooting and No.2’s deathblows to defeat abnormal Machine Bosses!

games.title: Poosh XL
games.shortDescription: Poosh XL is a neon-infused, one-button arcade score chaser. That's it! That pretty much says it all. If you like that first sentence you'll probably enjoy this game. Otherwise, refund it, I don't care, I just work here. (The spiritual successor to Ding Dong XL)

games.title: Adorable Witch5 : Lingering
games.shortDescription: Adorable Witch5 : Lingering is a role-playing game with light-hearted and casual level solving in which the player takes on the role of the main character who is trying to learn and help his classmates in the magic world to reach the final ending.

games.title: It Comes In Waves
games.shortDescription: A short, minimalist, experimental open-world adventure about guilt and grief. Explore, shoot, scavenge and bring a specimen to The Sanctuary. Beware PERMADEATH.

games.title: Buried
games.shortDescription: You wake up buried alive. You are running out of oxygen and you can't remember how you got here. There must be a way out, can you figure it out in time?

games.title: Chromosome Evil
games.shortDescription: Dive deep into this Lovecraft-inspired RTS survival. Assemble your team using different classes, skills, and weaponry. It's up to your squad to survive the onslaught of nightmares that are surely coming your way. Will you find the source of the darkness?

games.title: Space Scavenger
games.shortDescription: Action roguelike where you build and command your own spaceships. Battle enemies, explore planets and customize your ship on the fly. Make the best use of the quirky ship modules you find, ranging from slingshots to ion cannons, to try and avoid certain death.

games.title: Gold Hunter
games.shortDescription: Have you always dreamed of searching for gold? Then start your own adventure now - alone or together with friends. Explore a huge map and dig for gold using a variety of methods, vehicles and wash plants.

games.title: Toasterball
games.shortDescription: A ball, two goals and... toasters! Welcome to Toasterball. Play against your friends in this physics-based multiplayer sports game, where toasters are athletes, bread flies everywhere and the gameplay changes every time you score a goal!

games.title: Organs Please
games.shortDescription: A dark and satirical management sim, where you take control of a recycling factory with a twist: it recycles humans. Your job is to decide who gets to escape our dying planet in a cozy spaceship and who sacrifices their blood, sweat and tears for humanity. Literally.

games.title: Garage: Bad Dream Adventure
games.shortDescription: You are thrown into a weird world by the machine Garage. Can you escape from it?

games.title: Capes
games.shortDescription: Superheroes clash in this turn based strategy game. Recruit, train, and deploy your team in order to take back the city from the villains that hold it hostage.

games.title: Theseus Protocol
games.shortDescription: Theseus Protocol is a deck building roguelike where rebirth offers strategic opportunity. Utilize a powerful suite of cards and weaponry to uncover the cruel truth behind the dystopian sci-fi world of Mark City.

games.title: DUAL GEAR
games.shortDescription: DUAL GEAR is a Tactical Action Turn-Based Strategy Game inspired by Japanese Mecha. To go beyond the traditional, DUAL GEAR engages the player to pilots their mechs with Real-Time Action Shooting while experiencing the high pressure of Tactical Turn-Based Layers!

games.title: Stellar Warfare
games.shortDescription: Space RTS with base building and ship customization. Personal passion project. More than 200 available ships, weapons and modules to design your fleet with. Contains a small campaign, several single and multiplayer game modes and a coop game mode. Also contains Wave defense!

games.title: Understanding, The Game
games.shortDescription: 'Understanding, the game' it's a suspense/investigation horror indie game inspired in classic horror games! Full Game coming as soon we can! Help us grow the game!

games.title: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey DX
games.shortDescription: The definitive edition of the Atelier 'Mysterious' series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs! 'Atelier Firis' is the 2nd instalment: after Firis encounters alchemy and is able to leave town, she is taken on a magical journey that has no limits.

games.title: Golfie
games.shortDescription: Golfie is a run-based, roguelike minigolf deck builder for 1-8 players. Play through procedurally-generated levels, build a deck of crazy card abilities, and try to beat all 18 holes. Pick your route carefully because no two runs – or shots – are the same!

games.title: Nightmare Frames
games.shortDescription: Nightmare Frames is a supernatural thriller where you'll step into the shoes of Alan Goldberg, in the search for the scariest horror film of all time. An enthralling journey through the streets of the Hollywood of the 80s, a small haunted town, and even Hell itself.

games.title: Coin Flipper
games.shortDescription: Heads or tails? Coin Flipper is an idle clicker game that is all about flipping lots of coins. Upgrade your coin flips and get even more coins to flip!

games.title: Noun Town Language Learning
games.shortDescription: Gain new vocab while playing a game! Learn 1,000+ words phrases in a world that regains color as you learn. Test your skills with mini-games and talk to the local villagers. Learn Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Spanish, more…

games.title: SNK VS. CAPCOM SVC CHAOS
games.shortDescription: SNK and CAPCOM legends clash in this star-studded crossover fighting game! The 2003 arcade hit SVC CHAOS is back and better than ever!

games.title: Inn Tycoon
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Inn Tycoon! Build, design, and manage your dream inn. Serve delightful meals, offer various services, and hire a stellar staff. Create a top-notch hospitality empire and become the ultimate Inn Tycoon!

games.title: Exoblast
games.shortDescription: Exoblast is a mix of shoot’em up and arcade game, pimped with synthwave and pixelart. Choose your pilot, your ship and join the arena to confront other players in nervous and punitive matches. Impose your gameplay and reach the top of the tower!

games.title: I'a I'a Cofflhu Fhtagnyaa
games.shortDescription: 'I'a'Ia Cofflhu Fhtagnyaa' is a Galgame with Cthulhu mythology, with three female (xie) masters (shen) who can be attacked, 8-10 hours of game time. Working in a coffee shop, I accidentally discovered the indescribable secret of this shop...

games.title: Behind Glass: Aquarium Simulator
games.shortDescription: Create your very own aquariums on your PC with Behind Glass. With our realistic 3D aquarium engine, you can enjoy the details of lifelike fish, plants, decorations, algae, and more. Add realistic water and lighting effects and your monitor becomes a fish tank. Virtual aquascaping is so easy!

games.title: Misericorde: Volume One
games.shortDescription: Misericorde: Volume One is the first part of a series of mystery visual novels set in a convent in 1482.

games.title: INVITATION To FEAR
games.shortDescription: 『INVITATION To FEAR』 is a survival horror game for 1 to 4 players. After receiving one of the invitations, you will wake up in an unfamiliar place. Before long, you will realize that a terrifying creature is wandering around the building. Don't let 'her' find you.

games.title: THE MULLER-POWELL PRINCIPLE
games.shortDescription: Welcome to a breathtaking storyline full of portals, solving puzzles with an energy-absorbing weapon, and other adventures in a sci-fi atmosphere! Can you travel through parallel dimensions and uncover the secrets of your past?

games.title: Sumerians
games.shortDescription: Sumerians is a city building game set in ancient Mesopotamia. Attract new citizens and grow by expanding your irrigation system, building walls, palaces, temples and ziggurats. Research new technologies, manage your production, hire workers, and trade.

games.title: Railroads & Catacombs
games.shortDescription: In this exciting Card Building Roguelike game you create your cards from scratch adding different upgrades. Build your train, explore this mad land and face fearsome bosses. Discover infinite synergies. How far will you go?

games.title: Wind Peaks
games.shortDescription: In a place called Wind Peaks, mysteries happen, help the scouts find all the missing objects in this fun and relaxing adventure of treasure hunt

games.title: Farworld Pioneers
games.shortDescription: Explore an open world, sci-fi sandbox – in PVP, PVE, and co-op. Build and manage colonies on alien planets, and recruit AI survivors with unique personalities and skills. Craft, build, mine, farm, or get your electric death rifle and say hello to your neighbors.

games.title: Cosmonious High
games.shortDescription: From the makers of Job Simulator and Vacation Simulator— Welcome to Cosmonious High! Owlchemy Labs presents an out-of-this-world VR experience with their hallmark interactivity and distinctive humor. Meet a colorful cast, adapt outrageous powers, and discover the source of the school’s malfunctions.

games.title: Paleon
games.shortDescription: Your time machine is broken. And it looks like you are stuck in the past. Try to create your own civilization and return home!

games.title: Moving Out 2
games.shortDescription: Moving Out is back and wackier than ever, and now with ONLINE PLAY! Return to Packmore and use your moving skills across brand new dimensions and some old favourites. Help rebuild Smooth Moves and become an all-star F.A.R.T. (Furniture Arrangement Relocation Technician)!

games.title: Track and Burn
games.shortDescription: Driving an amazingly fun muscle car, feel the rush of adrenaline while zipping through the traffic, negotiating sharp turns and squeezing through tight passage.

games.title: Hidden Cats in Spooky Town
games.shortDescription: It's Halloween time! Do you choose Trick or Cat? Find all the Hidden Cats one by one in the Spooky Town to reveal the final colored art. Play through different modes, find special cats, and unlock bonus levels! More than 970 hidden objects to find! Now with the extra bonus level, AFTER PARTY!

games.title: Arrest of a stone Buddha
games.shortDescription: Hitman is searching for an answer in France 70-s.

games.title: Dahlia View
games.shortDescription: Sometimes it takes a nightmare to wake a place like Dahlia View. Lead the investigation into a missing child and discover the dark secret of Dahlia View in this story-driven observational thriller from the creators of The Occupation and Ether One.

games.title: Tiny Life
games.shortDescription: In Tiny Life, you control a set of people that live together in a household. You take care of their daily needs, build their skills, forge new relationships... or just mess up their entire life in whatever way you can think of!

games.title: Love Flute
games.shortDescription: Play the piano, play the flute, and enjoy a ghost story as you use the profits from your street performances to buy new instruments and furniture! Let's shoot for fame and fortune!

games.title: Bloody Rally Show
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Bloody Rally Show - a head-on smash between frenetic top-down arcade racing and hyperviolent reality TV. You must drift, boost, and blast to keep the viewers entertained and your paymasters happy. Go full throttle and drive to survive! Includes local multiplayer mayhem for up to 4 players

games.title: Witchtastic
games.shortDescription: Witchtastic is a challenging 2-4 player coop game about brewing and delivering magic potions as fast as possible. Take on the role of aspiring witches and experience charming adventures. Need a break from all the yelling of your friends? You can practice in a single player campaign as well!

games.title: DeathSprint 66
games.shortDescription: Compete in a bloody fight to the finish in DEATHSPRINT 66, fusing high-speed on-foot racing with deadly obstacles and brutal abilities. Unleash your velocity, push limits, and claim glory like never before.

games.title: My Village Life
games.shortDescription: My Village Life is a open world village simulator vehicle driving game.

games.title: Reactor Tech²
games.shortDescription: Become the main power engineer of the world - the builder of the most powerful power plant that feeds the whole world! You have to build your own power plant, research new technologies and make the most successful power company in 100 gaming years.

games.title: Lycanthorn II - Rain of Beasts
games.shortDescription: Lycanthorn II is 3D homage to games of old. You play as Rain, a Vampire Hunter, on her quest to slay Nosferatu.

games.title: Reloader: test_subject
games.shortDescription: Reloader: test_subject is an experimental 'Bullet Counting Reload Action' game. Experience being a Reloader: having legendary shooting skills and engaging in Close-Quarters Combat(CQC). You just have to remember how to use the gun you’re holding.

games.title: Sketch Crawler
games.shortDescription: New game from the legendary game designer, creator of S.T.A.L.K.E.R: Shadow of Chernobyl. A super-creative roguelike\deckbuilder in which you can redraw everything, voice everything and even write your own texts in quests and dialogs!

games.title: World Seed
games.shortDescription: A simple game with big ambitions. Fight creatures, explore the world and progress your character in this ever changing world.

games.title: The Hand of Merlin
games.shortDescription: The Hand of Merlin is a turn-based rogue-lite RPG in which Arthurian legend meets with sci-fi horror. Recruit mortal heroes to explore lands rife with otherworldly evil, make narrative bending choices in unique interactive encounters, and search for the lost fragments of your soul across the multiverse!

games.title: ExoCross
games.shortDescription: ExoCross is an offroad racing game introducing 4CPT vehicle physics (4-way contact patch traction technology). A soft-body tire model allows for competitive time attack and multiplayer wheel to wheel racing.

games.title: Saint Kotar: The Yellow Mask
games.shortDescription: Follow the fear of Benedek Dohnany and Nikolay Kalyakin and play the onset of a dark and chilling narrative adventure. Make decisions and affect the events that precede a macabre series of murders, allegedly related to devil worship and witchcraft.

games.title: Zero IDLE
games.shortDescription: Zero IDLE is an incremental (IDLE) game in which you can decide whether to make all of your way to the biggest number EVER by clicking, or by increasing your incremental production...or you can make the game to click for you...

games.title: Schastye
games.shortDescription: A miniature frozen between the atmosphere of a small room and Castaneda with Lovecraft. The story of radical spiritual practices in the search for truth among panels and stacks.

games.title: 7Days Origins
games.shortDescription: 7Days Origins is a single-player story game where the storyline changes based on the player's choices. For 7 days, you will meet various characters in the world of the dead. You may become allies and embark on adventures together or become enemies and fight.

games.title: Chessformer
games.shortDescription: Chessformer is a grid-based puzzle platformer with Chess pieces. The goal in each level is to capture the opposing king, who is lazy and never moves, so don't worry about losing any pieces.

games.title: Jumbo Airport Story
games.shortDescription: Just imagine: your own world-famous airport! A game with sky-high levels of fun!

games.title: Lisa's Memory - 丽莎的记忆
games.shortDescription: 《丽莎的记忆》是一个横版RPG游戏。主角丽莎从一个秘密的研究所里醒来，这里到处都充满了致命的陷阱和凶恶的怪物。丽莎有死亡后重生保留记忆的能力，丽莎将利用这个能力逃出研究所。

games.title: TFM: The First Men
games.shortDescription: An open-world colony sim based on stories of the first men. Infinite possibilities await your very own Adam and Eve as they embark on a generation-spanning adventure. How will you shape their future?

games.title: GOHOME
games.shortDescription: This is a third-person horror game set in a residential area in 2000s Japan. It's the complete version of the free horror game GOHOME, which was released in 2019 and caused a boom. The map has been doubled, and six more ghosts, including hidden characters, have been added to the game.

games.title: Infinite Tournament Paintball
games.shortDescription: Infinite is the first of it's kind. A modern era online paintball game that aims to capture the real world aspects of tournament style paintball. Featuring a 5v5 X-Ball format, markers set to 10.5 ramping, slide or dive into your bunker and engage in competitive matches

games.title: RATUZ
games.shortDescription: After a science experiment gets out of control, you need to survive and escape this dark prison that hides weird secrets. The game is a cinematic platform of terror and stealth, inspired by INSIDE, Another World, Blackthorne and Prince of Persia.

games.title: AutoChess of Gensokyo
games.shortDescription: 'AutoChess of Gensokyo' is a Touhou Project multi-player AutoChess-Like game. Draw character from the deck, build your combination, upgrade the character, and fight with other players. Keep optimizing your combination to win the game.

games.title: Yugo Puzzle
games.shortDescription: Yugo Puzzle is a minimalist, relaxing, and satisfying puzzle game. Move jelly blocks left and right to merge them with the same color. It may sound simple, but it’s deceptively challenging. Enjoy the satisfaction of solving each puzzle.

games.title: Cross Concerto
games.shortDescription: 《交汇协奏曲》是由日本知名美少女游戏集团品牌Applique为纪念品牌创立十周年而制作的和风传奇题材作品。由名作《月影魅像-解放之羽-》与《黄昏的禁忌之药》的原班人马打造。游戏剧情层层剥茧，路线结局众多，是一部拥有很高完成度的作品。

games.title: FPV LOGIC
games.shortDescription: FPV LOGIC is an FPV drone simulator with near-real physics and operation experience. Whether you enjoy freestyle or racing, you can find the same fun as flying a real drone in this game.

games.title: City Transport Simulator: Tram
games.shortDescription: Become a tram driver! Hop back into the cab for the ultimate tram driving experience. Drive modern real-world trams from various cities with physics indistinguishable from the real thing.

games.title: Ai Vpet
games.shortDescription: The new generation of table pets in the AI era provides users with a comprehensive AI customized platform for creating table pets, including image, voice, character design, and even interactive methods, through AI technologies such as deep learning and language processing.

games.title: Medieval Monarch
games.shortDescription: In the medieval era, assume the role of a lord and engage with other lords，develop fiefdoms, and employ strategies involving intrigue, warfare, and plunder. Expand your territory and strengthen your house lineage Or, be a god, manipulate the world? This game primarily strategic role-playing elements

games.title: Lithium City
games.shortDescription: Lithium City is a stylized isometric action game set in a neon-drenched world of electricity and violence.

games.title: Kona II: Brume
games.shortDescription: Northern Québec, 1970. A bizarre mist —the Brume— is disconnecting a rural mining village from its quiet reality. Step into the shoes of Detective Carl Faubert as he unfolds the mysteries haunting the region while battling for his own survival.

games.title: Catlateral Damage: Remeowstered
games.shortDescription: The premier first-person destructive house cat simulator is back with a vengeance! Play as a mischievous cat, swat your human's possessions onto the floor, scratch up curtains, smash precious keepsakes, and show your owner who's boss.

games.title: Lelie Navigation!
games.shortDescription: A turn-based RPG where you play as Lelie, a woman who uses the power of Dowsing to help people find things they've lost. One day however, Lelie's power gets her and her friend into a dangerous situation that they must work together to overcome.

games.title: Elasto Mania Remastered
games.shortDescription: The original cult classic returns. A blast from the past, better than ever. Are you ready?

games.title: Tchia
games.shortDescription: A Tropical Open-World adventure. Climb, glide, swim, and sail your boat around a beautiful archipelago in this physics-driven sandbox. Take control of any animal or object you can find, and Jam on your fully playable Ukulele.

games.title: SHIPS AT WAR
games.shortDescription: Sink player-made battleships, aircraft carriers and submarines in this physics-based game. Use pre-built ships and sink the enemy by deploying aircraft, torpedoes, depth charges or shells. Or built your own ships in the extensive ship-editor.

games.title: Between Time: Escape Room
games.shortDescription: You are going to steal a time machine. In this escape room, you have to travel through time, explore mysterious places and solve puzzles to get priceless treasures. Will you be able to make it back alive?

games.title: The Fancy Pants Adventures: Classic Pack
games.shortDescription: The classic Flash game series, compiled as the ultimate Fancy Pants fan collection - with updated visuals, loads of bonus features, and brand new Back Pages bonus levels. Follow along in Early Access, as creator Brad Borne brings these games back to their former glory. Run Fast, Run Fancy!

games.title: Teslagrad 2
games.shortDescription: Lumina, a young Teslamancer, finds herself stranded after her airship crash lands in Wyrmheim, a remote and treacherous land to the North. Embark on a dangerous adventure, exploring a gigantic, abandoned tower looming over a fjordside valley, on a quest to get Lumina home and back to her family.

games.title: Romancing SaGa -Minstrel Song- Remastered
games.shortDescription: Romancing SaGa -Minstrel Song- returns as a stunning remastered edition, with new gameplay elements and quality of life features! Get ready for an even deeper story and an even more thrilling adventure!

games.title: Meow Express
games.shortDescription: You are a cat on a robot vacuum cleaner. Which means you are bus driver in the cat world! Dodge obstacles, pop innocent kids' baloons, dash through buildings to collect your fellow cat pussengers. Meow Express is a cute, fun and annoying casual arcade game, just like our furry friends.

games.title: Orange Season
games.shortDescription: Make your farmer’s dream come true in Orange Season. With your parent’s help, you’ve finally saved enough money to buy a plot of land in the charming farmer’s village of Orange Town. Build a thriving farm as you grow crops, raise animals, fish, and mine materials to establish your farm in town.

games.title: Unexplored 2: The Wayfarer's Legacy
games.shortDescription: Dynamic, procedurally generated adventure game that puts exploration first. Build your legacy as each wayfarer will change the fate of the world. Endless replayability with a huge set of difficulty modifiers. Boasting an award-winning soundtrack, a beautiful art style, and regular updates.

games.title: Nine Witches: Family Disruption
games.shortDescription: When an occult German WW2 division releases an ancient curse upon the world, a supernatural problem is going to require a supernatural solution. Take control of two playable heroes as they embark on a comedic, alternate-history adventure with a truly original story (99.9999% guaranteed).

games.title: MARDEK
games.shortDescription: MARDEK is a fantasy/sci-fi/retro Flash RPG from 2007-2010, which blends parody with a deeper story. It offers solid turn-based RPG combat and dozens of hours of gameplay.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online - Blackwood
games.shortDescription: The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Blackwood is the ultimate Elder Scrolls experience and includes the base game, Blackwood Chapter, and all previous Chapters.

games.title: Apostle: Rebellion
games.shortDescription: A sci-fi, turn-based RPG. Humanity has reached a point where the majority of people opt to become cyborgs called Roids. However, social inequality is once again at a breaking point.

games.title: Project Wunderwaffe
games.shortDescription: Project Wunderwaffe will take you back into the realities of World War II, the end of which seems to be near. Germany is now just a shadow of its power. Your order is to build a secret military base and construct weapons of unprecedented power. Will you be capable of turning the tide of war?

games.title: Shokuo Shoujo
games.shortDescription: Huntress Yuki and her brother Yuu depend on each other, living in a remote village.

games.title: 流光易逝的夏末 - Fleeting Summer's End
games.shortDescription: Fleeting Summer's End is a small game of ADV. It is in the remote countryside of Teoswa area, China, in August. Deng Ainyang, who was Born and grew up in the metropolis(Shenzhen), followed her parents back to Teoswa. In Teoswa, Ainyang met Deng Kangsui and developed an intimate relationship with her

games.title: House of Lizards
games.shortDescription: Unique Ancient Knight Simulator with Horror Elements. Get Intelligence for Knight Brothers, return to the base Ancient Manuscripts, drink Baikal Water and Destroy the base of Lizards!

games.title: The Ninja Saviors: Return of the Warriors
games.shortDescription: Alluring audio! Pixel art perfection! Beat-em up beauty! Discover how hard a 32,000kg ninja hits with The Ninja Saviours!

games.title: Dream Town Island
games.shortDescription: A town sim where you raise generations of residents. Unlock new stores and facilities, help your residents find love, or cash in on the stock market!

games.title: Godrop
games.shortDescription: One level of warning, cosmic droplet rampage! A roguelike game featuring impact piercing. Collect holy relics, build up your energy, and morph the droplets to invade the solar system and destroy the ignorant human fleet to the ground!

games.title: Bonfire Peaks
games.shortDescription: Set your belongings on fire on a beautiful voxel art puzzle island.

games.title: Dear Devere
games.shortDescription: A romance/mystery visual novel set in 1930s Scotland, told through a letter correspondence.

games.title: VTuber Editor
games.shortDescription: VTuber Editor is a professional VTuber avatar editing tool. Bring more creativity to your VTuber avatar by adding paintings, VRM accessories, VTuber backgrounds, 3D animations, and more. Powerful customization features such as avatar decoration and animation make avatars more interesting.

games.title: RESTLESS SOUL
games.shortDescription: Laugh in the face of death in this hauntingly humorous comedy adventure about a wayward soul trying to make it back to the land of the living. Engage in bullet-hell lite battles, solve puzzles, and communicate with the dead as you navigate this “colorful” world. Death is just the beginning.

games.title: The True Love Rings
games.shortDescription: 'The True Love Rings' is a scene interactive decryption game. The overall atmosphere is casual and relaxed. Players follow the prompts in the scene to gradually solve the puzzles and help solve the problems encountered in life.

games.title: Cozy Time
games.shortDescription: Cozy Time provides you with a cozy environment to focus, relax or rest without being disturbed.

games.title: Feudal Friends
games.shortDescription: Produce your soldiers, Improve your equipment, Battle and Win in a chaotic castle! Build your team for 1-4 Online Co-op and PVE mode options! Determine your strategy with over 40 Rune options and be the first to destroy the opposing tower.

games.title: Power & Revolution 2023 Edition
games.shortDescription: The latest edition of the ultrarealistic world simulator where you play as the Head of State or as the opposition! New Additions: dive deeper into the war in the Ukraine with artillery, trenches, mines, troop morale, etc; detailed immigration management; the justice system; and children.

games.title: Pixel Cafe
games.shortDescription: Step into Pixel's shoes in this one-of-a-kind journey that bridges time, memories, and the aroma of fresh coffee. Dive deep into a city balancing its past and future. Engage in intense arcade challenges, immerse yourself in heartfelt stories, and navigate a world crafted in pixel art.

games.title: Oneiros
games.shortDescription: Will you be able to break the vicious circle? Can you regain control? Experience the surreal adventure filled with many puzzles and psychedelic visions.

games.title: 花落冬陽 Snowdreams -lost in winter-
games.shortDescription: 《花落冬陽》是一款以「夢想」與「思念」為主題的文字冒險遊戲。故事講述主角謝子臣在追尋作家之夢的過程中遭遇的困境，以及與夏芊帆、雪見兩名少女的戀愛故事。豐富的劇情、精緻的插畫、悠揚的音樂、搭配全中文語音，帶你體驗一段動人的台北冬季戀曲。

games.title: Causa, Voices of the Dusk
games.shortDescription: Causa, Voices of the Dusk is an intriguing turn-based strategy card game with innovative game mechanics. Sacrifice cards to raise your Cause, and bring them back later for unexpected powerful plays. Prove your abilities in battle and draft your way to Victory in extremely challenging campaigns.

games.title: Guilty Parade
games.shortDescription: One war. Two sides of a military conflict. Which side will you choose if you take a look at the world from both sides of the conflict? Whom will you support and whom will you destroy if some are fighting for an uncertain future, while others are for a peaceful present?

games.title: The Final Earth 2
games.shortDescription: The Final Earth 2 is a vertical sci-fi city builder. Earth is unlivable, so you decide to create a space colony. Gather resources, then build and research your way to a better future! Grow your city from an exploration ship to a huge metropolis, full of advanced technology. What will you build?

games.title: Gaia Project
games.shortDescription: Gaia Project is the digital adaptation of the boardgame Gaia Project created by Helge Ostertag and Jens Drögemüller and published by 'Feuerland Verlag'. It is a 1-4 player strategy game. It plays in the same universe as Terra Mystica and continues the adventure in the far future.

games.title: CARNAL
games.shortDescription: CARNAL is a fast and challenging retro FPS straight from the mid '90s. The Sons of Anak are opening portals to extract Dark Matter from the 'other side'. Combat the possessed soldiers, the manifested demons helping them, and any inanimate objects standing in your way!

games.title: 大富翁少女/Rich Girls
games.shortDescription: 'Rich Girls' is a casual board game / strategy game based on cards, dice and land properties. Players play the role of a gentleman, encountering various business ladies, and fighting against each others in the world of business war.

games.title: The Future Radio and the Artificial Pigeons
games.shortDescription: 2061, Japan. Mankind has lost the sky, and with it, its connections. All of it was taken away by birds... ...By countless artificial pigeons flying through the sky.

games.title: Ticket to Ride®
games.shortDescription: Travel around the world in an epic adventure that redefined the modern board game genre! Build a railway empire that connects the most popular cities, claim the most exciting routes and dominate your competitors in this fan favorite classic!

games.title: Anon's Neko Waifus
games.shortDescription: Discover an enchanting world where cute neko girls await to steal your heart. Immerse yourself in a tale of romance and emotions. It's the perfect getaway for a good time.

games.title: And the Hero Was Never Seen Again
games.shortDescription: The Demon King lies defeated at the Hero's hand, but the Hero himself has changed... in more ways than one!

games.title: Eyes: The Horror Game
games.shortDescription: You break into the mansion at night. It’s huge and built like a maze. You're trying to escape, but the monster is after you! The chase begins. RUN!!

games.title: Kodon
games.shortDescription: Kodon is a 3D sculpting software for VR and Desktop. We make beginners experts with our intuitive, easy to learn interface, and invite experts to become gods through speed, immersion and feel.

games.title: Pax Nova
games.shortDescription: A sci-fi turn-based 4X strategy game where you lead the fate of one of several factions divided between three races. Explore new worlds and new star systems filled with exciting secrets as well as dangers. Build cities, expand your influence and fight great battles on land and in space.

games.title: Ghost in the pool
games.shortDescription: A bizarre campus legend, take you into the traditional Japanese black-and-white comic horror story. Witness the familiar scenes and contemplate the terrifying moments.

games.title: SAMURAI SHODOWN NEOGEO COLLECTION
games.shortDescription: The ULTIMATE collection is here! It all began in ’93, and now, the weapon-based fighting game series that swept the world is ready to be taken home in a new stellar collection! Six NEOGEO titles as well as one mysterious, unreleased game are featured!

games.title: Inspector Waffles
games.shortDescription: Murder. Nothin’ nice about it. In this old school detective adventure, step into the boots of whip-smart Inspector Waffles and travel the city to track hidden clues, interrogate shady suspects, and unravel a dangerous mystery. But be warned: curiosity killed the cat...

games.title: Almighty: Kill Your Gods
games.shortDescription: Hunt demons, monsters, and gods solo or online with friends in this action RPG. Run, leap and fly across islands, ripping your foes to pieces, and rebuilding your home with their remains. Bring low the oppressive false gods, protect your kindred and become Almighty.

games.title: Berserk Boy
games.shortDescription: BERSERK BOY is a high speed action packed Platformer, with Metroidvania elements. Packed with vibrant and stylish pixel art. Go Berserk! as you change into different forms and use the power of Lightning, Fire, Ice, Air, and Earth to save the planet!

games.title: Kitten Burst
games.shortDescription: Kitten Burst is an Adventure/Racing Game about a Flying Cat set in the year 200X. Explore Sites on the Web, Race through Circuits, Battle Bullet Hell Bosses to Save Cyberspace.

games.title: METAL MAX Xeno Reborn
games.shortDescription: Metal Max Xeno Reborn is an action JRPG with real-time battle and vehicle combat elements. Join Talis, a lone hunter, and search for allies in a vengeance-charged war against monsters robotic enemies. Learn new skills and collect and customize tanks as you journey through a devastated world.

games.title: Disgaea 6 Complete
games.shortDescription: Join Zed on his quest to destroy the God of Destruction in the newest installment of the SRPG series, Disgaea! Join the zany cast for one HL of an adventure and use specialized abilities like Super Reincarnation to battle your way to victory! Disgaea 6 Complete includes all previously released DLC!

games.title: Blockbuster Inc.
games.shortDescription: Ever dreamed of making your own movies? Build up your own movie studio, scout for upcoming stars, and produce cutting-edge films and TV shows. Try to stay ahead of your competition throughout the history of cinematography.

games.title: Bloodhound
games.shortDescription: Crush the cult of Astaroth and vanquish her hellspawn, make them squeal and hide where they came from. Enjoy a Fresh Look Old Fun in this arcade horror FPS game inspired by the legends of the 90s.

games.title: Republic of Pirates
games.shortDescription: Establish and grow a pirate utopia during the Golden Age of Piracy. Create a resource-based economy, engage in real-time naval combat, and navigate diplomatic relationships with rival powers. Explore the far reaches of the Caribbean in search of the ultimate fortune and glory…

games.title: Kao the Kangaroo (2000 re-release)
games.shortDescription: Kao the Kangaroo is a 3D adventure game, first released in 2000. More than 30 levels, numerous funny characters, adjustable difficulty, and demanding gameplay attracted not only young players, but also offered pleasant entertainment for more advanced players.

games.title: Haunted House
games.shortDescription: 'Cheong Wing Mansion' A plot game set in a public housing estate, Prosperous Mansions is an exploration of Hong Kong in the olden days, with elements of ghosts and urban legends. The game is divided into units, each of which has its own story, yet is closely intertwined.

games.title: Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse
games.shortDescription: The open-world survival role-playing game 'Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse' tells the story of Delta Team and his comrades as they work to rebuild a world devastated by humans and their race turned into zombies.

games.title: Bite Night
games.shortDescription: Bite Night is a comedic first-person horror game that explores the idea of what if the big bad monster was bad at their job of being scary.

games.title: No Longer Home
games.shortDescription: No Longer Home is a game about letting go of the life you've built due to circumstances beyond your control. Immerse yourself in the lives of Bo and Ao and learn about their dreams, frustrations and fears. Welcome the magic of the everyday and somewhat extraordinary.

games.title: Perilous Warp
games.shortDescription: Perilous Warp is a fast-paced indie retro-shooter inspired by the classic 3D-actions. Communication with a distant space colony has been lost, and you bravely step into the teleporter with the desire for glorious adventures. But do not expect to win in a heartbeat!

games.title: Touhou Kaeizuka ～ Phantasmagoria of Flower View.
games.shortDescription: 桜、紫陽花、向日葵、彼岸花、 幻想の花は散ることなく咲き続ける。弾幕の花も然り。 弾幕の対戦型フラワリングシューティング！一人でも大変遊べます。

games.title: Rule No. 1
games.shortDescription: A silky smooth Arena First Person Shooter with a prime focus on game-feel. Massacre waves of sentient metallic geometry and their monster compatriots as you fight for your Hi-Score! Designed to be the ultimate 'warm-up' or 'waiting-for-download' game!

games.title: Crime O'Clock
games.shortDescription: Crime O'Clock is a hidden objects investigation and time exploration game with a deep storyline. Investigate cases through time and evolving maps by unveiling a multi-eras linked story. Will you be observant enough to solve the mysteries? Crime waits for no man!

games.title: Pampas & Selene: The Maze of Demons
games.shortDescription: Join Pampas and Selene as they overcome monsters, demons, and the Dark Priest with the help of the gods themselves! Explore this co-opvania 8-bit platformer alone or with a friend. This retro game is a loving tribute to an MSX2 masterpiece from the creator of UnEpic, Ghost 1.0, and UnMetal.

games.title: Mega City Force
games.shortDescription: Retrowave Action Roguelike featuring tough agents battling crime to the electrifying music of artists like Droid Bishop, Timecop1983, and more! Choose your agent and dive into hardcore action against enemies and bosses, utilizing a vast arsenal and special abilities that will define your playstyle

games.title: Just Another Night Shift
games.shortDescription: Just Another Night Shift is a casual competitive 1v1 PvP stealth strategy game. Play as a Thief and as a Security Guard. Steal the statue and try to prevent it in this 3D indie game. Grab a friend and work THE NIGHT SHIFT of your life. Join us for hours of fun gameplay with your friends!

games.title: Neyasnoe
games.shortDescription: Wastelands, grim folks behind garages, a nightclub, and a huge gray sky — a lost world for a lost generation. Let techno trance music and white verses lead you through the wastelands of the Neyasnoe.

games.title: BANG! BANG! Totally Accurate Redneck Simulator
games.shortDescription: BANG! BANG! Totally Accurate Redneck Simulator is a silly and super tough physics based shooter puzzler in which you attempt to help a drunken redneck hit targets without accidentally shooting himself with a ricochet.

games.title: The Morrigan
games.shortDescription: Step into this world of beautiful stylised graphics and explore striking, handcrafted environments - torch in one hand, big axe in the other. Built exclusively for VR.

games.title: Dragon Spirits
games.shortDescription: While constantly working on a video game without any rest, a college student who's about to graduate quietly slipped into slumber several times. In those lucid dreams, he found himself in the game he was working on, the fantasy world of Dragon Spirits.

games.title: Snowdome
games.shortDescription: For Tan Yan, there is little hope his life will change. It's like his whole life is trapped inside a snowdome, unable to escape. But, what if, one day, he's given the chance to make a change?

games.title: Countryballs: Modern Ballfare
games.shortDescription: The Definitive Political Debating Simulator. A wacky third-person multiplayer arena shooter inspired by Countryball memes - a game encouraging you to smash each others balls until someone finishes victoriously. Now includes an online co-op zombie mode!

games.title: Exodus Borealis
games.shortDescription: In this city builder and tower defense game, you will command a small band of ship wrecked colonists. Progress from struggling to survive the elements to a thriving kingdom that will smash the demon hordes that dare attack your settlement.

games.title: Crown Wars: The Black Prince
games.shortDescription: The War of Crowns rages on. Knights and brigands run rampant throughout the land, sowing destruction. From your castle base, rise to become the lord who leads the battle against the forces of evil in this turn-based tactics and strategy game.

games.title: Socialism Simulator
games.shortDescription: The civil war is over. To the rapturous cheers of the crowd, you and four of your companions take control of the country. The young socialist state proudly raises its flags, its eyes fixed on a distant, bright future.

games.title: Fairy Biography2：Confidante
games.shortDescription: You need to use the left mouse button to click to control the demon refining pot, so that the refining demon pot can reasonably rebound and successfully repel the enemy, so as to achieve victory

games.title: Super Dark Deception
games.shortDescription: Death awaits you once again in Super Dark Deception, a fun 2D reimagining of the hit horror maze game, Dark Deception!

games.title: Fairy Biography3 : Obsession
games.shortDescription: Fairy Biography3 : Obsession is a casual strategy game. Players first use advanced spells - [Artillery Artillery] to attack naughty demon spirits, obtain their most important thing [Yuan Shen], and finally break through the demon spirits created by them. phantom!

games.title: Mr. DRILLER DrillLand
games.shortDescription: The popular action puzzle game “Mr. DRILLER DrillLand” makes its Western debut on Steam! You’re invited to a secret amusement park known as “DrillLand” – 500 meters underground!

games.title: Draft of Darkness
games.shortDescription: Draft of Darkness is a survival horror RPG with deck building and roguelike dungeon exploration. Recruit allies, synergize their decks to create powerful card combos. Manage your limited resources and explore procedurally generated maps to determine the story's outcome.

games.title: Batora: Lost Haven
games.shortDescription: Batora: Lost Haven® is a choice-driven isometric action adventure with RPG elements and a unique duality system affecting combat, story, dialogues, puzzles, and endings, that will make you question the meaning of sacrifice.

games.title: Diluvian Winds
games.shortDescription: Diluvian Winds is a relaxing management game set in a small hamlet at the foot of a lighthouse. Welcome weary travelers and work together to expand your hamlet on land, under the sea, or among the clouds.

games.title: Vojo
games.shortDescription: Vojo - is a casual game in which you move forward through a tunnel. You need to avoid obstacles that appear in your path, and collect white cubes for which you get points. How many points can you collect?

games.title: Looking for Aliens
games.shortDescription: Aliens are among us! Can you find traces of them on Earth, the moon, and the edges of the galaxy? Find all the clues to prove the existence of alien civilizations and discover how making fried eggs can end up in a monster attack!

games.title: Surrounded
games.shortDescription: Surrounded is an up to 6-player cooperative horror game where you will encounter a lot of different variations of strange sightings and creatures capable of ending your life. Dive into the story mode with up to 6 players, or raise the stakes in the replayable co-op gamemode: 'Hunted'.

games.title: KamiYaba: Destiny on a Dicey Deadline
games.shortDescription: “If you don't tie the knot with the person of your dreams within the next year, you'll be in big trouble.” So forewarns Urara, the self-proclaimed Goddess of Matchmaking... kicking off a rowdy rom-com adventure!

games.title: Dino Trauma
games.shortDescription: Dino Trauma introduces you to a secret laboratory somewhere in eastern Europe where gore and dinosaurs aren't unusual things. Retro FPS inspired by the '90s legends.

games.title: Trinity Survivors
games.shortDescription: Select from a diverse roster of unique characters to assemble a trinity force and strategize to find the best skill combinations. Witness the astounding synergy that emerges. Engage in 2 player online cooperative multiplayer, team up with a friend to challenge orc hordes, and strive for high scores!

games.title: Parfait Remake
games.shortDescription: 《纯爱咖啡厅～帕露菲重制版～》是由GIGA/Entergram所制作的经典恋爱冒险游戏的重制版。原版于2005年发售，是广为人知的高口碑杰作。游戏拥有多达6位女主角以及13种结局的丰富内容。著名剧本家丸户史明凭借为本作编写剧本而一战成名。经典主题曲《Leaf Ticket》由KOTOKO献唱。

games.title: 秘封旅行 ~ Secret Sealing Travel
games.shortDescription: 秘封旅行是一款Touhou Project的同人桌宠休闲游戏。与桌面的两位秘封俱乐部少女互动，体验数值养成，在近未来京都的大地图上，尽情探索、打工、购物，来和秘封俱乐部一起享受每一天吧！

games.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island
games.shortDescription: She's back just in time to do all the puzzles in your Sunday paper! It's a Khimera Nonogram adventure!

games.title: Ultimate ADOM - Caverns of Chaos
games.shortDescription: Experience the sequel of the traditional roguelike dungeon-crawling classic. Enjoy unlimited replayability through endless procedurally generated dungeons, countless monsters, grafting, crafting and a vast amount of skill trees. Journey into the ever changing depths of the Caverns of Chaos.

games.title: 大明王朝1789 | Ming dynasty 1789
games.shortDescription: In 1789, the Ming Dynasty had survived for a hundred years. At this time, just before the Great Revolution, what will the Ming Dynasty look like under the influence of players?

games.title: Psych
games.shortDescription: Experience the story of Alexander Green and find out what happened on the day of the accident in this First Person horror Adventure. Follow the development of Alex, solve puzzles around the event and try not to fall into madness as you search for answers.

games.title: Mixolumia
games.shortDescription: In this entrancing musical arcade puzzler, diamond blocks slide together on a gem-shaped board and explode in glittering chain reactions.

games.title: Henchman Story
games.shortDescription: Being a bumbling supervillain's henchman is a thankless job. The spandex chafes, there's tons of late nights, and your boss rarely remembers your name. But in this narrative adventure you'll soon discover that - sometimes - even the choices of the lowliest henchman can change everything.

games.title: What if your girl was a frog?
games.shortDescription: There was a frog. She was cheerfully croaking on her lake. However, she was not a simple frog, but magic. And so she got a lonely boy. She used her magic and started her adventures.

games.title: Roots of Yggdrasil
games.shortDescription: Build settlements, explore the Nine Realms, collect artifacts and upgrade your deck to reach the top of Yggdrasil in this post-Ragnarok roguelike city-builder! Can you survive the end of the world?

games.title: I Did Not Buy This Ticket
games.shortDescription: Weep for the dead! In this short psychological horror story, play as a professional mourner travelling between funerals. Ride a nightmarish bus whose destination depends on how you choose to face your traumas.

games.title: Deep Secret
games.shortDescription: This is a casual puzzle match-3 game. Players need to use the mouse to select two unobstructed squares, and if they are the same, they will be eliminated. After success, you can advance the plot and story development of the two protagonists!

games.title: Master Detective Archives: RAIN CODE Plus
games.shortDescription: Yuma, an amnesiac detective-in-training, and Shinigami, the spirit haunting him, tackle unsolved mysteries.

games.title: Back
games.shortDescription: 《Back》 is a full-motion audio live horror game. Special Note 1: This game is very supernatural and scary, timid or heart disease players do not buy ！！！！ The game will reveal different ending plots step by step through various searches and choices for your character.

games.title: Ice World
games.shortDescription: A blizzard brought a long winter, Humanity on the brink of extinction. you had to face ferocious beasts, mine ice and snow to build a base, and survive in the cold apocalypse.

games.title: Medieval Fantasy Survival Simulator
games.shortDescription: You're gonna get yourself killed out here... There's monsters, bandits, and much, much worse roaming these lands... Do you really think you've got what it takes to survive? Or do you think you're cut out for much more than that... There's only one way to find out, and time is of the essence!

games.title: Virtual Circuit Board
games.shortDescription: Virtual Circuit Board is the sandbox drawing-based logic simulator where you can build, program, decorate, and simulate anything from simple monochrome circuits to complex and colorful computers. Play with digital logic in this sandbox-only experience.

games.title: Hands of Necromancy
games.shortDescription: Hands of Necromancy is a Dark Fantasy FPS metroidvania, inspired by classics such as Heretic and made with the GZDoom engine. Wield weapons, magic or transform into a fearsome monster to slay your foes, then raise them as undead servants and unleash even more carnage to become a master Necromancer!

games.title: Siege of Dungeon
games.shortDescription: Siege of Dungeon is a strategic team-based rogue-lite, where you challenge strong, cunning monsters and combine relics and skills to build up your team in turn-based combat. What’s waiting for you deep in the dungeon? Could it be a rare treasure or the beginning of despair...?

games.title: Kitchen Crisis
games.shortDescription: Kitchen Crisis is a culinary defense game. You are abducted by aliens and must satisfy their appetite. If you want to live to see another day, efficiently arrange your cooking appliances, upgrade your ingredients and tools! In order to survive, make wise decisions according to everchaning recipes.

games.title: Don Duality
games.shortDescription: Don Duality is a Chaos Manager game with card mechanics. Send your gangsters to the heist and launder money in your restaurant. Hire staff and upgrade your establishment, but remember that life like a roulette wheel and not everything can be fully controlled in Don's journey.

games.title: Raw Metal
games.shortDescription: Infiltrate the depths of an exoplanet mining facility to scavenge for gear and challenge a corrupt megacorporation. Utilize gadgets and equipment in high-stakes stealth, and hone your fighting skills in breakneck combat in this stylish stealth-action dungeon crawler.

games.title: Populous™: The Beginning
games.shortDescription: In the third part of the Populous series, you control your shaman and the tribe of her followers in a difficult quest to conquer all 25 planets of a star system and ascend to godhood.

games.title: Shoujo City
games.shortDescription: Shoujo City is a dating simulator game, set in virtual 3D Tokyo and focused on anime and otaku culture.

games.title: Pro 11 - Football Manager Game
games.shortDescription: Become the best football manager. Join Pro 11 and claim the championship!

games.title: Undungeon
games.shortDescription: Undungeon is a gorgeous Action/RPG driven by intense real-time combat and an immensely rich science fiction story. Travel between dimensions and change the world around you in an attempt to reconstruct the shattered Multiverse.

games.title: Catizens
games.shortDescription: Inspired by RimWorld and The Sims, Catizens is a colony management simulation game where you watch over unique cats with quirky personalities, as you help them build and grow their settlement while exploring new lands, facing off against wildlife and overcoming the challenges of each environment.

games.title: You Can Kana - Learn Japanese Hiragana & Katakana
games.shortDescription: Learn and master the japanese phonetic alphabets at your own pace with this meditative language learning tool.

games.title: Nimbatus - Drone Creator
games.shortDescription: Use the Nimbatus Drone Creator to construct physically simulated drones and try them out in a virtual testing environment. Do you have what it takes to become a drone engineer?

games.title: MAMIYA
games.shortDescription: MAMIYA is a captivating, dark mystery visual novel in which a group of young men struggle against existential dread before the end of the world.

games.title: Catgirls From My Sweet Dream
games.shortDescription: Journey to the Japanese Magical Village with Catgirls and Sushi. ♥Catgirls From My Sweet Dream♥ - a fun and simple satirical visual novel with “Match3” gameplay in the Magic Japanese setting. Japanese goodies and Nekogirls!

games.title: Hargrave
games.shortDescription: Hargrave finds himself inside the walls of a mysterious labyrinth filled with strange robots. Find the way out, or find what's hidden deep inside.

games.title: Who Wants To Be A Millionaire
games.shortDescription: Put your general knowledge to the test in « Who wants to be a millionaire? », the official game!

games.title: Dino Nest
games.shortDescription: Dinosaur survival management game. Lead your own pack of dinos and feed to grow bigger. Can you survive or will you become extinct?

games.title: Winter Survival
games.shortDescription: Dive into the ultimate winter survival experience and see if you can survive long enough for rescue to arrive. Experience our unique sanity system that takes survival to the next level.

games.title: Boba Simulator : Idle Shop Management
games.shortDescription: Boba Tea shop simulator. Manage recipe, stock and customer satisfaction.

games.title: Horticular
games.shortDescription: You have been magically summoned by mysterious gnomes to restore a long-lost garden. Attract adorable animals, build a lush environment, and immerse yourself in this relaxing garden-builder. Will you manage to reclaim the wasteland or succumb to a looming corruption?

games.title: Repetendium
games.shortDescription: Fight against an army of elemental creatures hell bent on your destruction. Compete with other players on the leaderboards to show who is the master of Repetendium !

games.title: Cozy Space
games.shortDescription: 'Cozy Space' is a relaxing home decoration game with true-to-life models and rooms. Enjoy a leisurely gaming experience and easily create cozy spaces. It cleverly blends music elements, allowing you to be a composer, interior designer, or simply relax without specific tasks!

games.title: NEODUEL: Backpack Monsters
games.shortDescription: NEODUEL: Backpack Monsters is a PvP inventory auto-battler with a monster-trainer twist! Collect Cosmions and items, and strategically manage your backpack to create unbeatable combos in tactical duels. Rise through the leagues to become the ultimate Cosmion master!

games.title: Penguin Helper
games.shortDescription: Penguin Helper is your chance to go to the South Pole, become a hero for penguins and enjoy a peaceful atmosphere

games.title: Himegashima Island
games.shortDescription: Kokomi is sent to the island of Himegashima, where his cousin demands that he spend his summer making happy memories. Having grown up sheltered, there's a whole new world of things for Kokomi to experience.

games.title: The Signifier Director's Cut
games.shortDescription: This story-driven adventure follows a mystery of death and despair from reality into the surreal realms of objective memories and subjective experiences. Search the mind, solve puzzles, and unravel the dark truth in this psychological thriller.

games.title: Underspace
games.shortDescription: The spiritual successor to Freelancer with a Lovecraftian, sandbox RPG twist. Explore a vast handmade universe with Day 1 mod support and a planned PvP/co-op multiplayer on the Early Access roadmap. You're going to need a bigger ship.

games.title: Bastide
