Each time you die you may upgrade or unlock several features.

games.title: Yumahorome ~Toki o Tometa Yakata de Asu o Sagasu Maigo-tachi~
games.shortDescription: 《真愿朦幻馆～在时间暂停的洋馆里追寻明天的羔羊们～》是由日本美少女游戏知名品牌Lump of Sugar（方糖社）于2022年6月24日发售的最新力作。本作由由人气画师萌木原文武担当原画与人物设计，由知名剧本家中岛大河创作剧本。片头主题歌《静寂之门》由新锐创作型歌手逢濑晶创作并献唱。

games.title: Quest Master
games.shortDescription: Quest Master is a dungeon maker inspired by the classics that first made us love dungeon crawling. Unleash your imagination, alone or in local co-op, to make dungeons full of puzzles, traps and monsters. Upload them for others to explore and challenge yourself with other players’ creations.

games.title: Creatures of Ava
games.shortDescription: Let your empathy guide you as you play an exciting action-adventure, creature-saver game. Understand and tame the creatures of Ava and let them lead you through a variety of ecosystems – all in the hopes of saving the planet from a life-consuming infection.

games.title: ONE.
games.shortDescription: The pioneering nakige that made a generation cry... Legendary '90s visual novel ONE. is back and better than ever with updated art, animations, and features!

games.title: XBPlay
games.shortDescription: Stream One and Series S/X consoles in 1080p

games.title: Hamster Hunter
games.shortDescription: You come home for an annual family reunion, only to find your family missing with an eerie note left by your father. After you discover what has happened you SEEK REVENGE!

games.title: Hotdog Runner
games.shortDescription: You are Simon, a lover of hotdogs. Can you guide him to collect the most hotdogs EVER?

games.title: Shapelab 2024
games.shortDescription: Shapelab is a unique VR 3D modeling application offering an intuitive interface and a variety of powerful polygon mesh-based sculpting tools to create high-quality 3D assets. Add VR to your 3D modeling workflow and experience a new dimension of creativity with Shapelab!

games.title: Paw Paw Paw
games.shortDescription: Paw Paw Paw was a peaceful and prosperous kingdom. Until one day, when the King had decided to enforce everyone to wear pants. We are the resistance. We are the Antipants.

games.title: Love n Dream: Virtual Happiness
games.shortDescription: 《Love n Dream: Virtual Happiness》is a card-based puzzle game with RPG components. Your job is to lead different girls to advance their adventure levels in a Virtual Reality Game.

games.title: Love Fantasy
games.shortDescription: Love Fantasy combines match-3, beauties, and visual novel elements. Become a hero to save the beautiful goddesses whose tasks were to create and preserve lives. Learn skills, buy items, upgrade stats, and so on to defeat the enemies.

games.title: Doll Explorer Prologue
games.shortDescription: 'Doll Explorer Prologue' you can play a free thinking puzzle game where you choose commands such as 'move forward' or 'attack' to traverse a dungeon! In search of dungeon treasures, the adventures of apprentice witch Tia and her magical life form Doll begin!

games.title: Chaos Galaxy 2
games.shortDescription: A turn-based Galaxy totalwar game. Choose one of 12 factions, direct dozens of admirals, control hundreds of warships, mecha and monsters, set up various buildings, study technology, and lead fleets to carry out grand strategic actions on the map of the galaxy.

games.title: Sumotori Dreams Classic
games.shortDescription: Heavy headed blocky guys sumo wrestle and tumble around.

games.title: Crossroad OS
games.shortDescription: Explore the mysterious operating system Crossʀoad OS. Adventure through its decaying programs, solve puzzles, collect items and meet strange creatures.

games.title: HAYAI
games.shortDescription: You are Ronin. Survive against an onslaught of enemies using a unique, mouse-based combat system. Draw your attack, felling your enemies in one swoop!

games.title: I live under your house.
games.shortDescription: You are a monster under someone's house.

games.title: Mortal Glory 2
games.shortDescription: Manage a team of traveling gladiators in this turn-based fantasy roguelike. Find the best recruits, discover powerful item combinations and come up with clever tactics on the battlefield. The tournament awaits those who desire MORTAL GLORY!

games.title: Joy Life
games.shortDescription: In the game, you need to find two cards with the same picture and successfully eliminate them. If the flopped cards are inconsistent, there will be no change. The way to pass the level is to eliminate all the cards in the picture.

games.title: Archaelund
games.shortDescription: Explore a vast open world and crawl through dungeons in first person, then fight tactical turn-based battles from a top-down perspective. Guide your adventuring party through Archaelund, mankind's last frontier, and uncover its many secrets.

games.title: Rune Knights
games.shortDescription: Rune Knights is a cooperative action RPG focused on customization, crafting, and combat. Customize your character's aesthetics, stats, gameplay, and gear as you battle through procedurally generated and hand-crafted levels with your allies.

games.title: I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 3
games.shortDescription: Gunfire rings out, shattering the safe haven of the town hall. Violent death. People driven to suicide. A mystery group behind the scenes. An imminent horde of zombies. And the intelligent zombies are finally on the move. What will become of Yuusuke and the others?

games.title: Vaporum: Lockdown
games.shortDescription: Vaporum: Lockdown, a prequel to Vaporum, is a grid-based dungeon crawler RPG in an original steampunk setting, inspired by old-school classics of the genre. Follow the story of Ellie Teller, a scientist struggling to survive disastrous events that happened in the tower of Arx Vaporum.

games.title: The Floor Is Still Really Cheap Lava
games.shortDescription: Small online multiplayer shooter with friends and customizable gamemodes. Loads of weapons to unlock. Storymode with a final boss; Try to travel as far as possible while avoiding the cheap lava!

games.title: candle flame in the wind
games.shortDescription: 我们是否需要探求一个所谓的答案或者真相？我们为了自已想知道的答案可以付出怎么样的代价？在这普通的一天烛即将迎来自己的命运，发现关于自己的黑暗秘密，而原本平静的生活也变得像风中的烛火一样摇摇欲坠。

games.title: RONIN: Two Souls CHAPTER 1
games.shortDescription: Create your own adventure with Kenji who wants to be a samurai and is trained for it. But beware, you might go out on your own way in this path, it is entirely up to your choices. Can someone else’s desire of revenge lead your purpose and choices? Or, does he decide that?

games.title: Guardians Frontline
games.shortDescription: Guardians Frontline is a sci-fi VR shooter that makes you a soldier and a commander. Fight off enemies and build bases in a single-player and co-op campaign, plus PvP game modes with full cross-play support.

games.title: Jitsu Squad
games.shortDescription: Jitsu Squad is a Marvel vs Capcom inspired 4 player co-op TAG TEAM beat ‘em up with epic character transformations and fast paced combat.

games.title: Blast Brigade vs. the Evil Legion of Dr. Cread
games.shortDescription: Blast off in a 2D metroidvania adventure bursting with platforming thrills, deep exploration, and explosive action. Assemble a crack team of heroes to save the world in Blast Brigade!

games.title: Mido and Di
games.shortDescription: Mido is an alien kid having nightmares about zombie aliens. One night he draws a creature, Di, and it comes alive to teach Mido how to fight zombies.

games.title: Start Over
games.shortDescription: Embark on an unpredictable survival journey in Start Over. Solo, co-op, online, explore diverse landscapes, craft through 4 tech tiers, encounter wildlife, and trade or raid for resources. Choose your path, defend against waves, and shape your destiny in a dynamic world. Are you ready to Start Over?

games.title: Logiart Grimoire
games.shortDescription: Logiart Grimoire is a puzzle game that combines the number puzzle 'Logiart' and the word puzzle 'Fusion' in which you deduce combinations from clues.

games.title: Quadrober Simulator
games.shortDescription: Are you a quadrober?

games.title: SCARF
games.shortDescription: Scarf is an atmospheric and emotional journey about what it means to be a hero. An adventure game mixing puzzles and 3D platforms. Explore beautifully crafted worlds and discover your true destiny with the help of a dragon-shaped scarf.

games.title: Remorse: The List
games.shortDescription: Remorse: The List is a classic survival horror game where the player must figure out what is happening in the little hungarian town of Hidegpuszta, and your only clue is a list that doesn't make much sense. Exploring will be the key to unveiling its secrets and get out of there alive.

games.title: Dark Hero Party
games.shortDescription: Imos lives his peaceful life helping his sister Tori run a potion shop in a quiet village. However, when an order is given for all Dracovalis to hunt down the Demon Lord, that peace is shattered forever.

games.title: Bus Driving Sim 22
games.shortDescription: Experience what it feels like to be a real bus driver. Simulator featuring realistic physics, a variety of bus models (city buses, electric bus, school bus), three distinct regions to explore (US, Germany, Brazil) and much more. Test your skills in career, drive in freeride or play multiplayer.

games.title: RPG Developer Bakin
games.shortDescription: RPG Developer Bakin is a game development tool that allows anyone to create RPGs using intuitive operations and advanced features without the need for programming knowledge. Several game asset DLCs are also available, so you can enjoy creating games from the day you purchase it.

games.title: Gazillionaire
games.shortDescription: Become a Gazillionaire by starting a tiny trading company and building a business empire!

games.title: Goblin Summer Camp
games.shortDescription: The one true multiplayer goblin simulator. Play Goblin Tag and acquire power ups that let you leap across the entire map. Play Hide and Seek and annoy your friends with ‘REEEES’ when they cant find you. Stay alive in Death Run without being trapped. Be a goblin and do goblin things!

games.title: Midnight Scenes: The Highway (Special Edition)
games.shortDescription: Claire Barnes is about to discover what kind of horrors lurk in the darkness of a deserted road. Welcome to a dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.

games.title: Fire Commander
games.shortDescription: See what it means to face the fire. Command a firefighting unit in an exciting tactical RTS. Save lives, manage your water supplies and care for your team in 30+ missions. Be a real hero!

games.title: Ninja Hanrei
games.shortDescription: Ninja Hanrei is a 2D run and gun Platformer game inspired on Ancient Japan but with Super Powers.

games.title: Survive or Thrive
games.shortDescription: Crikey, mate! You shouldn't be out here all on your own! There's big MONSTAS' runnin' about! And besides... It's not always the beasts that you gotta watch out for. Beasts are easy to predict! They just wanna kill and eat ya! Humans are much harder... They'll pretend to be your friend first!

games.title: A Shopping Trip to Eklan Tor
games.shortDescription: Explore a tiny monster town in VR and search for hidden objects.

games.title: Lawgivers II
games.shortDescription: Lawgivers II is a political sandbox game that features multiple electoral systems, approve/reject bills and govern a country. Start out your career from the very bottom, and perhaps one day, lead your nation to become the most influential in the world.

games.title: Meridian 157: Chapter 1
games.shortDescription: While searching for the anomaly, you find yourself trapped inside a facility on a remote sub-Arctic island. What is this place? Who built it? Why was it left abandoned? Explore the uninhabited complex you now find yourself trapped in, but be warned: you might not be as alone as you think...

games.title: Gone Rogue
games.shortDescription: Gone Rogue is a tactical stealth game with RPG elements. Get into the role of a thief from the city slums. Lurking in the shadows, sneak unnoticed past enemies, get behind any locked doors, and carry off rich loot.

games.title: Perseus: Titan Slayer
games.shortDescription: Defeat the Titans as you battle your way into Tartarus to stop Chaos from conquering Olympus and destroying the world. In this rogue-like dungeon crawler adventure, you will play as Perseus, a demigod tasked with one mission; stop Chaos and the evil forces that surround him.

games.title: The Mobius Machine
games.shortDescription: Discover a vast alien world. Fight the ferocious local fauna and killer machines. Reveal its secrets and find a way to escape. The Mobius Machine is a side-scroller action adventure, with an emphasis on free-form exploration and intense combat.

games.title: Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic
games.shortDescription: Join Clicky on a new, enchanted adventure in Hidden Through Time 2: Myths Magic! Search for hidden objects scattered around hand-drawn worlds, and unlock more as you go. With both a single player campaign and an online mode where you can create your own dreamworld, the adventure never ends!

games.title: Karting Superstars
games.shortDescription: A kart racing game without weapons! This is a pure motorsport arcade racer. Compete vs very challenging AI, get on the global leaderboards and play with others online.

games.title: Mini Settlers
games.shortDescription: Mini Settlers is a minimalistic city builder! Settle islands, construct cities, and design efficient logistic networks to fulfill your buildings' needs and fuel population growth to adventure into new worlds.

games.title: DeathWatchers
games.shortDescription: DeathWatchers is a 4 player online co-op, psychological horror. Use the equipment at your disposal to locate log as many paranormal events as possible. Build your ritual and try to cleanse the locations of any demonic threats. An incorrect ritual and you may never leave.

games.title: United Penguin Kingdom
games.shortDescription: A city-building game where you build a penguin settlement and satisfy the various needs of your penguins while dealing with seals and killer whales. Enjoy the growth of your settlement, become the king, and lead the United Penguin Kingdom.

games.title: Astro Looter: Survivor
games.shortDescription: Explore alien planets to mine resources, kill alien insects, build defense turrets, and survive waves of insect attacks across the galactic frontier. Astro Looter combines elements of survival, roguelike, and tower defense in a top-down shooter.

games.title: Lenna's Inception
games.shortDescription: The legendary hero is dead, and a strange glitch is spreading across the kingdom. Explore dangerous dungeons, and defeat the eight archangels to restore order to an unraveling world in this epic action-adventure RPG.

games.title: Chaotic Airport Construction Manager
games.shortDescription: A simulation game making fun of Germans needing 16 years to build an airport. Are you able to do better?

games.title: I'm on Observation Duty 3
games.shortDescription: A thrilling psychological horror game. Your job is to look for anomalies in a haunted house. If you see anyhting suspicious (furniture moving, extra objects, intruders), take a photo and send a report. Includes both VR- (windows only) and non-VR (windows, mac, linux)-versions.

games.title: Legendary Hoplite
games.shortDescription: A combination of Action RPG and Tower Defense: slay monsters, find weapons, upgrade your armies, defend your base… Prevent humanity from extinction at the hands of monsters from Greek mythology and ancient tribes. Don't let them cross the gate, commander!

games.title: Epiphany City
games.shortDescription: Use magical picture frames to manipulate the world around you in mind-bending ways. Turn paintings to life, change time, re-imagine objects to suit your needs. Follow Lily, a girl who's lost all hope, as she steals powers from the strongest superhero, leaving it up to her to save the world.

games.title: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
games.shortDescription: Plan your next move wisely, every additional combo can make the difference! Whether in solo or duo, online or offline, mix and match your units to defeat your enemies in this Definitive Edition of Might Magic: Clash of Heroes!

games.title: Sisters: Last Day of Summer
games.shortDescription: A fully-animated visual novel about a boy who wakes up in an unknown house with two beautiful sisters, their mother, and an unspoken truth.

games.title: Turkish Throne
games.shortDescription: Lead your political party in a fierce competition to seize power against major rivals. Invest strategically, secure votes, and navigate crucial decisions to claim the presidential seat. Will you shape the destiny of Turkish politics?

games.title: DOOMBLADE
games.shortDescription: Deep underground, Gloom Girl discovers DOOMBLADE, a sentient weapon hellbent on escape after eons in chains. Together, “Doom and Gloom” embark on a vengeful quest to unlock the powerful abilities and destroy the Dread Lords once and for all in this 2D Action Metroidvania.

games.title: Hot And Lovely 2
games.shortDescription: This is an interesting casual origami game that can exercise your hands-on ability. And when you pass all the levels, you can start the hot sex journey between you and the beautiful girl.

games.title: Simp Simulator
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Simp Simulator. Queen desires money, perhaps it's time to simp! Collect as many money sacks as you could and deliver them to your queen! Hurry though, queen does not like to wait.

games.title: Guilt Free
games.shortDescription: Guilt Free is a visual novel crossed with a point and click made to offer perspective on mental health and eating disorders. Navigate a couple's rocky relationship and encounter 'flaws' or 'quirks' that may actually be symptomatic behaviors.

games.title: Chenso Club
games.shortDescription: Aliens are attacking! Who will save us? Chenso Club will! Using chainsaws, hammers, and the aliens’ own life force against them - these fearless warriors will pulverise enemies on their way to victory. Go solo! Go co-op! Go hack those aliens in this action-packed, side-scrolling platform brawler!

games.title: QV
games.shortDescription: Start a dimension-jumping adventure with Quby!

games.title: Love in the distance
games.shortDescription: A word adventure game based on a long-distance relationship. On high school and college campuses, pick up memories that belong only to that time. Ideal and reality, if we can chose it again, can we not have regrets?

games.title: Transiruby
games.shortDescription: Explore the mysteries of an unknown land! ”Transiruby '' is a metroidvania game where you explore the world as a cyborg protagonist named Siruby. Slash and shoot your way to reveal its hidden secrets!

games.title: Beyond The Edge Of Owlsgard
games.shortDescription: Save a peaceful world from being annihilated by machines in this oldschool point click tale, inspired by classic animated movies and adventure games of the 90s.

games.title: moon: Remix RPG Adventure
games.shortDescription: Don't be a hero. Experience the love. Experience moon. moon is an anti-RPG steeped in story and character, mood and music.

games.title: Great Houses of Calderia
games.shortDescription: Great Houses of Calderia is a Feudal Grand Strategy game focusing on family dynamics stories. Use your family strengths to compete against rivals to rise in the ranks of Calderia - produce, trade, scheme, bribe, and battle to build your legacy of power!

games.title: Crypto Miner Tycoon Simulator
games.shortDescription: Build rigs to mine Bitcoin, Ethereum and other cryptocurrency. Trade on the market to grow wealth. Expand your business into new offices. Hire skilled employees and assign tasks. Use cash from your mega farms to research new technologies and reach the goal of each scenario.

games.title: Dread X Collection 5
games.shortDescription: A horror anthology in the Dread X Collection series. Featuring 12 new games from up-and-comers along with veterans, all wrapped up in an old, run down party venue that may be hiding more than it's letting on...

games.title: My Cat Girl Lover
games.shortDescription: Zirui, who lives alone, takes in a dying black cat. One rainy night the black cat suddenly 'bad-mouthed' Zirui. The next day, the black cat disappears and at the same time, a cat lady who resembles the black cat appears in Zirui's bed ......

games.title: Sunrider 4: The Captain's Return
games.shortDescription: Captain Kayto Shields returns from exile in Sunrider 4: The Captain’s Return for a new space adventure!

games.title: Don't Pee
games.shortDescription: You've woken up in the middle of the night and you've gotta pee. Get to the bathroom as fast as you can before you pee your pants.

games.title: Egg Squeeze
games.shortDescription: Egg Squeeze is a biological intuition test where you squeeze eggs for as long as you can without breaking them.

games.title: AION - Translator application
games.shortDescription: AION - Translator application is not a simple translator, but it translates all texts andtexts in the image to the language you want in all OS environment.

games.title: Ever Forward
games.shortDescription: A girl trapped in a strange world somewhere between reality and imagination. Help her find her way in this adventure puzzle game.

games.title: GameGuru MAX
games.shortDescription: GameGuru MAX is a 3D game-maker that makes the creation of your game simple, quick and easy – no coding required! With all the tools and assets you need in one place you can start making your dream game in minutes! Dream it ∙ Build it ∙ Play it

games.title: Silicon Dreams | cyberpunk interrogation
games.shortDescription: It’s 2065, and you are an interrogator-model android tasked with rooting out deviants among your own kind. You must probe for lies, monitor and exploit emotional spikes, earn the trust of your subjects, and make the final call: release, or destroy?

games.title: Police Shootout
games.shortDescription: Police Shootout is a new turn-based FPS game. Put on your uniform and get ready to respond the most surprising calls in your policeman’s career. Solve cases and gain experience, but also find out why a good young policeman gave up his career in a big city and moved to a small town of San Adrino.

games.title: Krush Kill ‘N Destroy 2: Krossfire
games.shortDescription: Krush Kill 'N Destroy 2: Krossfire is a fast and furious post-apocalyptic real-time strategy game where you have to be quick or be dead. Play as one of three unique factions in the struggle to seek out and conquer oil fields to fuel your army.

games.title: World Racing 2 - Champion Edition
games.shortDescription: World Racing 2 is back - revamped with a new look! The highly acclaimed racing spectacle makes the streets on your screen glow like never before! The new Champion Edition offers modding and Steam Workshop support. Are you ready to start the race of your life? The roads are waiting for you!

games.title: Curse Crackers: For Whom the Belle Toils
games.shortDescription: Curse Crackers is a fast-paced acrobatic platformer where you bounce, vault, and fight your way through a whimsical world with the help of your loyal companion. Eat snacks, collect items, and travel the world to stop Bonnie and her band of troublemakers!

games.title: Queen of the flies 蝇后
games.shortDescription: This is a reading game that describes internet life. You can push the plot by clicking on different positions on the screen and pass the customs in 30 minutes.

games.title: Between Horizons
games.shortDescription: Between Horizons is a narrative 2.5D sci-fi detective adventure. 33 years into the Zephyr's journey, its mission is suddenly jeopardized. Can you find the culprit before it's too late? Experience an enthralling story set in a semi-open world that branches and ends based on your choices.

games.title: GeoDepths
games.shortDescription: Pilot your drill deep below the surface of a remote planet, to mine ore to refine into resources, which will be used in drill upgrades and construction of your homebase. Upgrades will allow you to drill deeper to find more types of ores. Explore caves to uncover mysteries and secrets.

games.title: Departed Away
games.shortDescription: Discover 'Departed Away,' a captivating visual novel where friendship intertwines with mystery. Uncover secrets, engage in verbal duels, and make choices that shape your story. Delve into emotional depth and intricate connections in this unique story.

games.title: Nine Tereasures of Liuyin
games.shortDescription: This is a dark, soul like role-playing game, trying to create a different experience in this genre. The protagonist fights against a powerful enemy in this city in search of a divine artifact.

games.title: Red Bow
games.shortDescription: If you were given another chance, would you take it? Or leave it in the hands of a little girl? Play as Roh, a young girl stuck in a bizarre nightmare of dark and eerie creatures.

games.title: Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials
games.shortDescription: Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials is a snarky action-adventure puzzle game with a good dose of humor. Explore hundreds of secret-filled rooms, fight big bosses, gather companions for your party and use the powers of Pip—your bat buddy—to solve puzzles and escape the eldritch abyss!

games.title: LEAP
games.shortDescription: LEAP is a fast-paced, multiplayer first-person shooter featuring epic large scale battles, each with players armed to the teeth. Fight for either the United Earth Defense Coalition (UEDC) or the rebel Exo-Terrans - whoever pays the most, wins your trigger finger and excessive arsenal.

games.title: Survival Classic
games.shortDescription: Try to survive the harsh realities of the cold Siberian countryside. Live long and always remember, man is man's enemy. You can trust no one but it is almost impossible to survive on your own. Choose your path and go to finish. Firefights, transport, crafting and survival.

games.title: Breakpoint
games.shortDescription: Breakpoint is a twin-stick slasher where your weapons explode. Break through the swarm to claim your spot on the online leaderboard.

games.title: Hairdresser Simulator
games.shortDescription: Create new hairstyles for customers. Cut, dye, and style to perfection. Enhance your skills and master the craft. Run your business and renovate your salon. Generate profit, hire employees - aim to the top! Upload any portrait photo and try out new hairstyles thanks to the character creator!

games.title: Keyword: A Spider's Thread
games.shortDescription: Become an investigator in Keyword, a narrative thriller where you’ll depend on skills of logical deduction, hacking, and social engineering to solve challenging puzzles as the only means of finding your missing daughter.

games.title: Tyrant's Blessing
games.shortDescription: Tyberia has been turned into a paradise by the Tyrant, free from war, suffering, and death - because nearly everyone has been turned into the undead. Take charge of the last living warriors in tactical, turn-based battles and drive the Dead Army into the sea!

games.title: Sugar * Style
games.shortDescription: Sugar * Style is a Japanese-style visual novel produced by Smee, a Japanese developer of romance VNs. Be the perfect husband for your future wife and conquer her heart with your husband-powers!

games.title: AGAINST
games.shortDescription: AGAINST is a combat rhythm VR game that will immerse you in a dark comics story. Follow the beat to shoot and slice your way through evil henchmen of Dr. Vice. Empowering music is your only way out from these crime-ridden streets.

games.title: Boxville
games.shortDescription: Boxville is an adventure puzzle game about speechless cans living in the city of boxes and drawing doodles on cardboards to tell the stories. Made in Ukraine.

games.title: Arrogation: Unlight of Day
games.shortDescription: Arrogation: Unlight of Day is a psychological horror game set in World War II. You will play as a lone reporter searching for his lost family in an abandoned village from 80s China. Beyond darkness, you will find nightmarish creatures and secrets from the long lost Imperial Japanese Army.

games.title: Takoyaki Party Survival
games.shortDescription: You should consume a good balance of protein, carbohydrates, and fats to survive. The nutritional balance changes depending on the ingredients you put in your takoyaki. If you are overloaded with calories, you will be too full to eat, so please consume calories by squatting.

games.title: KATANA KAMI: A Way of the Samurai Story
games.shortDescription: The Way of the Samurai is forged in battle! Help the swordsmith Dojima pay off his debt after his beautiful daughter is taken as collateral by crafting swords by day and exploring mysterious, twisting dungeons for valuable materials at night.

games.title: Zooma VR
games.shortDescription: Zooma is a virtual adventure in which you will have to be smart, demonstrate your ability for rapid decision-making, and exhibit significant accuracy and coordination skills. Check out what happens if you mix shooting, puzzles, and classic match-three in virtual reality.

games.title: The Good Life
games.shortDescription: Enjoy everyday life while solving a murder mystery in Rainy Woods - known as the 'happiest town in the world' - in this all-new 'Debt Repayment RPG'!

games.title: Pandemic Love
games.shortDescription: A short visual novel about isolation. You try to search for comfort in the lonesome people around you. Keeping the darkness at bay with small embers of light. Will you let the fear change you?

games.title: Miniland Adventure
games.shortDescription: The world doesn't generate itself - you do it, shape the world as you wish! Start with nothing, and build dream houses for goblins and yourself while exploring, collecting resources, crafting, building, fighting, farming... and more!

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom
games.shortDescription: Traverse the Telvanni Peninsula in Morrowind and preserve secrets ascribed to the unfathomable realms of Apocrypha. Unlock the runic power of a brand-new class - the Arcanist - and fight to uphold reality itself.

games.title: No Sun To Worship
games.shortDescription: A short, minimalist stealth-action game about the importance of art. We painted the sky ashen gray. Burned the heavens to starve each other. Now we walk an endless cemetery of regret.

games.title: Dollmare
games.shortDescription: You've accepted a shady job offer at a doll factory. Inspect dolls for defects and anomalies. Follow strange protocols. Don't get fired and stay alive.

games.title: Haruka Ao no Hanayome ni
games.shortDescription: 《献给蔚蓝之海的新娘》是由日本美少女游戏知名品牌Lump of Sugar（方糖社）于2023年最新发售的作品。本作由人气原画师萌木原文武担当人物设计与原画，由业内多位剧本家携手担当剧本；结成惠乃香、风花真白等知名声优领衔出演游戏女主角。片头主题曲《Eternity Blue》由知名歌姬Kicco献唱。

games.title: Rocket Assault: Downhill Rush
games.shortDescription: Fast-paced racing game based on Rocket League mechanics, race against players from all over the world, defeat them to rank up in the leaderboards and get special items to show off your skills

games.title: Inn Legend
games.shortDescription: 一款经典的客栈经营类游戏。在想法设法发展客栈的同时，还要处理好人际关系，最终将自己的客栈从破产的边缘拯救回来。

games.title: A day in East Europe
games.shortDescription: Have you ever went on google and searched 'I accidentally'? If you did then you saw that google autosuggest 'I accidentally restarted the USSR'. In this game you will be able to play the tail of Igor Ivanov as he accidentally restarts the USSR.

games.title: Cross Maid
games.shortDescription: 互相认错性别的两人，机缘巧合之下开始同居生活 产生羁绊到互相依恋再到自我怀疑，温馨欢乐的短片小故事

games.title: Vertical Slice: A Game Dev Story
games.shortDescription: From nobody to famous game producer in 3 years: that’s the journey you will live! Experience the trials and tribulations of game development in this life simulation game: live through the process of founding a small team and learning how to work together to develop a successful game.

games.title: Madshot
games.shortDescription: Madshot is a fast-paced, acrobatic, rogue-lite shooter. Survive the ever-changing road through Cthulhu and beyond. Equip endless upgrade combinations as you fight your way through horrific monsters and multi-phased boss battles.

games.title: illWill
games.shortDescription: Eliminate hordes of monsters in a thrilling first person shooter - ILLWILL.

games.title: Re:BF
games.shortDescription: When a world is overwhelmed by new monsters, it's up to a single apprentice adventurer to set out on a quest and bring peace back to the land in this JRPG with fully animated combat!

games.title: VRM Posing Desktop
games.shortDescription: Accelerate the creation of 3D models! This is a highly functional posing tool for Vtubers, 3D modelers, and illustrators to use.Make your VRM character take various poses using poses you created or others' poses.Various useful functions are available.

games.title: Ukraine Defense Force Tactics
games.shortDescription: Turn-based strategy in which you lead a heroic defense of Ukraine under siege by the despicable Russian Z force. Outmaneuver an endless deluge of enemies using combined infantry-and-armor tactics to survive against all odds.

games.title: Late Night Drive
games.shortDescription: Explore various maps with your friends or play solo and relax. Whether you prefer a relaxing drive or a fast-paced, action-packed race, the choice is yours. Get ready to unforgettable journey through the city streets under the moonlit sky!

games.title: SKIBIDI: ESCAPE FROM TOILETS!
games.shortDescription: 'SKIBIDI: ESCAPE FROM TOILETS' is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players. TV MANs are trying to get through creepy and atmospheric locations that are filled with dangerous SKIBIDI - they want to kill you! Free content updates with new levels and game modes - YES YES YES!

games.title: Find the Demon 恶魔鉴定守则
games.shortDescription: 她们中间，有一个是恶魔。

games.title: The Waylanders
games.shortDescription: Slip the bonds of fate in this party-based RPG filled with Celtic myth and historical legend. Discover thrilling adventure alongside mortal companions and immortal allies as you explore the world of The Waylanders.

games.title: Transient: Extended Edition
games.shortDescription: H.P. Lovecraft meets Cyberpunk. Delve deep into a dystopian world and investigate what is happening to you and your friends in a domed city. Solve puzzles, hack systems and plug in to explore other dimensions. Discover a truth that might tear apart your sanity and question your very existence.

games.title: Horror Story: Hallowseed
games.shortDescription: Horror Story: Hallowseed is a story-driven psychological horror game. An obscure event causes two of your friends to disappear while you were camping in the woods. Left alone and stranded in an unknown place, you need to seek the answers about what happened, face the horror and find your friends.

games.title: Burn Me Twice
games.shortDescription: A narrative adventure that combines the exploration and investigation of the enigmatic town of Düstenburg and its people, with trials that test your knowledge about the case.

games.title: Re:DESTINY
games.shortDescription: This is a game that combines match-3 with light RPG elements, a GALGAME style of presentation with beautiful character. The story is strongly inspired by Japan mythology background and characters.

games.title: From the Shadows
games.shortDescription: From the Shadows is a cooperative puzzle platformer game where players have to work their way through a mysterious mansion by resolving puzzles that revolve around the mechanics of light and shadow.

games.title: Brain Meltdown - Into Despair
games.shortDescription: Brain Meltdown - Into Despair is a platformer game with a unique concept, where you need to control two characters by yourself. This is not a co-op game!

games.title: Incremental Epic Hero
games.shortDescription: Incremental, Idle, RPG, Japanese Anime Game! Incremental Epic Hero is a free-to-play idle game with Japanese cute anime!

games.title: Leenie Boog
games.shortDescription: The war. Light versus darkness. It has been going on for thousands of years. One night, the Thousand-Year War suddenly knocked on your window. You will have to meet an uninvited guest.

games.title: Clank!
games.shortDescription: Burgle your way to adventure in the award-winning board game!

games.title: Dolmen
games.shortDescription: Dolmen is a terrifying new action RPG that combines futuristic Sci-Fi and Cosmic Horror elements. Will your timeline be erased or will you defeat your enemies to survive and fulfil your mission?

games.title: Raiders! Forsaken Earth
games.shortDescription: Raiders! Forsaken Earth is a strategy/management game where you play as the leader of a merciless band of post-apocalyptic marauders. Build up your organization while extorting, kidnapping, and destroying the last remnants of civilization. The wasteland doesn't need another hero...

games.title: DEPO : Death Epileptic Pixel Origins
games.shortDescription: DEPO is a first person 3D platformer where you control a rebel pixel inside a computer with an evil Operating System governing everything. You'll find final bosses, cinematic scenes, arcade mini-games, 70 huge levels full of surprises, ¡and big stories to discover!

games.title: Sakura Succubus 3
games.shortDescription: The third part of the Sakura Succubus series finds Hiroki enjoying himself with his succubus harem. His days pass peacefully, until he meets a mysterious woman who claims to have a strong connection to him.

games.title: Hello Puppets! VR
games.shortDescription: Go on a horror-comedy adventure that turns your hand into a living, talking puppet named Scout. Years ago, a bad Sesame Street knock-off called “Mortimer’s Handeemen” was canceled and forgotten, but the puppets from the show have come to life. They’re pure evil and they have plans for you.

games.title: LAPIN
games.shortDescription: LAPIN is a 2D precision platformer game featuring a group of brave rabbit explorers. Break through life-threatening obstacles with precise controls, and embark on an adventure filled with new encounters and stunning landscapes!

games.title: Survivor Dieland
games.shortDescription: You're gonna get yourself killed being out here all by your lonesome... There's monsters on this island! Besides, It's not always the beasts you should be afraid of... Beasts are easy to predict. They just want to kill and eat you. Humans are much harder... They'll pretend to be your friend first...

games.title: Anglerfish
games.shortDescription: The game only saves when you die. Every time you die, something changes. Every change is based on where and how you died. Go on an epic adventure only equipped with your trusted shotgun, your wit and your strong stomach for disturbing exploration. Can you survive a night at the bar, Anglerfish?

games.title: Voor De Kroon
games.shortDescription: Fight for control during the Friso-Hollandic Wars. Set in the medieval 13th century, the game features a strategy campaign and historical battles. Fight with your army in 3rd person battles and command your troops.

games.title: Yacht Dice
games.shortDescription: Yacht Dice is a classic dice game popular around the world, each player by throwing dice statistics score to carry on the game, the player with the highest score wins. Invite friends to play online, or compete against players from around the world.

games.title: Fishing Vacation
games.shortDescription: A Game Boy styled fishing horror adventure

games.title: Multiplayer Platform Golf
games.shortDescription: Swing into the ultimate golf adventure with Multiplayer Platform Golf! Enjoy physics-based golfing and 3D platforming in multiplayer matches with up to 12 players. Create and share courses using the level editor and explore endless community maps via Steam Workshop. It’s time to tee off!

games.title: Abandoned Souls
games.shortDescription: Abandoned Souls is a horror game, shown through a GoPro lens. You play as a vlogger who specializes in urban exploration.

games.title: Shadows of the Damned: Hella Remastered
games.shortDescription: Shadows of the Damned, an action-adventure road trip through hell, has been remastered at last! Get ready for a story about rock, love, and just a little bit of demon slaying.

games.title: Dragon Is Dead
games.shortDescription: Dragon is Dead is a hack-and-slash, roguelite action platformer. It offers tons of customization fun with different character skill trees and legendary equipment. Overcome repeated deaths to defeat Guernian, the leader of the Dark Dragons.

games.title: 8-Bit Adventures 2
games.shortDescription: 8-Bit Adventures 2 is everything you love about NES, SNES and PS1-era JRPGs - with all of the charm, heart and soul, but none of the inconvenience. Dynamic turn-based battles pixels with personality!

games.title: Wire Lips
games.shortDescription: Leta’s life changed in one moment. She and her friend Lina found an old music box in the mountains... and soon Lina disappeared, leaving behind only a photograph and the ominous music box. Uncover the secrets in atmospheric third-person horror game.

games.title: Mad Experiments: Escape Room
games.shortDescription: Award-nominated escape game. Alone or with up to 5 players, explore 3 unique rooms, solve mind-bending puzzles, and unravel the dark secrets of the Professor Cheshire and his experiments.

games.title: Alien Marauder
games.shortDescription: “Alien Marauder” is a real-time strategy game with survival and confrontation theme. In this game, you will be the leader to a treacherous alien planet, build and defend base to survive against the vexan waves. Make the right decision!

games.title: Dadish
games.shortDescription: Explore an exciting world, face off with fast-food themed foes, and reunite Dadish with his missing children in this challenging platforming adventure.

games.title: Boat Crew
games.shortDescription: Command your crew in Boat Crew, a gripping action-strategy experience amidst the Pacific War. Take charge of a PT boat against Imperial Japan, skillfully managing resources and personnel by any means necessary to ensure victory in this high-stakes conflict.

games.title: Four Color Jump
games.shortDescription: Four color jumps is a leisure jumping game. The ball rises, crosses or touches the springboard, and constantly jumps up. Let's see where the limit of the ball is!

games.title: Total Tank Generals
games.shortDescription: Every war has its Generals. Take command of an army during World War II and lead them to victory. Strategize your way through many scenarios and real historical military campaigns of past generals.

games.title: 孤岛海妖 The Sea-demon
games.shortDescription: 一组侦探小队受章鱼岛主人之邀，对六年前的海妖悬案发起挑战。她们需要在二十四小时内完成调查，并各自提交一份答案。最后，出现了七种截然不同的解答……

games.title: Within Skerry
games.shortDescription: The Accumulation of Evil is an ancient book stating that if enough evil energy is concentrated in a single area, a dark force may be born.Humans can sometimes be very horrible creatures - but sometimes, it is taken a bit too far.

games.title: Trash of the Titans
games.shortDescription: It's turn-based fantasy tactics with trash animals. Defend your trash from invading rats, and eat your trash to upgrade your team. Think your way out of ruin by using the shape of each level to your advantage. Be creative, and try to not die.

games.title: Exanimum: The Silent Call
games.shortDescription: 'Exanimum: The Silent Call' is a first-person psychological horror game. In this chilling experience, you will find yourself confronting terrifying mysteries and chilling secrets.

games.title: Desvelado
games.shortDescription: Turn off the lights, dodge the ghosts and go to sleep as soon as you can in this hand-crafted 2d platform experience! In this vampiric precision platformer you will overcome challenging puzzles and deadly enemies before going to sleep in your cosy coffin.

games.title: Space Simulation Toolkit
games.shortDescription: Physics sandbox game that uses a graphics card as a supercomputer. Change the laws of physics, design mechanisms, create A-Life worlds and inhabit them with living beings, experiment with evolution and AI.

games.title: VR Skater
games.shortDescription: The most authentic, challenging, and immersive skating game ever

games.title: Arena
games.shortDescription: Fight for your freedom to exist as a magical freak!

games.title: Miner: Dig Deep
games.shortDescription: A cozy mining platformer game. Dig deep into the earth in search of riches. Create your mine, improve your equipment, but don't get too greedy.

games.title: Few Nights More
games.shortDescription: Few Nights More is a roguelike turn-based RPG based in a world where Vampire Lords seek to conquer lost territories and their place in the world. Design and defend your stronghold, slay your enemies with traps, fulfill your Lord’s true potential, slowly conquering what is rightfully yours.

games.title: Xuan-Yuan Sword 2
games.shortDescription: *** This game doesn't support English *** 自盘古开天辟地后，女娲神创造了人族与魔族，因性格与外表的不同，两族常起冲突。后来人类铸造了一把神器——轩辕剑，企图彻底解决两族间的战争。持有此剑的侠士带领人类与魔族战得两败俱伤。十七年后，主角离开教他仙法多年的师父下山历练，面对这世上的纷争，期待一个能让自己活跃的舞台……

games.title: Ethereal Estate
games.shortDescription: As an Ethereal Estate agent, your job is to make a mess out of a mansion and its helpless inhabitants. Never before has a ghost unleashed such devastating chaos... until now!

games.title: Siege of Avalon: Anthology
games.shortDescription: Siege of Avalon is an isometric story-driven fantasy-RPG. The Citadel of Avalon is all that remains of the once-mighty seven kingdoms. The invaders have surrounded Avalon and the depleted garrison is bracing for the final assault. Now is the time for the birth of a legend.

games.title: Beside Myself
games.shortDescription: You have to play as the historian-journalist Michael, plunge into the atmosphere of darkness of an abandoned hospital, where you will need to unravel the secrets of the past and try to get out in order to tell the whole world about those terrible events.

games.title: Lust from Beyond: M Edition
games.shortDescription: Descend into madness in a first-person survival horror inspired by Lovecraft and Giger. Solve the mystery of esoteric cults. Cross the gate to the blasphemous land of Lusst’ghaa. Play the new M-rated cut of the fan-favorite Lust from Beyond.

games.title: Blood And Zombies
games.shortDescription: Blood, guts, meat. Humanity's waging total war against a horrific zombie apocalypse. Lead one of four of humanity's deadliest survivors against the horde in this first person, wave defense shooter. Load up your guns, set up turrets, sharpen your skills, and maybe you'll make it through the night.

games.title: EXOME
games.shortDescription: EXOME is a co-op survival shooter with a focus on exploration, weapon progression and horde AI. Discover what grim mysteries are hidden in this deep forest. Explore and fight for survival, alone or with your friends.

games.title: Greyhill Incident
games.shortDescription: This story-driven Survival-Horror game is about a classic Alien-Invasion which takes place during the early 90s. As Ryan Baker, equipped with a baseball bat and a few bullets in his revolver, the story takes you across the atmospheric neighborhood of Greyhill which is invaded by UFOs Grey Aliens.

games.title: UNITED 1944
games.shortDescription: UNITED 1944 is an innovative WWII shooter combining weapon crafting, base building, and team strategy. Fight for territory in 16v16 urban guerrilla battles in Domination Mode, or explore a city in ruins as a lone wolf in Survivor. Unlock skills and customize your hero. Play your way. Make history.

games.title: Terminal 81
games.shortDescription: Thanks to the financial crisis of 2008, Lorena migrated to Terminal 81 to work, but what seemed like a simple Latin American neighborhood, it was a dangerous region dominated by a mysterious criminal organization that carries out murders, kidnappings and human trafficking.

games.title: Star Command Galaxies
games.shortDescription: Take command in the ultimate starship simulator: Star Command Galaxies. Become a Captain, recruit your crew, customize and upgrade your starship, battle alien vessels, teleport to away missions and repel boarding invaders in this real-time strategy simulation adventure from indie studio Warballoon.

games.title: Gladius | Gladiator VR Sword fighting
games.shortDescription: Gladius is an immersive VR sword fighting game set in ancient Rome. As a gladiator, you will choose your weapons, train against different enemies, and finally fight for your freedom in an epic battle against the mightiest warriors and mythical creatures of the time. Win the crowd and you will win your freedom.

games.title: Gal*Gun Returns
games.shortDescription: The infamous ecchi rail-shooter is back! Fight back with pheromones as girls throw themselves at you and try to find true love in less than a day! Discover a beautifully reimagined version of the first game of the series that never came to the west!

games.title: The Amazing American Circus
games.shortDescription: Roll up and play a deck building game like no other! Gather weird and wonderful performers, amaze audiences, explore Gilded Age America, and transform your run down circus into an entertainment empire. Play your cards right and you could claim the crown of greatest showman from P.T .Barnum!

games.title: SUPER DRINK BROS.
games.shortDescription: Juice cans hit each other! ?? A powerful and high-speed 3D action game that decides the best drink in the world!

games.title: Ark of Artemis
games.shortDescription: Half a year passed since the world was destroyed by the angels —— Claudia decided to set off for the Demon Continent, but she was attacked by angels on her way. After gaining the power of the divine weapon, she was able to repel the angels.

games.title: Duck Creator
games.shortDescription: Duck Creator, Create your own Duck!

games.title: Bean Stalker
games.shortDescription: Bean Stalker is a climbing action-adventure game. As a Stalker, you need to craft, loot and fight endless hordes of enemies to finally defeat the greatest one: the spirit of the tree. All of this in a procedurally generated environment with a touch of steampunk style.

games.title: Touhou ~Red Empress Devil.
games.shortDescription: 'Touhou ~Red Empress Devil.' is a bullet-hell shooting roguelike action game. Set in The Scarlet Devil Mansion, the inhabitants of Gensokyo go on a rampage!

games.title: Fireboy & Watergirl: Fairy Tales
games.shortDescription: Fireboy Watergirl are back! This time with fairies to help you!

games.title: Doll Grabber
games.shortDescription: 'Doll Grabber' is a casual puzzle game that simulates a claw machine. Players need to grab a specified number of dolls in each level. Come and challenge yourself!

games.title: Wizards and Warlords
games.shortDescription: Wizards and Warlords is an indie turn-based strategy game, where you play in a randomly generated fantasy world, contending with rival wizards, warlords, roaming marauders and hidden ancient evils. Create a customized sovereign or choose from one of many predefined templates.

games.title: Quickscoper Doge: The Dank Illuminati Memes
games.shortDescription: The illuminati have stolen that dank memes, and it's up to you, Doge, to recover them! Be careful tho m8, as PewDiePie and Dat Boi are also after the memes!

games.title: Mineko's Night Market
games.shortDescription: Mineko’s Night Market is a narrative-driven, social simulation adventure game that celebrates Japanese culture and invites players to craft whimsical items, eat delicious snacks, and ultimately enjoy all the cats.

games.title: Crisis VRigade
games.shortDescription: Crisis VRigade is a virtual reality action filled first person shooter that lets players take on the role of a SWAT trooper and deal with terrorist situations. Play solo or team with your friends with the coop multiplayer mode.

games.title: Chasing Light
games.shortDescription: 'Chasing Light' is the story of the seven days of exploring the physical properties of a game and uncovering an inner world of human beings and society. Have a weird trip!

games.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Shoot 'em Up Girls in a Dungeon?
games.shortDescription: Enjoy a free shoot'em up side-scrolling mini-game with the characters from the anime and JRPG DanMachi, and fight through stages of bullet hell and bosses!

games.title: Sudoku RPG
games.shortDescription: Sudoku RPG is a new style of game that combines Sudoku Puzzle and RPG genres. The only thing that can help a miner who has been named a hero by God's mistake is your excellent brain and concentration.

games.title: Mission in Snowdriftland - Snowlogue
games.shortDescription: Help Chubby, the fearless little snowman, with saving important artifacts from video game history! Play the first 3 levels for free in this pixel-art homage to classic 2D platformers like Super Mario.

games.title: Uninvited Guest
games.shortDescription: Uninvited Guest is a first-person psychological horror game set in 1930. You play as a villager who was destined to end up in an old mansion.

games.title: The Shape of Things
games.shortDescription: Experience a relaxing atmosphere from the comfort of your cozy room by solving small 3D puzzles inside collectible gachapons, and find the original shape of things inspired by Rubik’s style.

games.title: Hauntii
games.shortDescription: An action adventure about a ghost’s journey through the afterlife. Possess enemies and the environment and fend off hostile spirits in pursuit of starry fragments from a past life.

games.title: CAT & ONION
games.shortDescription: A short cat adventure packed with curious characters, strange environments and good vibes.​ Climb, talk, fly and smack your way to places where no cat has ever gone before!

games.title: Retro Commander
games.shortDescription: Retro Commander is a post-apocalyptic real-time strategy wargame (RTS).

games.title: Last Stop
games.shortDescription: Last Stop is a single-player third-person adventure set in present day London, where you play as three separate characters whose worlds collide in the midst of a supernatural crisis.

games.title: Puzzle - LINES AND KNOTS
games.shortDescription: Logical puzzle game for meditation. The goal of the player is to assemble a puzzle consisting of nodes. Easy to understand mechanics, swap hexagons with lines.

games.title: Wayhaven Chronicles: Book Two
games.shortDescription: Under the lights of the carnival, will romance and adventure bloom anew? The quiet town of Wayhaven is once again the center of supernatural occurrences.

games.title: Beholgar
games.shortDescription: Beholgar is a classically styled metroidvania action adventure. Explore caverns, ancient woods, and deadly castles; battle creatures and solve ancient mysteries at the kingdom.

games.title: NASCAR 21: Ignition
games.shortDescription: NASCAR 21: Ignition redefines the official video game of the world’s most popular stock car racing series. With incredible graphics and immersive gameplay, NASCAR 21: Ignition brings a whole new level of authenticity and atmosphere to the NASCAR Cup Series.

games.title: Project Demigod
games.shortDescription: Project Demigod is the ultimate superhero simulator. Stage physics-driven comic book battles in a limitless sandbox. Toss cars into ninjas with super strength, swing through cityscapes or master tactile melee weapons. You decide what type of hero to be. Who will you become?

games.title: Judero
games.shortDescription: A handmade action/adventure game based on the rich folklore of the Scottish Borders.

games.title: Last Holiday
games.shortDescription: Last Holiday is set in a picturesque North Bohemian village during the holidays in year 2000, where a good little singer seeks refuge from an angry old man. You have to take care of all your needs, such as food, drink, cigarettes, beer, girls and just about everything that goes with village life.

games.title: Zero Division
games.shortDescription: A roguelite deckbuilder crossed with a CCG, set in a dark cyberpunk world. You will lead a three-man squad against competing factions fighting among the ashes of a world-wide war. Each operator comes with a unique deck that can be customized and augmented.

games.title: Backrooms Break
games.shortDescription: Explore and break the environments of the Backrooms and Poolrooms! Utilize Thor's demolition hammer, firearms, and explosives to carve your way through the walls and entities. This isn't just another mundane walking simulator game. Now the entities are the victims. Overcome your fears with violence.

games.title: Retrowave World
games.shortDescription: Neon lights, palm trees, synthwave, chrome robot women, speeding 80s supercars... Welcome to Retrowave World!

games.title: An English Haunting
games.shortDescription: While looking for the existence of the Great Beyond, Professor Patrick Moore, aided by a fake medium, will build a device to see the other side, embark on a search for a millenary artefact, and investigate the most haunted manor of 1907 England.

games.title: Moose Miners
games.shortDescription: Take control of a mining operation run by moose. They mine and sell the gems. You need to decide where to spend the profits. Hire more miners and upgrade their gear. Buy new rails and minecarts to get deeper into the mine. The deeper you get the more valuable gems you will find.

games.title: Kofi Quest
games.shortDescription: Kofi Quest is a not-so-serious adventure that brings together mechanics from Action RPG and RTS games. You’ll control Kofi, a weak, lazy and unlucky videogame character that will be followed by a group of interesting (and pathetic) characters aiding him to live a great adventure.

games.title: HorrorVale
games.shortDescription: HorrorVale: A spooky, horror themed RPG adventure!

games.title: Tony Stewart's Sprint Car Racing
games.shortDescription: Jump into a 900 horsepower Sprint Car for some Saturday night dirt racing action! Feel the rush as you slide through the turns to take the checkered flag!

games.title: Spellbound Spire
games.shortDescription: Go on an immersive VR Journey into a magical tower in Al-Andalus filled with corruption. Progress the tower's mind-bending walkways and reality-altering moments using your magical gloves. Can you solve its mysteries and restore the peace in the tower?

games.title: Frogsong
games.shortDescription: A heartfelt adventure in a fantasy world of frogs! Talk to weird and wonderful characters, fight vicious bugs, and explore a vibrant world in this charming action RPG.

games.title: Solar System VR
games.shortDescription: An educational virtual reality journey through space. Be the first space tourist in history and explore planets and moons in our Solar System like never before. You can experience a journey to the Earth's moon, explore Mars, and even see the surface of Enceladus, one of Saturn's moons.

games.title: Time Break Chronicles
games.shortDescription: Time Break Chronicles is a fusion of classic JRPGs and modern Roguelites, with a cast of 100 playable classes to find and unlock. Build your team, customize their abilities, and venture into a procedurally generated adventure through space-time and beyond!

games.title: Exorcist Fairy

games.title: 100 hidden cupcakes
games.shortDescription: Hidden object game in the setting of a cartoon cafe. Black and white hand-drawn graphics. This is a kind game for kids.

games.title: Tide Up
games.shortDescription: Tide Up is a rather dark and gloomy adventure game. Accompany the girl in a dreamlike world of wonder. Collect the pearls scattered around the world and help the girl escape!

games.title: Mega Mall Story
games.shortDescription: Design a towering mega mall in this mall management simulation game.

games.title: Pocket City
games.shortDescription: A casual city building game. Become the mayor and create your own metropolis! Create residential, commercial, and industrial zones. Build parks and recreation spots. Respond to crime and disasters. Watch your city come alive!

games.title: DRAGON QUEST TREASURES
games.shortDescription: Erik and his sister Mia dream of the day they can explore the world. One night they encounter a pair of otherworldly creatures, Porcus and Purrsula, and are whisked away to Draconia - a land full of treasures just waiting to be discovered.

games.title: Kingsvein
games.shortDescription: Explore and reclaim the infested castle-city of Kingsvein! Ride into its depths on your trusty wyvern, and lead your customizable party of Knights and Mystics in deep tactical combat.

games.title: The Voidness - Lidar Horror Survival Game
games.shortDescription: The Voidness is a SCI-FI psychological horror game where it takes place inside the void where it's filled with just gloom - the only way to see is by scanning the environment with your range finder device, however you are not alone. Don't breathe ... as they are listening.. and watching.

games.title: Mech Builder
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Mech Builder- a relaxing puzzle game inspired by Model building(gunpla). You will experience the relaxing process of building a model kit with complete freedom with over 60+ puzzles.

games.title: Furry Angel Take In
games.shortDescription: 一款疗愈心灵的恋爱模拟文字冒险视觉小说——因为童年创伤而浑浑噩噩，早已放弃了人生的“我”，在与“从天而降”的女孩相处的甜蜜时光中，感受她不求回报的爱，收获心灵的成长，疗愈内心的创伤。与她一起探索生命的意义、爱的真谛，与灵魂的重量。

games.title: Double Kick Heroes
games.shortDescription: Butcher loads of zombies in Rhythm with Metal! Survive on the highway to hell fighting an epic freakshow! Now with 30 levels of pure madness! 19 Licensed tracks and a Community Level Editor to import your own songs!

games.title: Alien Shooter - Last Hope
games.shortDescription: New chapter in history of the legendary game, including 10 story missions.

games.title: SCP: Blackout
games.shortDescription: A VR/Desktop game where you are a new D-Class personnel in secret SCP Research Site-50 when everything falls apart. Use what you can find as you explore the facility, access logs to learn about the SCP entities in containment, and run for your life from the SCP entities that have escaped.

games.title: Apple Slash
games.shortDescription: Repel an invasion of mysterious charming creatures in a vast murky marshland. Strike your foes in a God-like slash-based manner and experience ambiguous encounters brimming with personality.

games.title: Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood
games.shortDescription: Scarlet Hood must lead a hapless Munchkin troupe through the Wicked Wood. Too bad the Black Witch, LeFaba, doesn't take too kindly to strangers gallivanting in her domain. Our fledgling witch soon realizes she's reliving the same day. Can she overcome the disaster that awaits at every turn?

games.title: Ageless
games.shortDescription: Ageless is a story driven puzzle platformer where you must alter the age of animals and plant life around you to progress. Play as Kiara, a young girl who braves through heartache and loss as she journeys across a mysterious world to discovers its secrets and herself.

games.title: Gensokyo Odyssey
games.shortDescription: Gensokyo Odyssey! A Touhou satirical visual novel where you find yourself lost in Gensokyo with only your schoolbag and an air hockey puck.

games.title: Nine-Tailed Okitsune Tale
games.shortDescription: Fluffy x Kawaii! A Japanese-style action RPG where the character changes into various forms to solve anomalies that occur in the capital!

games.title: Hot And Lovely ：Uniform
games.shortDescription: Hot And Lovely: Uniform is a classic puzzle game. Players need to eliminate more than three blocks of the same type to complete the goal and pass the level. After completing all the levels, the game is successful!

games.title: Frontline Crisis
games.shortDescription: Defend humanity's last hope, pilot a powerful mech, in Frontlines Crisis! A battlefield swarming with insects makes strategic and combat decisions crucial. Each decision will determine your fate. Defend humanity's last sanctuary, fight fiercely, and uphold human honor with wits and courage!

games.title: Space Cycle
games.shortDescription: Space resources are the battleground for warring factions. As a Space Defense Officer, protect your faction's assets in a vast, hostile universe. Allocate resources, upgrade defenses, and repel relentless enemy attacks! With over 50 unique units and deep strategy, experience real-time tower defense!

games.title: The Alliance Alive HD Remastered
games.shortDescription: Rise up and ignite the resistance in The Alliance Alive HD Remastered! Explore diverse realms, awaken new skills mid-battle, and forge alliances to challenge the Daemons that have taken over the world!

games.title: יום פתוח (Open Day)
games.shortDescription: משחק ישראלי קומי (בעברית) עם חידות, קרבות, דמויות מצחיקות והפתעות. בקרו במוסד אקדמי מטורלל עם מרצים משוגעים, טכנולוגיה הזויה, חתולים ומאפים מזמרים! זהירות, מתחת לפני השטח יש קנוניה בת שנים... האם תצליחו לצאת בחיים?

games.title: Fragsurf
games.shortDescription: Fragsurf is a dynamic blend of multiplayer first-person shooter PvP, strafing, surfing, and bunnyhop, allowing players to engage in high-speed maneuvers and combat.

games.title: Destropolis
games.shortDescription: Destropolis is a top-down shooter game with a fully destructible environment, hundreds of enemies and nuclear explosions. Fight a countless swarm of enemies. Tear them to pieces with bullets, lasers and explosions. Destroy as many of them as you can before they overwhelm you...

games.title: Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead
games.shortDescription: Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead combines the legendary and challenging puzzle gameplay of Bridge Constructor™ with the post-apocalyptic zombie universe of AMC’s The Walking Dead.

games.title: Fox! Hen! Bag!
games.shortDescription: In this short first-person adventure game, you have to bring your friends over to the other mountain by using a tramway car. But beware! Each friend has their own agenda. You have to talk to them to decide which order they should be moved in. Based on a classic riddle.

games.title: Super Catboy
games.shortDescription: Super Catboy is an action-packed platformer created in a high-bit pixel art style, combining the best elements of the golden 16-bit platformer era of the 90s with some ‘pawsome’ new mechanics! And let’s not forget; there’s plenty of CAT CONTENT!

games.title: Mad Pack
games.shortDescription: Immerse yourself in the world of dynamic battles of the Mad Pack. Get levels and abilities, cut through crowds of enemies, clear the world level by level, and fight bosses, all in the name of bloody fun.

games.title: Dating Simulator
games.shortDescription: Dating Simulator is a simulation game where you meet and interact with different people.

games.title: Security Booth: Director's Cut
games.shortDescription: The year is 1996 and you’re employed by a science lab called Nova Nexus. You work as a security guard at the front gate to the lab, inside a guard booth. However, tonight it seems something important is happening inside of Nova Nexus and things are... well... a little strange.

games.title: The Black Cat Magician
games.shortDescription: A laidback animal RPG: help Cloudy the Black Cat protect her tower!

games.title: Dream House Days DX
games.shortDescription: Make the dwelling of your dreams a reality in this apartment management sim!

games.title: Can't Live Without Electricity
games.shortDescription: Can't Live Without Electricity is a 3D relaxing puzzle game in which you supply electricity by connecting houses to power plants.

games.title: An Airport for Aliens Currently Run by Dogs
games.shortDescription: An Airport for Aliens Currently Run by Dogs is an open-world comedy adventure game. Talk to stock photo dogs. Solve their problems. Catch your flight. And call it Dog Airport Game when you get tired of saying the full title, like I did three months ago.

games.title: The Neverland of the Mountain and Sea
games.shortDescription: Falling in love!! With a robot girl (fool)!!

games.title: Isles of Limbo
games.shortDescription: Arena-based hack-and-slash combat Fight off waves of enemies with the weight of your hammer and the grace of your sword. Spellbinding Visuals A hybrid of 3D and hand-painted art styles, animated to create a breathing, if not quite living, world between worlds.

games.title: PRIM
games.shortDescription: PRIM is a creepy-but-cute point’n’click adventure game full of dark humor. When her mother dies, Prim finds out she’s Death’s daughter and now has to live with her father. But the Grim Reaper has strict rules and when Prim breaks them, things take a fatal turn. Can you breathe life into her misery?

games.title: Fractal Block World
games.shortDescription: This is a surreal exploration game. Explore a massive fractal with great complexities. You can shrink infinitely to go deeper into the fractal. Or you can become larger by growing. Inner space awaits you in this infinite world.

games.title: Time on Frog Island
games.shortDescription: Cast away on an island paradise complete with a cast of friendly frogs. Enjoy sandbox island life and explore at your own pace, solving sticky situations for your new friends and trading your way to fixing your ship!

games.title: Yamafuda! 2nd station
games.shortDescription: We created a game that can be played by anyone, using cards to hike mountains. You choose a card for each station. If you make gears along the way, you can hike more comfortably. Let's enjoy many mountains!

games.title: Vestaria Saga II: The Sacred Sword of Silvanister
games.shortDescription: Vestaria Saga II continues the adventures of Zade, bringing the tales of him and his companions to a thrilling, satisfying end. They will encounter allies both new and old while uncovering more mysteries behind the vile Margulites and their plan to plunge Vestaria into a new age of darkness.

games.title: Yggdra Union
games.shortDescription: In order to recapture her homeland, Yggdra gathers her allies and confronts the empire. 'Yggdra Union' is a tactics RPG that features three elements: the 'Union System', in which players team up with her allies to launch attacks, the exhilarating 'Clash' through army battles, and the 'Tactics Card'.

games.title: Terror At Oakheart
games.shortDescription: The renowned slasher horror films of the 1980s and 1990s serve as a source of inspiration for Terror at Oakheart. The community of Oakheart has been terrorized by Teddy, a masked serial killer. As the body count rises, you discover there is more going on here than just a man in a mask.

games.title: Garrison: Archangel
games.shortDescription: Garrison: Archangel is a fast-paced, customizable, mecha fighting game designed for epic anime style one-on-one and multiplayer team battles. Design, build and pilot your Archangels today!

games.title: Sexy Fitness Girl
games.shortDescription: 'Sexy fitness girl' is a casual elimination game. You are playing as a gym boss, conquering girls through sensuality and rationality and interacting with girls to trigger all unlocking animations and voices.

games.title: Over the Alps
games.shortDescription: Over The Alps is a choices-matter narrative adventure game told through interactive postcards, sent from a secret agent to their handler, in 1930s Switzerland.

games.title: 迷离诡夜 blurred weird night
games.shortDescription: The story mode is a supernatural interactive story, with strong Chinese characteristic scenes and plots. Will all the staff die or will most of them survive? It's like a funny horror movie, scary and funny. The zombie mode has different plots and boss. Provide DEMO download

games.title: Slobbish Dragon Princess
games.shortDescription: After discovering a strange, lizard-like being on the side of the road, things start to change for Takeru. And wouldn’t you know it, that lizard was actually the princess of the dragons! Now begins their bizarre, yet down to earth daily life.

games.title: S.O.T.A 2
games.shortDescription: S.O.T.A - Survival Online Time Anomaly is a multiplayer MMO TPS game with RPG and open world survival elements. The game takes place in an anomalous zone. The setting of the game is the Soviet local post-apocalypse.

games.title: Mirages
games.shortDescription: Mirages is a 3D narrative and horror game with folk stories. One night, seven brides headed to the Captain Mansion but strayed into a place full of ghosts - Regret City. Horror haunts the small town. Due to destiny, actors, warlords, and offspring of the town are drawn in. They are closer to truth.

games.title: Dead District: Survival
games.shortDescription: Dead District is a multiplayer and single-player survival sandbox game in an open world where the player has a wide range of options.

games.title: Escape from Grustovia
games.shortDescription: The long-awaited draft notice has arrived, and besides the window, you have only one way out - to RUN. The main thing is to get out of the apartment before the draft notice page fully loads.

games.title: Her Name Was Fire
games.shortDescription: Her Name Was Fire is a Tarotpunk twin stick roguelike where you progressively unlock spells and upgrades to defeat hordes of void creatures. Survive the 5 stages of grief and vanquish the Major Allegories.

games.title: Axis Football 2023
games.shortDescription: Axis Football is a simulation-style football game featuring the industry's best franchise mode, massive customization, and realistic gameplay.

games.title: Army Troop
games.shortDescription: Army Troop is an old-school PvP World War 2 online first-person shooter. Reminding you of the good old days World War games.

games.title: Hood Warfare
games.shortDescription: Gang violence is out of control in Detroit. The Bloods, Crips, and Vatos fight to regain control of the city. Choose your side, spin the block, and come out on top this action packed, chaotic FPS.

games.title: Decimate Drive
games.shortDescription: It's run or die in a killer car infested city. Dash from dumpster to park bench and don’t make a wrong move. Ice cream trucks, snowplows and dodgy vans all want you dead. Decimate Drive, an indie game, is terrifyingly fast-paced and drenched in atmospheric horror.

games.title: Happy Sheepies
games.shortDescription: Happy Sheepies is a relaxing sheep farming game that includes some Crafting and Business Management elements with its simple Drag Drop gameplay. Meet the needs of your sheepies, craft and sell your products, and grow your business!

games.title: World of Tennis: Roaring ’20s
games.shortDescription: World of Tennis: Roaring ’20s is a realistic tennis game featuring global multiplayer and tactical gameplay across a variety of incredible, life-like locations – all set in the roaring ’20s!

games.title: Girls! Girls! Girls!?
games.shortDescription: Welcome to 'Girls! Girls! Girls!?' cafe, where charming cross-dressing 'girls' navigate love, life, and laughter. As the new manager, make lasting decisions, explore intricate and explicit relationships with each character, and discover multiple endings in a story where every choice matters.

games.title: Endless Furry Killer 2020
games.shortDescription: Endless Furry Killer 2020 is the game that lets you kill furries endlessly! Shoot furries in a endless 2D top down action packed adventure! Fun for the whole family!

games.title: Astatos
games.shortDescription: Leave your influence in your wake as you bring together a broken land in a card-battling adventure filled with gods, heroes, and the instability of yourself and those around you. Play the story, or go online with fellow Crown Mages for tabletop card action.

games.title: Zoeti
games.shortDescription: Zoeti is a turn-based roguelite that features a deck of playing cards used to create card combos and activate skills in the heat of battle. Bolster your arsenal of skills through battles, discoverable upgrades, or aid from the locals which enhance your plays to overcome the evil plaguing your land.

games.title: Ruff Night At The Gallery
games.shortDescription: Ruff Night At The Gallery is an adorable short-form horror masterpiece featuring art, dogs, and spooky ghosts. Explore the gallery, find some keys, and admire the artwork...just don’t get licked!

games.title: Galactic Glitch
games.shortDescription: Galactic Glitch is a physics-based roguelike shooter. Throw rocks, mines, missiles, and even the enemies themselves! Rip them apart for improvised shields or use their energy cores as explosive ammunition. In this universe, your ability to manipulate objects is the key to your survival.

games.title: A Musical Story
games.shortDescription: ‘A Musical Story’ is a rhythm game set against a 70s backdrop. Explore the memories of Gabriel, a young man trying to come to terms with his situation through the connections to his musical memory.

games.title: Recursive Ruin
games.shortDescription: A story rich narrative puzzle game in which an artist comes to terms with their grief. Explore an infinitely recursive world of strange fractal beauty and solve mind-bending puzzles. Confront the ineffable and chat with your cat in a search for meaning and hope.

games.title: Doomsday Paradise
games.shortDescription: Can you get a date before the end of the world? Doomsday Paradise is a goofy, multiplayer dating sim about finding love before the apocalypse. With over 130 different endings and 12 different singles to woo- no two games will ever be the same.

games.title: ScrewUp
games.shortDescription: Screwup 1.0 The update includes new features such as a new combat system, official server system, exploring new islands by ship, NPC trading, and rare item trading. There are also new hunting and pet systems, as well as many other features that will be added in future updates.

games.title: Rush Rally Origins
games.shortDescription: The definitive top down racer

games.title: Bash the Teacher! - Classroom Clicker
games.shortDescription: It's time to show the teacher who is the real boss of the classroom in this hilarious idle-clicker game! Click away to blast the teacher with your chosen weapon - watch as the teacher’s frustration grows and discover their funny reactions!

games.title: 1BITDRAGON
games.shortDescription: Anyone can make music! 1BITDRAGON is a music creation software super easy to use, instant and fun.

games.title: Voidwrought
games.shortDescription: Voidwrought is a 2D action-platformer set in a hand-drawn world of cosmic horrors. Explore the thawing ruins of the First Civilisation and strike down the gods that dwell there. Grow your powers, uncover ancient artifacts, and expand your shrine amid the wreckage.

games.title: AMID EVIL VR
games.shortDescription: A retro FPS for the ages! Completely rebuilt from the ground up for VR! Once branded a HERETIC. Now YOU have been chosen as our champion! Reclaim our sacred weapons. Take back our ancient lands. If you can stand... AMID EVIL.

games.title: DEATH IN UNISON
games.shortDescription: Survive the world's deadliest psychopaths. Experience a unique 2-player co-op experience that puts your teamwork and communication to the test. Complete your duties alone or with a partner in a prison like no other.

games.title: JUSTICE SUCKS: Tactical Vacuum Action
games.shortDescription: JUSTICE SUCKS is a stealth/action game about a killer robot vacuum cleaner on a quest for vengeance through a 90s TV universe. Stalk your prey, hack smart devices, turn them into deadly traps and consume the blood of your enemies to unleash devastating powers.

games.title: Franchise Hockey Manager 7
