games.shortDescription: Film and produce 1999's hottest reality TV show: The Crush House! Select a crush-worthy cast, satisfy voracious audiences and keep the show on air to uncover the sinister secrets behind this darkly comic thirst-person shooter.

games.title: 14 Minesweeper Variants 2
games.shortDescription: Minesweeper but the rules are changing, again.

games.title: Christmas Nightmare
games.shortDescription: Christmas Nightmare is an atmospheric horror game about New Year's Eve.

games.title: Baisu
games.shortDescription: Step into the shoes of Detective Clay Kriest in 'Baisu,' a chilling tale of family, art, and the haunting unknown. As you arrive at the secluded residence of Maple Street 22, responding to an eerie call for help, you'll find yourself immersed in a quest shrouded in darkness.

games.title: Muv-Luv photonmelodies♮
games.shortDescription: Fall in Luv all over again! Familiar faces and worlds collide in three massive new adventures, including the long-awaited follow-up to Muv-Luv Alternative!

games.title: Signs of the Sojourner
games.shortDescription: In this narrative card game about relationships and communication, navigate conversations in a colorful world reminiscent of our own. Learn and grow through the cards you choose to play. Who will you become? What will you leave behind?

games.title: Mad Streets
games.shortDescription: Mad Streets is a hilarious multiplayer party game with an emphasis on brutal yet comical fist fighting throughout a multitude of modes, local and online, where players battle it out in wild physics driven chaos to determine who is the baddest player in town!

games.title: 3D Math - Ultra
games.shortDescription: Mathematic Ultra - is both simple and complex challenges!

games.title: YAKIMOCHI STREAM
games.shortDescription: 『ヤキモチストリーム』は、まどそふとより発売された学園コメディーアドベンチャーゲームです。本作はまどそふとの2作目にあたる作品で、とても人気が高く、発売当初日本萌えゲーアワード2014にて金賞・プロモーション賞を受賞しました。

games.title: Verne: The Shape of Fantasy
games.shortDescription: Become Jules Verne and adventure into the dangers that hide in Hemera, a fantastic parallel world built from his own imagination. Explore, solve puzzles and unlock the most coveted secret of the mighty Atlantis.

games.title: Sunset Drive 1986
games.shortDescription: Sunset Drive 1986 is a solo developer game with 80s retro style arcade driving game and an endless highway. You can either have a relaxing experience and enjoy the chill music, or you can upgrade your cars to break speed records while completing missions.

games.title: Toast Defense
games.shortDescription: Ducks are after your toast! Setup various water guns in this fun tower defense game to shoo away the ducks so they don't steal your precious toast. You choose how many flocks of ducks come for your toast each wave, the greater the risk the greater the reward!

games.title: Drift King
games.shortDescription: Grab your favorite car, tune it, challenge players in Online Drift battles and become a DRIFT KING!

games.title: First Dwarf
games.shortDescription: If there’s one thing dwarves are better at than grooming their beards, it's engineering. Jump into your mech, build a base and explore the crumbled fantasy world in this immersive action RPG. Will you manage to survive its dangers?

games.title: Regular Factory: Escape Room
games.shortDescription: You don't work in a regular assembly line. In this escape room, you will investigate what is really being manufactured in a secret factory, explore mysterious places and solve puzzles. Will you discover the truth?

games.title: Neko Maid
games.shortDescription: Every neko girl loves cleanliness, wants to clean and take care of a master. And every certain maid has a secret — someone loves to be photographed in the master's mirror, the other loves to escape to the beach during a coffee break ...

games.title: Robber Knight
games.shortDescription: RPG/Strategy. Lead your army through intense battles, make decisions that influence the story, and conquer vast lands. Play solo or fight side by side with up to 4 friends.

games.title: Golden Lap
games.shortDescription: Step into the polished shoes of a racing team manager in the heart-stirring Golden Era of motorsport where every decision can lead to glory or gravel. With sleek minimalist charm and deep strategic gameplay, Golden Lap offers a unique experience in the motorsport management genre.

games.title: Drawing From Memory
games.shortDescription: Drawing from Memory is an online party game where 2-4 friends try to figure out what your most and least favorite characters look like by Drawing them from Memory.

games.title: NecroAttack！
games.shortDescription: Armies of zombies are coming! The Edgar Kingdom is teetering on the brink of collapse! Young Edgar Princess stands out and leads her subjects to defeat enemies. Follow the story of the princess to explore uncharted land, and might unravel the mysteries behind such disaster?

games.title: Etaine: Magic Survivor / 伊泰恩：魔法幸存者
games.shortDescription: Etaine: Magic Survivor is a top-down arena shooter survival roguelite game. You can construct your skill set through spell, artifacts, talents and tarot cards. Become mage of unbreakable or fatal, it's your choice! Will you be able to survive when you against the thousands of monsters？

games.title: Mad Smartphone Tycoon
games.shortDescription: Build Your smartphone Empire in Mad Smartphone Tycoon, your main goal in this game is to create the ultimate smartphone that combines both performance and aesthetics. Expand your company, dominate the global market, become a tycoon in the world of mobile phones!

games.title: Ignis Universia: Eternal Sisters Saga DX
games.shortDescription: A short game with a long name. Mashes up JRPG battles with Visual Novel storytelling. Not entirely serious.

games.title: SpellMaster: The Saga
games.shortDescription: SpellMaster - The Saga is a story-driving action RPG inspired by the Gothic series. Gameplay takes place in an open, seamless world filled with secrets, mysteries, terrible monsters, and varied NPCs. Who to be and how to behave is yours to choose - this is your Saga

games.title: Mail Mole + 'Xpress Deliveries
games.shortDescription: Mail Mole is a charming 3D platformer featuring Molty, the fastest delivery mole, in his quest to save Carrotland from disaster! Explore magical worlds, make new friends, race against Mecha-Moles, find collectibles, solve puzzles and deliver awesomeness to the end of the world!

games.title: Lost Potato
games.shortDescription: Lost Potato is a minimalistic top-down roguelite where you can't damage enemies directly. Push them into spikes, reflect bullets and help a young potato find its way out of a jungle filled with man-eating tribes!

games.title: Santa Claus in Trouble (HD)
games.shortDescription: Help Santa to collect lost christmas presents in this wonderful 3D Jump'n'Run experience. An exciting arcade adventure is just waiting for the kids in your life and especially the kid in you!

games.title: 3 Minute Heroes
games.shortDescription: 3 Minute Heroes is a real-time strategy game that combines tower defense, deck building, and rogue-like genres. Place your champions, use cards, and keep your home safe for 3 minutes!

games.title: Trailer Shop Simulator
games.shortDescription: Being on the run from the mafia for more than 10 years, you managed to hide for a while in a cozy sunny town. Develop, buy weapons, engage in all available types of business to eventually protect yourself from a large criminal organization.

games.title: Kittens and Yarn
games.shortDescription: Move the pieces of place and untangle the wool yarn for these cute kittens.

games.title: The Wreck
games.shortDescription: In this 3D visual novel, follow failed screenwriter Junon as she attempts to make it through the most pivotal day in her life. Relive the past, alter the present, and embrace the future, or without your help, Junon’s story might end in a wreck.

games.title: Devil's Dungeon
games.shortDescription: Heroes and girls come to the Devil Lord's Dungeon. Can they defeat the Devil Lord or be captured and become slaves? Devil's Dungeon is a real-time strategy game. The game centers on creating mazes and monsters to help defend the Devil Lord from heroes seeking to destroy him.

games.title: Ballance
games.shortDescription: In this 2004 classic originally released by Atari games, you will navigate 12 sky-high courses. Each course is fraught with different obstacles that will block your path, slide your marble off course, or blow them right into the bottomless void below.

games.title: Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenwood
games.shortDescription: Dive into 'Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenwood', an engaging hidden object game brimming with elusive cats, interactive elements, and captivating mini-stories. Venture beyond whiskers in a world rich with surprises and discover the wonders of Kittenwood!

games.title: Joyville
games.shortDescription: Joyville is a horror-puzzle adventure game set in an abandoned children's camp. Brace yourself for a gripping journey through the shadows, solving puzzles, and trying to survive amidst the hidden horrors that await you.

games.title: imomushi
games.shortDescription: This is not 'The Great Adventure of the Cute Caterpillar.'

games.title: Machinika: Atlas
games.shortDescription: Machinika: Atlas is an indie puzzle game and is the direct sequel to Machinika: Museum, you play as a museum researcher who just land on Atlas. Will you unravel the mysteries of the alien vessel? Solve cryptic puzzles to find out what happened!

games.title: AWAY: The Survival Series
games.shortDescription: In this story-based adventure, play as a tiny sugar glider in your very own nature documentary. Glide among the trees, fight dangerous predators, and explore beautiful environments as you embark on a high-flying journey to save your family.

games.title: AshenForest
games.shortDescription: AshenForest is a roguelite action RPG focused on boss-rush. To purify the ashen forest that is causing the plague, you must fight against all the monsters lurking in the forest.

games.title: Puddle Knights
games.shortDescription: Protecting nobles from mud may look simple on the surface, but the intricate cape arranging puzzle mechanics ensure steadily increasing difficulty. Join the Knights on their quest to preserve dignity, and mindmuck is practically guaranteed! Playtime 10-35h.

games.title: Tour de France 2020
games.shortDescription: Compete against the peloton in all 21 stages of the Tour de France in the official game! To wear the yellow jersey, you will need to take risks, attack, sprint and perfect your race tactics. Challenge your friends in Downhill or Sprint Challenge mode!

games.title: Fast Food Manager
games.shortDescription: Launch your own business from scratch! Starting with a small coffee booth, build the most popular food service chain in town. Experiment, develop, make a profit.

games.title: Wantless : Solace at World’s End
games.shortDescription: In this dystopic sci-fi Tactical RPG, save your patients from themselves. Craft your skills among millions of combinations, heal the mind and face ever growing nightmares in 10mn runs. Will you overcome the insidious being chasing you across minds?

games.title: Mysteries Under Lake Ophelia
games.shortDescription: Relax, and fish in a very strange lake.

games.title: Worlds of Aria
games.shortDescription: Lead your own DnD-like adventuring party on an epic adventure narrated by Laura Bailey. Invite your friends for free to the group with the Friends Pass, or strike out on your own. Cooperation, betrayal, and the luck of the dice… what wild escapades will you and your teammates get up to?

games.title: Orebound
games.shortDescription: Journey on a quest to find the Emberstone. Lost in the depths of time. The king has tasked you to find it buried in the mountains. Dig deep and automate mining in the mountains before you. Craft, discover runes, send precious metals and gems back to your kingdom. Grow, mine and find the Emberstone.

games.title: Wait! Life is beautiful!
games.shortDescription: W!LiB! is an interactive psychological thriller about suicide, based on personal experience. This is a story about a void in the soul, about search and loss of the life purpose in trying to save oneself and others. This is a life that can be lived your own way. For any life is beautiful... isn’t it?

games.title: Furious Seas
games.shortDescription: Furious Seas puts you in command as captain of a deadly pirate ship. Navigate through treacherous waters and blast apart fearsome enemy fleets in this thrilling VR adventure like no other. Carve out your legend today amidst the Furious Seas.

games.title: Aron's Adventure
games.shortDescription: Aron's Adventure is an Action Adventure RPG that takes place in a fantasy world called Elor. An ancient evil re-awakens and the fate of the land is thrown into Aron's hands. Aron will have to unite the people all while learning how to use his new abilities.

games.title: Tesla Force
games.shortDescription: With science as your super power, charge up your coils and zap into action! Tesla Force is a rogue-lite top-down shooter featuring endless procedural gameplay with tentacle splitting action. Play as Tesla, Curie, Lovecraft and Shelley and blast the cosmic horror back into the galactic abyss!

games.title: HEAT REBORN
games.shortDescription: HEAT REBORN is a free massively multiplayer online first-person shooter. Completely re-created the original HEAT PROJECT with modern game engine. Brings you the improvement of graphics, game balance, and even with numbers of new game mode for you!

games.title: College Bowl
games.shortDescription: College Bowl is a beautifully pixelated on-field simulation of American Football! Challenge college rivals on your way to winning a National title! Take on various game modes, including a deep Dynasty mode with in-depth recruiting, scouting, stat tracking, ranking, bowl games, yearly goals and more!

games.title: Assembly Planter
games.shortDescription: A farming / automation game, that allows you to progress from a poor hard-working farmer with just a few old tools to a lazy rich guy that watches his machines do the work for him while he tries to optimize production.

games.title: Three Kingdom: The Journey
games.shortDescription: Craft a legendary deck and lead your troops to protect the Kingdom for the glory of the Han Dynasty in this fast-paced deck-building strategy roguelike. The Kingdom is on the verge of disaster against the Yellow Turbans rebellion, and only you – and your skills as a general – stand in their way!

games.title: Golazo! Soccer League
games.shortDescription: Golazo is a dynamic arcade football game with a medium-sized fields, no fouls and offsides whistled. Just pure fun!

games.title: Fantasy Tavern Sextet -Vol.2 Adventurer's Days-
games.shortDescription: The 2nd part of a 3 part series! A run-of-the-mill guy who got transported to a fantasy world joins a witch and a lady knight together in battle?! Will he live to tell the tale?! And he has an unexpected reunion?! The 2nd chapter of the harem love-comedy in a fantasy world tavern available now!

games.title: Base One
games.shortDescription: Base One is a space base builder game where you take control of a network of space stations and its crew's tasks and wellbeing. Maintain your resources and defenses as you navigate the wide array of dangers ahead of you!

games.title: Firegirl: Hack 'n Splash Rescue DX
games.shortDescription: Take on the role of a young rescue officer starting her career. Armed with a trusty axe and high-pressure fire hose that also acts like a jetpack, Firegirl responds to emergency calls across the city. Can Firegirl save all the trapped civilians caught in each blaze?

games.title: Yummy Girl
games.shortDescription: The girls are very hungry, feed them, they are waiting for you.

games.title: Hot Springs Story
games.shortDescription: Build and manage the ultimate Japanese hot springs inn.

games.title: Nightmare: The Lunatic
games.shortDescription: Nightmare: The Lunatic is a parrying action rogue-lite platformer game about escaping a nightmare. Constantly swap between 3 weapons, use special attacks, and avoid and parry enemy attacks. Strengthen yourself by collecting powerful and unique totems.

games.title: Forgotten Realms: The Archives - Collection One
games.shortDescription: The Forgotten Realms Archive - Collection One allows you to journey through the set of adventures: the Eye of the Beholder trilogy, a collection of first-person, real-time role-playing games.

games.title: Neighbor Fight
games.shortDescription: Multiplayer first person strategy game with lots of destruction. Destroy the house of your neighbor by throwing furniture and build a business by selling weed!

games.title: RWBY: Arrowfell
games.shortDescription: Dive into an explosive new RWBY adventure! Instantly switch between Ruby, Weiss, Blake, and Yang, and use their weapons and Semblances to battle a mysterious new threat in this in-canon story set during RWBY Volume 7! Featuring a new song by Jeff Williams with vocals by Casey Lee Williams!

games.title: Regency Solitaire II
games.shortDescription: Revisit romantic Regency Britain to build a glorious garden, in this charming solitaire sequel. Tour historic hotspots, silence gossips, and host the season’s most anticipated soiree. Play your cards right to unlock bonus levels and a love story. Don't miss the party everyone's talking about!

games.title: Iron Marines Invasion
games.shortDescription: Prepare to take off, soldier! The galaxy needs your strategy! Prove your RTS expertise, explore an entire galaxy and defend it from a threatening invasion.

games.title: Fruitbus
games.shortDescription: A journey of flavors and friendships awaits you in your cozy, customisable food truck! Forage for fresh ingredients to create your own menu, then feed tummies and souls with home-cooked meals. Change the world, one apple at a time.

games.title: Arcana Alchemia
games.shortDescription: 《炼爱秘仪》是由日本知名美少女游戏品牌Lump of Sugar（方糖社）制作的奇幻恋爱题材作品。本作由萌木原文武担当原画与角色设计，由业内多位剧本家携手担当剧本，人气声优天知遥、步莎拉领衔为本作女主角献声。曾荣获萌系游戏大赏年度声音金奖以及月间奖。

games.title: Angry Penguin
games.shortDescription: hard platformer with a penguin, and it's probably a good game for youtube and twitch (do not insult my mother while playing pls)

games.title: The Apocalypse Sacrifice
games.shortDescription: As an adventurer, you have unintentionally uncovered a horrifying secret hidden in the town for years. Every choice you make will shape the story and become part of your personality test. Will you be the hero who saves the villagers, or will you sacrifice them to create your own legend?

games.title: Rogue System
games.shortDescription: Our goal is to depict the possibilities of space exploration combat within a realistic environment- to emphasize the 'science' in science-fiction. Key features to include: proper orbital mechanics for all objects in space, detailed ship system control, functionality, inter-dependency damage reaction.

games.title: Serious Sam: Tormental
games.shortDescription: Serious Sam: Tormental is a 3D rogue-lite top-down shooter where you blast your way through the tormented mind of demigod of destruction Mental, as he imagines worlds and monsters that stand on your path towards his inner ego. Let the showdown begin!

games.title: Melon Journey: Bittersweet Memories
games.shortDescription: Melon Journey: Bittersweet Memories is a story-exploration game about getting caught up in the outlandish happenings of a small town where melons are illegal. Silly and cute on the surface, but are things really as peaceful as they seem?

games.title: Farmtale
games.shortDescription: Build your farm from one chicken and explore the world as you progress. Buy animals, harvest crops, hire workers for management, and advance through unique buildings, quests, upgrades, and items in the ultimate idle clicker hybrid!

games.title: Creature Lab
games.shortDescription: Become a mad scientist! Conduct crazy experiments, mix mutagens, breed abominable creatures, and attach monstrous body parts to them. Manage your inventory, expand your lab, and make sure your hideout is safe. Send your creations into the city to obtain salvage and test subjects!

games.title: RealFlight Trainer Edition
games.shortDescription: RealFlight Trainer Edition is the perfect way to learn radio control flying on your PC. With 7 aircraft from Horizon Hobby and flying lessons from experienced RC pilots, you'll be ready to solo in no time. When you're ready, an upgrade to RealFlight Evolution is also available.

games.title: Nemesis: Distress
games.shortDescription: NEMESIS DISTRESS is a unique multiplayer Sci-Fi horror experience that aims at creating unforgettable, cinematic moments. Remember – this is NOT a shooter, in Nemesis you are not the hunter. You are the PREY.

games.title: Kazakh Drive
games.shortDescription: You're a simple Kazakh driver. Take a trip along the highway that cuts through the gloomy landscapes of Central Asia full of Eastern wisdom. And be careful.

games.title: Setteeh
games.shortDescription: Setteeh - is a horror game created based on real stories of Yakutia residents. Each episode of the game tells a new story.

games.title: LumbearJack
games.shortDescription: Grab your axe and save the environment by chopping and recycling every man-made thing in your path and solving puzzles with your charming animal friends!

games.title: AI Drone Simulator
games.shortDescription: AI Drone Simulator is an FPV drone simulator. Huge, dynamic environments. Virtual copy of your own drone. Total customization for maximum pilot power. Community sharing of drones, maps and tracks !

games.title: Berserk Mode
games.shortDescription: Berserk Mode is a visceral time-attack fantasy rogue-lite. Become the Berserker and wade into a dungeon battlefield swarming with monsters. Unleash the absurd power of your Beast in a storm of blood and gibs. Prepare to enter Berserk Mode.

games.title: Bail or Jail(OBAKEIDORO!)
games.shortDescription: A 3 minute tag-battle with extra twists! Play as a Monster who must lock everyone into jail before time runs out, or as a Human who must avoid capture and bail their teammates out of trouble. Invite your friends and family to play this speedy game of cat and mouse - or rather, Monsters and Humans!

games.title: Arkanoid - Eternal Battle
games.shortDescription: Discover or re-discover, the emblematic block breaker game in a fully modernized version! Classic elements from the franchise will definitely make a comeback, with a brand-new look, new rules, as well as new effects, bonuses and features!

games.title: HG Adventure
games.shortDescription: You suddenly enter a whole new world empty-handed. Start a whole new adventure all your own. Farming, fishing, building, cooking, alchemy and living a quiet life. Or is it fighting monsters, learning skills, building equipment and discovering the world's hidden secrets? Or maybe I want them all.

games.title: Doomed to Hell
games.shortDescription: Doomed to Hell is a roguelike-like top-down shooter where you play as Rose, a human in hell who will need to fight all of its monsters in waves of enemies, defeat bosses, and get new weapons to earn back his life on earth.

games.title: YiYi
games.shortDescription: You are 'GUI', you have come to a city of eternal night, to find your soul to dream of 'Yi Yi'.

games.title: Genopanic
games.shortDescription: Genopanic is a pixel-art, Metroidvania-inspired adventure-platformer. Explore corridors of the space station, teeming with secrets and dangers, and engage in boss fights. Solve puzzles and uncover hidden mysteries in the dark atmosphere of a sci-fi research complex. Discover the truth with each step

games.title: Clock Tower: Rewind
games.shortDescription: The 16-bit nightmare returns. Survive, hide, and avoid the deadly Scissorman in this legendary horror classic.

games.title: The Hand of Glory
games.shortDescription: The challenge of a dangerous serial killer plummets detective Lazarus Bundy’s career into a chasm with no way out. In a desperate attempt at a comeback, Lazarus decides to secretly investigate the disappearance of Kathrin Mulzberg.

games.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Infinite Combate
games.shortDescription: Experience the anime from DanMachi. Follow the story from the beginning and discover new content in the game! Enter the world of Orario, where gods live amongst humans and protect them in their Familia - become the greatest adventurer through dungeon-crawling, real-time RPG combat and date events!

games.title: Deep Despair
games.shortDescription: Deep Despair is a Minecraft-style survival sandbox. Travel, collect resources, craft items, dig, build, grow crops and survive. Freedom of action is limited only by your imagination!

games.title: Dirge
games.shortDescription: Band together with up to 4 friends to confront paranormal monsters. One player can take on the monster role to hunt the investigators. To win the game, you must survive long enough to accomplish all of the tasks to defeat the monsters. Step out of the shadows, no more running hiding. Fight back!

games.title: TunTown
games.shortDescription: ***** This Game is only abailable in Chinese*****卡通風格的RPG遊戲，玩家扮演主角樂樂，地點在木桶鎮，帶領著自己的夥伴們聯手對抗各種威脅小鎮的勢力，解決神秘事件。

games.title: Vacuum Pilot
games.shortDescription: Vacuum Pilot is a 2D speedrunning game with easy to learn but hard to master controls based on mouse movement.

games.title: Best Forklift Operator
games.shortDescription: Welcome to the world of warehouses, transport, and forklifts. Join us and show that you deserve to be called the best forklift operator.

games.title: Ninki Seiyuu: How to Make a Pop Voice Actress
games.shortDescription: A love comedy set in the voice acting industry, from the point of view of voice actresses, managers, and sound engineers... and it's, like, 78% accurate! Play it, and you might find out what this industry is all about!

games.title: Dreamin' Her - 僕は、彼女の夢を見る。-
games.shortDescription: From the creators of Seven Days and LOST:SMILE, LIFE0 presents their third game: 「Dreamin' Her」. In his dreams, the ideal girlfriend appears taking the form of his childhood friend. Is she really just a dream, or is she something more?

games.title: The Symbiant Re:Union
games.shortDescription: Take a deep dive into Danya’s and Brahve’s heat and romance in The Symbiant Re:Union. The events take place after two Endings of The Symbiant’s main game.

games.title: Star Sonata 2
games.shortDescription: Star Sonata 2 is a space sandbox MMO that combines elements of action, RPG, and empire creation into a truly unique MMO. Explore the sandbox style universe, build persistent bases, construct trade ships, and even fight your way to the top and claim the Emperor’s Throne!

games.title: River City Saga: Three Kingdoms
games.shortDescription: Kunio, the beloved hot-blooded renegade, is back to wreak havoc in the world of the Three Kingdoms! The characters take on the roles of famous generals for a game packed with wild action.

games.title: Obsurity
games.shortDescription: Discover all the secrets of two completely different worlds.

games.title: Duck Life: Retro Pack
games.shortDescription: Play the 3 classic Duck Life Flash games like you've never seen them before!

games.title: Heroes of the Three Kingdoms 5
games.shortDescription: 《三国群英传Ⅴ》是由宇峻奥汀研发的一款即时战略类游戏，也是三国群英传系列的第五部作品 。 玩家在游戏中将扮演三国时期的君主，调兵遣将、攻城掠池。画面清晰度全面升级至1024*768分辨率，并实现千人同屏的超大型战役。

games.title: CALL OF LDPR
games.shortDescription: I was an ordinary kid from Egorievsk and my life was going bad. But everything changed one fine moment, when my mate, nicknamed Ponos and i, were sucking beer on the bars. LDPR branch was opened in our yard.I also decided that since I can't do anything except jerk off, it's time to go into politics.

games.title: Flåklypa Grand Prix
games.shortDescription: Immerse yourself in the world of Flåklypa in this game for the whole family. Play nine mini games, enjoy the classic story and take it to the tracks for high-octane racing, alone or with a friend in split-screen. But watch out, your competitors will use dirty tricks to win – and so can you!

games.title: Diablo The Abyss
games.shortDescription: Diablo The Abyss is a strategic RPG full of random and roguelike elements. Within this randomized world, you can freely make strageties at your own pace and conquer formidable challenges, while shaping your unique adventure journey.

games.title: DesktopMMD4:Born to Dance
games.shortDescription: The fourth generation of DesktopMMD born to dance,Brand new Theater-Mode, Fully supports using of MMD's VMD format dance motion file and PMX/PMD models directly , It's never been easier for MMD models to dance on your desktop. Support MMD's physics engine, Support STEAM workshop.

games.title: VIDEOVERSE
games.shortDescription: Relive the days of the early internet and dive into this fictional video game era, where the 'Kinmoku Shark’ gaming system and its online social network 'Videoverse' were still popular…

games.title: The Land Beneath Us
games.shortDescription: The Land Beneath Us: A turn-based rogue-lite dungeon crawler rooted in Welsh mythology. Unleash skill combos and wield stylish weaponry in Annwn's Underworld. Conquer the Seven Lords, save The Creator, and retrieve vital Soul-Tech.

games.title: Hero Tale
games.shortDescription: Explore medieval fantasy island in idle RPG with rogue-like elements. Grind to gain experience, train your skills and fight more and more difficult enemies to unlock new maps and drop best loot. Strategize your growth when choosing your path on massive skill tree.

games.title: Nonsensical Video Generator
games.shortDescription: Nonsensical Video Generator is an automated video production software designed to let anyone create humorous videos at ease. Unleash your creativity by tinkering with parameters and importing media!

games.title: PegIdle
games.shortDescription: PegIdle is a Pachinko idle game! Aim and shoot your balls to clear all the pegs on the board. Recieve gold by hitting the golden pegs or by landing balls into the moving bucket. Purchasing auto ball drop will automaticly drop balls onto the board. Spend your gold on new balls and ball upgrades!

games.title: Skater Frog
games.shortDescription: He was a skater frog, she said see ya later dog.

games.title: Shelter Manager
games.shortDescription: We live in a troubled world. Viruses, military conflicts - you never know what danger the world will face tomorrow. It's time to get ready now! Lead a bunker network and start developing society after a global disaster.

games.title: SOLAS 128
games.shortDescription: Explore SOLAS 128, a game of interconnected puzzles where you redirect and reconfigure rhythmic pulses of light to breathe life back into an ancient machine. BAFTA Scotland Game Winner.

games.title: Princess Farmer
games.shortDescription: Be the magical bunny farmer you've always wanted to be! Princess Farmer is a charming visual-novel meets match-3 gameplay, with a host of adorable characters to befriend, mysteries to solve, and fashion to collect. Smash rocks! Make combos! Win hearts!

games.title: Battle Bands: Rock & Roll Deckbuilder
games.shortDescription: Get the band together and take on the world in this battle of the bands, deckbuilding card game set in the fantasy land of Riff City. Play solo or with friends to conquer competitive real-time tournaments or offbeat bosses in a coop campaign. Wits and a sick riff are key to becoming a rock legend.

games.title: SCP: The Foundation
games.shortDescription: An everyday, routine assembly takes a rather dark turn amidst some rumours of a containment breach...

games.title: The Tartarus Key
games.shortDescription: There’s no way out for Alex Young who wakes up to find herself locked in a strange mansion filled with puzzles, traps, and cameras following her every move. Whether she and her companions live or die, and find the truth behind their abduction, is up to you in this first-person mystery thriller.

games.title: Doctor Who: The Edge of Reality
games.shortDescription: Experience an unforgettable adventure in space and time. Explore new worlds, face Daleks, Cybermen and Weeping Angels and join two Doctors on an epic quest to save the universe from an unstoppable new threat in this first-person narrative adventure.

games.title: Rabbit Hole
games.shortDescription: An ancient evil has descended upon the rural town of Rabbit Hole. Now Shaun Turner not only has to untangle a twisted web of supernatural events and mysteries to save his family but also escape from the hellish remains of his hometown.

games.title: The Harem Life of Peerless Swordsmen
games.shortDescription: Nick wants to become more handsome and powerful. On his journey to become stronger, he meets the righteous Leslie, the powerful and beautiful Josephine, and the extraordinarily charismatic Pandora, embarking on a blissful harem life~.

games.title: Parkour Tag
games.shortDescription: Parkour Tag is a platforming PvP game that faces two-players off in a competitive game of movement. Run vertically or horizontally on any wall, jump, double jump, slide, vault and more to outmaneuver your opponent and claim victory!

games.title: Frigore
games.shortDescription: Frigore takes place in 1995.An indie survival RPG horror game. Simple gameplay, beautiful graphics , dark and chilling atmosphere.

games.title: Beat Invaders
games.shortDescription: Beat Invaders is a Vertical Shoot 'Em Up Roguelite - Fight your way through enemy fleets, unlock skills, items, ships, and upgrade them in the next run. Enjoy the smooth neon visuals matching the pushing EDM soundtrack - The perfect game to unwind.

games.title: Etrian Odyssey II HD
games.shortDescription: Take off to the skies for High Lagaard, a mysterious castle beyond the clouds. Assemble a team of heroes, seek the mystery of the colossal Yggdrasil tree and uncover the truth of the city!

games.title: Forgotten Realms: The Archives - Collection Two
games.shortDescription: The Forgotten Realm Archives - Collection Two brings a healthy mix of “Gold Box” and nostalgia goodness to your PC, along with a combination of adventure builders, turn-based and real-time role-playing gameplay.

games.title: Field of Glory: Kingdoms
games.shortDescription: Politics, religion, war. They are nothing without a legacy that can stand the test of time. Lead any nation, and turn it into a mighty kingdom in one of the most compelling grand strategy games ever created.

games.title: Eyes of War
games.shortDescription: Eyes of War is a real-time strategy game set in the medieval era, offering both single-player and multiplayer experiences where you can control every unit in character mode. Build your castle, lead your army, and dominate the map. Eyes of War invites you to epic battles of the medieval era!

games.title: Fairy Biography4 : Affair
games.shortDescription: Fairy Biography4 : Affair is a casual strategy game with elements of oriental mythology. It still continues the unique world view of the series, bringing you a fantasy world where ancient and modern intersect.

games.title: Sheryl ~The Alchemist of the Island Ruins~
games.shortDescription: Sheryl, a novice alchemist, works with her boss and fellow alchemist, Debora. But when Debora skips out to avoid debt collectors, it's up to Sheryl to keep the atelier afloat, lest it collapse under the weight of her boss's mistakes!

games.title: POOOOL
games.shortDescription: POOOOL is a small, pool-inspired physics puzzler where you combine balls of similar sizes to create even bigger ones, all while trying to save room for more. Chase your hi-score, share scores with friends, and master your flinging skills!

games.title: Critadel
games.shortDescription: Critadel is a futuristic platform/shooter/roguelike with three playable characters, hundreds of branching paths and over 100,000 unique weapon configurations!

games.title: Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition
games.shortDescription: Dracula is ready to take over Europe and only four iconic vampire hunters can stop him, in this digital adaptation of the classic board game of deduction and gothic horror. Play locally with friends or with up to five players online. Will you be the hunter or the hunted?

games.title: hallucination - 幻觉
games.shortDescription: Sequel of Old Watch

games.title: White Hell
games.shortDescription: White Hell is a retro-style first-person shooter set in a frost-bound Finland after the apocalypse.

games.title: Tennis Manager 2021
games.shortDescription: Do you have what it takes to become the greatest tennis manager? Enter your academy, manage your team, plan your training, schedule your tournaments, change your game plans and discover the new young guns. Take the reins, make the right decisions, become the very best!

games.title: Tanks in Labyrinth
games.shortDescription: Destroy other tanks, use bonuses correctly and stay alive. You need at least 1 friend for this game :)

games.title: Angry Putin
games.shortDescription: Angry Putin is a third person simulation game. Putin is angry and he will relax by beating other people, dancing with music and drinking VOTKA VOTKA VOTKA!

games.title: Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow
games.shortDescription: Experience the altered memories of a dying man, reliving his entire life as a little boy while lying on his deathbed. Explore the profound depths of his subconscious as you assist Griffin to shed the remains of his miserable life before his impending demise.

games.title: Spikair Volleyball
games.shortDescription: Control the 4 players of your volleyball team. Recruit players, train them and win tournaments to become the best volleyball club.

games.title: Sekai to Sekai no Mannaka de
games.shortDescription: 《在世界与世界的正中央》是日本知名视觉小说游戏厂商Lump of Sugar（方糖社）在全盛时期所制作的一款轻科幻恋爱题材作品。本作由方糖社旗下高人气画师萌木原文武（代表作《游魂》系列）负责原画与人物设计，剧本由市川环、铁人和芹联手打造。音乐由大川茂伸制作。游戏主题曲由知名歌姬Kicco献唱。

games.title: Ink: Tournament Paintball
games.shortDescription: The definitive paintball game that you have been looking for over a decade. A solution for paintball teams to practice and compete on the most recent layouts with the best guns on the market. Join now to battle it out on Ink: Tournament Paintball®!

games.title: Family curse
games.shortDescription: Family curse is a mystical horror from the first person with a frightening atmosphere. Immerse yourself in the intricate history of the Crouse family and find out the terrible secret of the people who died in the cursed house.

games.title: Against Great Darkness
games.shortDescription: Against Great Darkness is a brick-breaking, bullet hell, roguelite where you play as a pagan trying to escape Hell's maw. Trigger relics by keeping your disks bouncing, experience unique events where you can obtain incredible loot, and battle hellish bosses while always keeping an eye on your disks.

games.title: The Strongest TOFU
games.shortDescription: Be The TOFU. The one and only Tofu action game created by a real Tofu Meister. You choose one of three varieties, and in its endless journey it gradually softens, crumbles, stews, and acquires bittern to become TOFU.

games.title: Life Eater
games.shortDescription: If you don't sacrifice your neighbors, the world ends. Life Eater is a horror fantasy kidnapping simulator where you must become intimately familiar with your targets' lives one intrusive action at a time... and hope that the dark god you serve is even real.

games.title: Sore wa Maichiru Sakura no You ni -Re:BIRTH-
games.shortDescription: 《繁花落舞恋如樱 -Re:BIRTH-》由日本美少女游戏资深大厂Navel制作，是早在22年前就已成为广受赞誉的经典名作的重制版。本作由西又葵担当原画与角色设计；由创作了《我们没有翅膀》、《近月少女的礼仪》等话题名作的剧本家王雀孙主笔。桃山伊音、夏和小、九条信乃等知名声优为本作女主角献声。

games.title: In Search Of You
games.shortDescription: This game is to rekindle the exhilarating sensation of youthful passion—to perfectly capture the essence of romantic endeavors, making the experience of falling in love both sweet and meaningful, and to inspire players with the beauty of love within the nightlife entertainment industry.

games.title: I Am Part-time Worker!!
games.shortDescription: This is an action-comedy game where you work part-time at a convenience store register while taking down troublesome 'nuisance customers.'

games.title: Of Bird and Cage
games.shortDescription: Of Bird and Cage is a unique metal album presented through a two-hour-long story-driven game. Play music in a brand-new way. Featuring famous artists like Ron 'Bumblefoot' Thal (ex-Guns N' Roses), Rob van der Loo (Epica), Ruud Jolie (Within Temptation), and many others!

games.title: 铁道少女:梦想轨迹 2.0 Railway To Dream
games.shortDescription: 梦想轨迹是集合轻百合与养成元素的文字冒险游戏，玩家将扮演力图成为第一名女性动车组司机的田诗虹，在一个月期间接受川崎镜与韩德亮二人的指导，并在最后接受梁凌薇的考核。以此与两位童年好友和解，将三人之间那早已扭曲的轨迹，重新引导回正确的轨道上。

games.title: Power of Ten
games.shortDescription: Fly a star-fighter against a bloodthirsty armada. Gather weapons, resources, and upgrades to help you push back the relentless assault while protecting the galaxies' civilians!

games.title: T-Minus 30
games.shortDescription: Plan a city and build a space fleet to escape a dying Earth before time runs out. You have 30 minutes to scavenge a post-apocalyptic environment to build infrastructure, grow crops, generate power, and assemble rockets to save as many people as you can.

games.title: Soundodger 2
games.shortDescription: Dodge the music and weave through an endless ballet of bullets in an all-new collection of hand-crafted levels set to the music of an award-winning cast of international musicians. Turn any song into an amazing experience with the robust Level Editor and never run out of things to dodge.

games.title: NOeSIS Ⅱ-人间无常「正式版」
games.shortDescription: In order to pay off the loan, the protagonist and childhood sweetheart work together to clean up the lonely death. After meeting the girl who claims to be the incarnation of the firefly, the protagonist quietly changes.

games.title: Hot And Lovely 4
games.shortDescription: A very interesting puzzle game. You need to remember the different pictures by flipping the cards, and find the same pictures to eliminate.

games.title: My Name is Mayo 3
games.shortDescription: Get ready to have your intellect enriched, your emotions manipulated and your mayonnaise expanded; as you unveil the stories and learn from mistakes. Our lives are too short not to be enhanced with meaningful stories like this one!

games.title: Greedventory
games.shortDescription: Greedventory is a gorgeous pixel-art linear action RPG experience, where the only thing between you and an embarrassingly swift death is your mouse. Strike, parry, and cast powerful spells on your enemies, loot ancient treasures, explore a brutal realm, and become the hero you never wanted to be!

games.title: EVOTINCTION
games.shortDescription: In 'Evotinction', a third-person hacking and stealth game, you are Dr. Liu, the only one who can stop rogue AIs in a futuristic research facility. Use a variety of hacking skills to overcome robotic threats and uncover the secrets that hold the key to humanity's survival or its potential extinction.

games.title: Nightmare knock
games.shortDescription: How would you like to know that an uninvited guest, about whom you know absolutely nothing, will come to you at night? One thing is clear, he is unlikely to come in peace. What will you do? Prepare for his visit? Will you take a knife or hide in the closet? It's up to you.

games.title: Tornado: Research and Rescue
games.shortDescription: Experience the thrill of becoming a storm chaser in Tornado: Research and Rescue! Capture twisters with a 90's VHS camera, warn towns, customise chases, and get up-close for thrilling photos. Deploy probes, collect data, and upgrade your truck, radar, and probes. Mod vehicles with Steam Workshop!

games.title: Treasure Chest Clicker
games.shortDescription: Click your way to a fortune in Treasure Chest Clicker! Discover gold, level up and find all the rare treasures hidden inside the chests!

games.title: Technotopia
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Technotopia, a city-builder card game. Take on the role of an AI designed to build a perfect city. Build districts, meet the needs of diverse communities and maintain the delicate balance between factions vying for control over you!

games.title: Hot Shot Burn
games.shortDescription: Hot Shot Burn is the hilariously violent party brawler that lets you compete in the galaxy's ultimate televised blood sport. Experience crazy couch battles full of ridiculous flukes and insane skill shots for up to 4 players.

games.title: The Last Hex
games.shortDescription: The dead arise and only you can stand against them. Equip and train your character, grow your arsenal of cards, survive harrowing encounters and prepare for the final showdown with The Lost at ...The Last Hex! A RPG Deckbuilder with Roguelite elements.

games.title: Hotel R'n'R
games.shortDescription: Hotel R’n’R, the gonzo VR rockstar simulator! Sell your soul to The Devil, smash up hotels and become Infamous. Pressure from hotel staff and your own limp wrists are against you, but with over 36 weapons, and a World Tour ahead of you, it’s time to get creative.

games.title: Dark Quest 3
games.shortDescription: A rogue-lite tabletop that mixes card based exploration with turn based combat. Create your party, draw adventure cards, roll dice and fight monsters to defeat the sorcerer and his magic.

games.title: Helskate
games.shortDescription: Helskate is a skateboarding action roguelite. Grind, perform tricks, and chain combos to power up your attacks to slay the monsters of Vertheim. Combine unique weapons and gear to suit your playstyle as you fight, die, and upgrade your abilities to come back to this labyrinth over and over again!

games.title: Sword and Fairy 4
games.shortDescription: *** This game is only available in Chinese *** 《仙四》自上市至今，廣受玩家青睞，刻骨銘心的故事軸線，至今仍被各界譽為單機遊戲中的雋永之作。故事講述山野少年雲天河從小孤獨地成長，整天以追豬、玩豬、獵豬為樂。某日因為盜墓少女韓菱紗而闖入父母的神秘墓室，墓室中的奇事奇景使得山野少年踏上了尋覓往事、求仙問道的旅途……

games.title: GROSS
games.shortDescription: GROSS is a unique twist on the classic tower defense genre. After building your defenses, you will jump into the action to take on enemies head-on. Make sure to collect as much cash as possible to upgrade your defenses and stay ahead of the game. Can you outlast the waves of enemies?

games.title: The Coma 2B: Catacomb
games.shortDescription: The Coma 2B: Catacomb is a Korean survival horror adventure. It is the back story to the previous game, The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters, and a story bridge for the full series. You return as Youngho, the hero from The Coma 1, as you once again venture forth into the terrifying mirror dimension…

games.title: Kirakira Monstars
games.shortDescription: It's sure to bring a smile to everyone's face! In the big city of the human world, a group of monstrous girls go about their daily lives in a serious, anything-goes, slapstick frenzy!

games.title: SIMULACRA 3
games.shortDescription: The town of Stonecreek is haunted. People keep disappearing into thin air, leaving nothing but an eerie symbol behind. With the townsfolk gripped with fear, use a missing victim's phone to unlock the truth in the third entry of the acclaimed horror series, SIMULACRA.

games.title: Garbanzo Quest
games.shortDescription: GARBANZO QUEST! The crazy bullet-heck platformer where your main weapon is your own spit! Bring a friend! Hand-crafted challenges, secrets, and branching paths galore!

games.title: Battle Grid
games.shortDescription: Face relentless alien hordes, collect their resources and assemble an unstoppable squadron of mechs! In this Action Roguelite, discover game-breaking synergies, mix and match weapons and units, unlock upgrades, harvest and conquer alien planets.

games.title: [REC] Paroxysm
games.shortDescription: You're a horror content creator, venturing into frightening locations to captivate your audience. You're attempting to attract more viewers by recording paranormal events. However, these horror-filled adventures will one day come back to haunt you, at a high cost.

games.title: Hanako: Honor & Blade
games.shortDescription: Hanako: Honor Blade is a multiplayer melee experience set in Feudal Japan, with up to 24 players. Become one of four distinct warrior classes. Dominate the battlefield through multiple game modes and maps. ------ Full Release September 15th, 2021... 14 years in the making!

games.title: Tiny Thor
games.shortDescription: Jump into this challenging retro platformer! Play as Thor, use his mighty hammer and unique items to explore the Northern Realms. Beware of mythical creatures blocking your path to become a god!

games.title: Himeko Sutori
games.shortDescription: Himeko Sutori is a tactical, turn-based RPG that combines intimate character development with epic battles featuring hundreds of unique characters. With the included campaign editor, you can make new worlds and new adventures, making Himeko Sutori your story.

games.title: Ollie & Bollie: Outdoor Estate
games.shortDescription: A cute sandbox game about restoring an estate. Work with your (real or AI) friend Bollie to cut trees, catch sheep, build a shed and more in this outdoor autumn sandbox game.

games.title: Villa's Blinds
games.shortDescription: Hello graduates! You have a degree on computer engineering and you can’t find a job? Start now to develop a game in your rental garage. Advertise them and gather your own fan base. Earn your pocket money! Of course, you won’t live in this garbage dump till the end!

games.title: Cyber-doge 2077: Meme runner
games.shortDescription: Furious 3D runner about a pumped-up dog. Run as far as possible! Collect coins! Set new records and enjoy a great soundtrack.

games.title: EBOLA 2
games.shortDescription: EBOLA 2 is created in the spirit of the great classics of survival horrors. In this game, you will control the main character with a first-person camera which makes you feel like you’re in a real horror movie.

games.title: The Architect: Paris
games.shortDescription: The Architect: Paris is a construction game that allows you to shape the city of Paris into what you want. Destroy, draw, build your own architectural projects, customizing each building carefully or entire districts at once.

games.title: Forsake: Urban horror
games.shortDescription: Forsake is a 1 to 4 player co-op online survival horror game where each player is a member of an urban explorer group. Choose your equipment to explore places full of paranormal and exorcise them, if you think you can handle it!

games.title: Apocalyptic Vibes
games.shortDescription: A vintage immersive first-person shooter on GZDoom. With an atmosphere of a cold and melancholic postapocalypse, elements of dieselpunk, mix of a retro-style and realism and romantic shoegaze as a soundtrack.

games.title: Last Group Out
games.shortDescription: Shoot, loot and try to escape with your life in this online co-op looter shooter!

games.title: Roma Invicta
games.shortDescription: Roma Invicta combines action packed real-time battles with turn-based strategy on a big campaign map. Supply your legions and conquer ancient Gaul turn by turn. Fight by yourself or hand over your soldiers to the AI ​​and enjoy the spectacle.

games.title: Path of the Midnight Sun
games.shortDescription: Protect a noblewoman reckoning with unholy powers as she wards off the soul of the Demon King sealed inside her. Doubt your own companions, survive against unforgiving hordes of monsters. But beware; every choice has consequences in this epic JRPG adventure of betrayal, romance self-acceptance.

games.title: 9th Sentinel Sisters
games.shortDescription: The battle of the clone girls unfolds on a post-apocalyptic Earth, devastated by the alien life form known as 'Bleed.' Pilot the manned weapon 'Father' to eliminate enemies. Upgrade weapons, create powerful builds, and strategize to successfully clear stages.

games.title: Lords of Infinity
games.shortDescription: Lead an ancient and crumbling noble house in a rich gunpowder fantasy setting. Lie, bribe, and conspire to secure power and prestige – or to save a doomed kingdom from itself.

games.title: Songs Of Death
games.shortDescription: Roguelite, rhythm，survival game. You need to play the role of Ma Chao, upgrade weapons in the battle, combine fetters, break through the tight encirclement, fight your way out, even if cursed by the world, you have to kill your father's enemy Cao Cao!

games.title: Knights Within
games.shortDescription: Knights Within is a third person shooter and melee hack slash blend with rogue-lite elements. Design custom loadouts, navigate procedurally generated levels and utilize random power-ups. Either solo or with friends, can you survive endless waves of enemies to ensure humanity's survival?

games.title: ~Azur Ring~virgin and slave's phylacteries
games.shortDescription: New Metroidvania + RPG adventure game. Legendary gear! Unique set, a large number of magical equipment to provide you with unlimited possibilities to equip build. Gorgeous and fluent act combo system, give you the operating space to challenge the limit!

games.title: Victory Road
games.shortDescription: Victory Road is a boxing simulator that uniquely puts you in the role of the coach, not the boxer! As a coach, the fate of your boxer’s career, and potentially his life, is in your hands. Raise your boxer and utilize various strategies to climb up the ranking board.

games.title: Adam - Lost Memories
games.shortDescription: Adam - Lost Memories is a psychological horror puzzle game, based on my personal experiences with child abuse.

games.title: Chess Sudoku
games.shortDescription: How does Chess Sudoku work? Well we’ve taken the classic sudoku game everyone knows and loves and created puzzles with chess-related twists! There are three different types of puzzles in the game: Knight Sudoku; King Sudoku and Queen Sudoku.

games.title: GOAL! The Club Manager
games.shortDescription: You are more than a coach. You are the undisputed club boss. Are you ready to dominate the league with your team in this re-imagining of the classic sports management franchise? Could you be the next manager sensation? Prove it!

games.title: Crystal Call
games.shortDescription: Run, dash, blast and slide your way through challenging environments in this fluid and fast paced first person speedrunner!

games.title: Defend the Rook
games.shortDescription: A roguelike tactics board combat combined with tower defense elements. Defeat the invading hordes to stay alive and save the land! Enjoy more tactics than a normal TD game, combined with the added challenge of building towers and fighting off waves of enemies!

games.title: The Indigo Parallel
games.shortDescription: A surreal mind-bending journey into the depths of madness. You assume the role of Tom, a man hopelessly in love with Daisy, who embarks on a psychedelic adventure through a bizarre and unpredictable world.

games.title: Fishards
games.shortDescription: Combine the intense, skill-shot PVP of Magicka or Battlerite with some wacky 2-legged-fish and you've got yourself Fishards! The unique spell combining mechanic creates a brand new type of PvP​ ​arena​ experience that you have to try with friends!

games.title: Saint Maker - Horror Visual Novel
games.shortDescription: A haunted convent. Statues that move on their own. A buried past. Welcome to Saint Idelora’s convent, where becoming a saint comes with a price.

games.title: AETHERIS
games.shortDescription: Aetheris is a tactical RPG with challenging turn-based battles set in an immersive and vibrant environment. Make the right choices and find the best strategy to survive in the unforgiving Wilderness. Journey alone or as a party of four—the adventure awaits!

games.title: Island Cities - Jigsaw Puzzle
games.shortDescription: Arrange the town islands and see them come to life. Just swap the blocks of a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

games.title: cat and rat
games.shortDescription: 一款双人欢乐追逐游戏

games.title: NIDUS
games.shortDescription: A symbiotic Flower and Wasp struggle to complete their lifecycle, in a challengingly twisted arcade experience. Control both characters at once in mind-bending Single Player, or team up with a friend in hectic Local Co-Op. Master the symbiotic duet, devour the swarm, and ascend the leaderboard.

games.title: MareQuest: An Interactive Tail
games.shortDescription: A terrible darkness threatens a world of overwhelmingly adorable mares. Can a new cute mare with amnesia save the world or will she lose more than her memories along the way?

games.title: Midnight Ramen
games.shortDescription: In Midnight Ramen, you play as the owner of a late-night ramen stand and his apprentice. You interact with your customers, listen to their troubles, and help them out whenever you can. But as the bowls of ramen are cooked and served, troubles are beginning to brew in your own life as well...

games.title: Beer Simulator
games.shortDescription: You are single? You have a very hard work and small salary? Then this game is just for you. In this game you can earn beer just by clicking on beer. Upgrade your beer, sell your beer, earn gold, purchase more beer without becoming an actual alcoholic.

games.title: The Book of Distance
games.shortDescription: In 1935, Yonezo Okita left his home in Japan and began a new life in Canada. Then war and state-sanctioned racism changed everything—he became the enemy. His grandson leads us on an interactive virtual pilgrimage through an emotional geography of immigration and family to recover what was lost.

games.title: Fox Girls Never Play Dirty
games.shortDescription: A classic style turn-based RPG. While traveling in the country of Stivale, Ryunosuke bumps into a fox girl named Serena. Before long, he's brawling with the police, and he gets wrapped up in a movement to reform the country.

games.title: Serious Sam: Kamikaze Attack!
games.shortDescription: Step into the boots of Serious Sam's most iconic foe, the Headless Kamikaze, and chase down the vile Serious Sam in this action packed arcade runner

games.title: Last Days
games.shortDescription: The gods have blessed New Canaan for four hundred years, and everyone - including Sister Ginsetsu - thought it would go on forever, until the day Ginsetsu met the gods of New Canaan. Since then, the story between the maiden who calls herself a god, and the maiden who will become a god has begun.

games.title: Crossing Guard Joe
games.shortDescription: In Monoxide City where the cars don't stop, only one man can help kids cross the street.

games.title: Demon Turf: Neon Splash
games.shortDescription: Maintain a constant momentum of precision platforming through surreal worlds, filled with bright neon colors, and enjoy the intoxicating combination of 2D 3D art! Explore and hunt collectables or knuckle-down and master satisfying mechanics to compete for the best times across the world!

games.title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Rei
games.shortDescription: Higurashi When They Cry is a sound novel. The music, backgrounds and characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. They laugh and cry and get angry. The user takes the point of view of the protagonist to experience the story.

games.title: Garlant: My Story
games.shortDescription: I am a Falconeye who just graduated from the academy. In pursuit of challenges, I came to the distant border of the kingdom: Garlant in the Doe region. Here I will start a new chapter of my life, and it's going to be an amazing adventure story!

games.title: Pet Shop Simulator
games.shortDescription: Run your own pet shop in Pet Shop Simulator! Find new homes for pets, thus fulfilling the dreams of your customers. Take care of the needs of animals by selling the right items and get involved in matters related to the pets' home life!

games.title: EcoGnomix
games.shortDescription: A quirky mix of roguelite and city builder. Build a lively little city above, by looting mystical caves with a team of gnomes below! Use multiple runs to unlock upgrades and abilities to help your gnomes venture deeper into the dangerous underground.

games.title: Clue/Cluedo
games.shortDescription: Step into new Crime Scenes. Use your skills of deduction to unravel the mystery and find out who did it, with what weapon, where. It’s the original crime-solving classic with new investigation formats exclusive to the video game. Solve every case and become the detective you want to be!

games.title: Climber Animals: Together
games.shortDescription: Climber Animals is a challenging and dynamic parkour game for 1-8 players. In this game,overcome obstacles and climb to the top with your friends. If you fall, your progress is lost and you start over. Keep your balance on this challenging climb and compete with your friends to reach the top.

games.title: The Living Remain
games.shortDescription: The Living Remain is a virtual reality first person adventure shooter where players immerse themselves in a world where the undead have taken over. You must survive the horde of undead using an arsenal of weapons in a story driven campaign loaded with a variety of interactive environments.

games.title: Overloop
games.shortDescription: A puzzle-platformer set in a dystopian world where the invention of a cloning device has messed things up, big time. Armed with a clone gun and a mighty fine mustache, the chore of saving THE WHOLE OF CIVILIZATION rests on your shoulders. Don’t blow it.

games.title: Mutropolis
games.shortDescription: MUTROPOLIS is a lovely sci-fi adventure set on the abandoned Planet Earth. Play as Henry Dijon (hero, nerd, detective) in search of a legendary lost city. Uncover weird ancient artifacts. And PLEASE don’t get obliterated by an ageless evil. You’ve been warned.

games.title: Charterstone: Digital Edition
games.shortDescription: Build and discover in Charterstone - a digital board game campaign. Shape your village into the new Eternal City!☁️🏙️☁️

games.title: Peaceful Days
games.shortDescription: Peaceful Days is a farming RPG heavily inspired by Harvest Moon series. In this game, you can build your dream from scratch, raise animals, interact with town folks, take part in interesting festivals, discover many secrets and more!

games.title: Phantom Breaker: Omnia
games.shortDescription: Phantom Breaker Omnia is a fast-paced 2-D anime fighting game that features 20 unique characters, pitted against one another to make their greatest wishes come true. The ability to choose between 3 fighting styles will appeal to seasoned gamers while making the game accessible to newcomers.

games.title: Hot And Lovely 3
games.shortDescription: This is an interesting leisure origami game, which can exercise your hands-on ability. In the game, you must fold the paper as much as possible into the specified cute graphics in the specified origami times. The game is very challenging from easy to difficult.

games.title: RussianPunk 2007
games.shortDescription: The factory worker, like everyone else, thought that 2007 would never return. However, on his way home, he stumbled upon some magical mushrooms.

games.title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator
games.shortDescription: Service off-road vehicles and take them for a drive! Offroad Mechanic Simulator lets you modify many classic off-road vehicles and prepare them for daunting tasks that no normal car could ever hope to complete. Test your work and climb steep cliffs or drive through rivers and deep layers of mud.

games.title: 100 hidden gnomes
games.shortDescription: Hidden object game in a fairytale style. This is a kind game for kids.

games.title: SCHiM
games.shortDescription: SCHiM is a game about jumping from shadow to shadow in a relaxing and lively environment. This 3D platformer takes elements of light, shadow animation and adds them directly to the gameplay, delivering an experience that you will only find in SCHiM.

games.title: Monolith
games.shortDescription: A classical science fiction point and click adventure which takes you into a deep story and murky atmosphere, while solving logical puzzles. Accompany Tessa Carter and her talking robot as she finds out about herself and searches for a way to survive.

games.title: Saiko no sutoka no shiki
games.shortDescription: Saiko no Sutoka No Shiki is a spin-off of the original game Saiko no Sutoka, in which Saiko is a zombie anime girl who wants to play with her senpai, with the senpai needing to complete her parts and give her food to satisfy her hunger while simultaneously trying to escape.

games.title: Living Cell
games.shortDescription: You are the liquidator survived the samosbor in block G-326 of the endless Gigakhrushchyovka. You have to find out what happened in this block, evacuate the residents and find a way out for yourself. But is everything as simple as it seems at first glance?

games.title: AsHes
games.shortDescription: This horror game inspired by Chinese folklore offers an enthralling journey through the depths of the Underworld. As you delve deeper, you'll unravel hidden secrets veiled in the darkness.

games.title: Just Click The Button
games.shortDescription: In 'Just Click The Button,' you do indeed, click on a button. The more you click, the more the game evolves. Select new abilities that align with your playstyle. Decide whether to attempt to beat the game after reaching a certain threshold or play indefinitely!

games.title: Voids Vigil
games.shortDescription: Blast your way through robotic hordes in this auto-battler arena shooter. Use auto-firing weapons and drones, timely dashes and special abilities to reach the Void where a final Conservator Custodian awaits computational convergence. Spend your Cogs wisely among the shops to create unique builds!

games.title: Witch's Doll
games.shortDescription: Witch's Doll is a first-person psychological horror game with realistic graphics. Beware, something is lurking in the dark. Get ready for intense jumpscares.

games.title: Kakenuke★Forward to Our Sparking Youth!
games.shortDescription: What does 'youth' mean to you? Is it a time in your life meant for having fun? For devoting yourself to a cause? For Yuu Tono, it's meant earning money and studying to build a brighter future for him and his family. But maybe the new (or maybe old?) friend who's come into his life will change that.

games.title: Gnomes and Knights
games.shortDescription: Gnome hunting reaches a new level! Become a mighty knight and plunge into the world of dark fantasy without leaving your home.

games.title: Common'hood
games.shortDescription: Common’hood is a community building and economy management game with highly customizable base building tools. Scavenge for materials, grow your own food, research new technology, craft new tools, build a home, make friends. Form your community and take it from surviving to thriving!

games.title: Pixel Puzzles Illustrations & Anime
games.shortDescription: Pixel Puzzles, your number one place for digital jigsaws.

games.title: Another Try
games.shortDescription: The virus has devastated cities and lands, you are one of the last survivors! You will have to survive in a harsh post-apocalyptic world populated by the living dead.

games.title: Tandis
games.shortDescription: Tandis is a puzzle game where you discover mind-bending geometric shapes.

games.title: Kasi
games.shortDescription: Be a plant. Manage water and sunlight for photosynthesis. Grow branches into the sky and roots into the earth. Become the tallest, most efficient tree, a snaking vine with many shoots, or just a nice bush.

games.title: Gigapocalypse
games.shortDescription: Become a customizable giant monster with manifold skills in Gigapocalypse, inspired by classical Kaijū movies such as “Godzilla” and “King Kong” and the game classic “Rampage”.

games.title: Мухосранск | Russian City Sim
games.shortDescription: The atmosphere of the nuclear wasteland.

games.title: Universe For Sale
games.shortDescription: A space station nestled in the clouds of Jupiter. A bizarre bazaar where a young, worried woman crafts entire universes in the palm of her hand. A mysterious cultist who's stripped the flesh from his bones in order to reach enlightenment. Here, there's a universe for sale. You buying?

games.title: Once Upon a Jester
games.shortDescription: Travel the kingdom as Jester with his best friend Sok to improvise theatre shows and perform on stages far and wide. Sing your hearts out, crack jokes and impress audiences to become the stars of the famous Royal Theatrical Spectacle!

games.title: Gilded Shadows
games.shortDescription: A GxB visual novel that explores a whimsical, yet dangerous world which blends the solarpunk and cyberpunk aesthetics into a unique adventure. As you follow the MC on her journey, pursue various love interests in a stand-alone story unique to that route.

games.title: Silent Hope
games.shortDescription: Explore, fight, and produce items to grow stronger as seven distinct heroes in this silent world. Guided by the Princess, you'll delve into the Abyss and learn the mysteries of the King and his now-ruined kingdom. In a world without words, what hope is there for humanity?

games.title: Wandering in Space VR
games.shortDescription: Join Wandering In Space, a unique FPS ROGUELITE SCI-FI experience built for VR. With a variety of space weapons, upgradable armory, power ups and unknown superpower, you, a soldier without any memory have to fight the mutants, cyborgs and the rebels to survive in the space of unknown...

games.title: Sora no Ao to Shiro to
games.shortDescription: 《天空的蓝与白/如梭夏日》是由日本美少女游戏品牌Barista Lab于2022年夏天推出的一款恋爱小品作。由知名原画师SesenaYau担当人物设计与原画，由咏野万知子编写剧本，并由知名音乐制作人大川茂伸制作音乐。

games.title: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival
games.shortDescription: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival is a drum-based rhythm game featuring songs from genres such as Anime and VOCALOID™, and also a variety of game modes! Have fun playing solo or online!

games.title: Alia's Carnival! Flowering Sky
games.shortDescription: 本作是日本美少女游戏知名品牌NanaWind（七风社）制作的超能力校园恋爱题材作品，是《爱丽娅的明日盛典!》的续作。本作由业内知名女性画师七尾奈留和Mitha联合担当原画与角色设计；由超人气声优桐谷华、秋野花、阳茉莉等领衔为游戏女主角献声。

games.title: The Wind and Wilting Blossom
games.shortDescription: Navigate the war-torn lands of an alternate history Heian Japan battling yokai hordes in challenging turn-based combat. Encounter hundreds of story events, level-up your party, and unlock new allies and weapons. Die, learn from your mistakes, and try again.

games.title: 東方翠神廻廊 〜 Faith in the Goddess of Suwa.
games.shortDescription: “Touhou Suijin Kairou” is a Touhou derivative RPG featuring over 150 fantasy girls! Explore the corridors and solve the strange situation in Gensokyo! A profound story unfolds, and your choices will change the future!

games.title: Speed Limit
games.shortDescription: Speed Limit is a non-stop genre-warping arcade experience that never slows down. No cuts, no lapses in the chaos, Speed Limit is an old-school action extravaganza boiled down to its core elements: Hard. Fast. Addictive. Now with a free Arcade Edition update!

games.title: KingSim
games.shortDescription: Become the King in a story-driven 8-bit style game, where choice matters. And try not to die instantly...

games.title: Touken Ranbu Warriors
games.shortDescription: 'Touken Ranbu Warriors' is an action game that is a collaboration between the 'spirits of blades' simulation game 'Touken Ranbu ONLINE' presented by DMM GAMES and NITRO PLUS, and the thrilling '1 vs. 1,000' WARRIORS series of KOEI TECMO GAMES.

games.title: Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism
games.shortDescription: Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism is a (hi)story-driven turn-based strategy set in the WW2 period. It offers refined wargame mechanics, story-rich gameplay, and modern 3D graphics. Lead the USSR Armed forces staging the world Communist revolution. For Stalin! For the Motherland!

games.title: Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved
games.shortDescription: Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved is a villain protagonist real-time strategy game. You will play as the King of the Dead and rule the world once again by creating zombie legions and destroying human cities. As the King of the Dead, you can infect humans, turn them into zombies and rule the world!

games.title: Beyond Sunset
games.shortDescription: Cyberpunk first-person shooter with a rich story and RPG elements. You are Lucy, an enhanced street samurai searching for lost memories. Fight in large, open, interactive levels overtaken by yakuza, zombies, robots and bosses!

games.title: Of Life and Land
games.shortDescription: Of Life and Land is a charming settlement-building strategy game paired with a rich simulation experience. Every animal and plant strives to find its place in nature while you lead your villagers to their future. Expand to different regions and trade with local factions to gain needed resources.

games.title: Ultimate Zombie Defense 2
games.shortDescription: 4-player co-op, zombie slaying, base building, boss battling mayhem! Cleanse the infected wave by wave and upgrade your base with traps defenses in Ultimate Zombie Defense 2!

games.title: Tru Or Die
games.shortDescription: Tru Or Die: Chiraq is a third person single/multiplayer roleplaying game.

games.title: SUPER CRAZY RHYTHM CASTLE
games.shortDescription: It’s Super Crazy Rhythm Castle, the chaotic rhythm adventure! A puzzling co-op mashup unlike anything you've ever heard. Solo, or with a band of up to three friends … … Can you conquer the castle?

games.title: Kingdom's Life
games.shortDescription: Kingdom's Life - Large turn-based global strategy game in pixel style. You have to create your own people and state. Can you lead the state to political, economic, technological and military triumph? It depends on you.

games.title: Nearly Dead - Live and Let Die
games.shortDescription: 2D top-down multi co-op action game. Survive the zombies together with a stranger.

games.title: Room 301 NO.6
games.shortDescription: —Look at the world around you, and see that left long forgotten. Room 301 is a narrative game portraying the lived experience of those with Alzheimer's. Progress through similar puzzles time and again. Each day, you must sort through your belongings to see your past: your slowly fading memories

games.title: Beltex
games.shortDescription: Beltex is a casual factory game played on a hex map. Extract numbers. Combine them using mathematical operations. Deliver them using belts across a huge map. Unlock new buildings and upgrades.

games.title: Watch Your Plastic Duck
games.shortDescription: Small rubber ducks calmly swim in the pool and you can watch them to relaxing music. What can go wrong?

games.title: Ooglians
games.shortDescription: Ooglians are coming! Nothing excites an ooglian more than smashing machinery. Protect your machinery with more machinery which attracts even more ooglians. How unfortunate.

games.title: Shape Shifter: Formations
games.shortDescription: Shape Shifter: Formations is an action twin-stick shooter with rogue-lite elements, where you must destroy hordes of geometric enemies alone or with a friend. Select your ship and combine a large variety of weapons, abilities and infinitely stacking upgrades to craft your own unique build.

games.title: Death Trick: Double Blind
games.shortDescription: The star magician of Morgan’s Traveling Circus is missing, but the show must go on! In this non-linear detective visual novel, unravel the mystery from two different perspectives as you learn the varying stories of an entire circus of performers, each with their own lives... and their own secrets.

games.title: Samosbor
games.shortDescription: The player will take the role of a liquidator destroying the consequences of Samosbor in the narrow corridors of Gigakhrushchevka.

games.title: Orbi Universo
games.shortDescription: Play as the leader of a civilization, make it prosper and stand the test of time. Orbi Universo is a strategy/simulation game in which you manage your civilization with an abstract and complex node system and you make your society evolve through different periods, from cavemen to the Modern Era.

games.title: Gloomy Eyes VR
games.shortDescription: With the voice of Colin Farrell, Gloomy Eyes narrates the story of the sun who got tired of the humans and decided to hide and never rise again. Gloomy Eyes is an animated VR-series in 6DoF 3D real-time.

games.title: Age of Reforging:The Freelands
games.shortDescription: Age of Reforging: The Freelands is a medieval fantasy sandbox, strategy, and survival RPG. Players will take on the role of a 'reforger' chosen by the goddess of fate, growing and expanding their party on a journey through a vast land of opportunity - the Freelands - to adventure as they wish!

games.title: Raindrops
games.shortDescription: Raindrops is a stereo rhythm game, played with your mouse. Notes will be poured from both sides, and the sound will wave towards the direction of succesful hits. Move your mouse, click with both buttons, even scroll to take care of these notes.

games.title: Farmer's Life: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Farmer’s Life is a first simulator that will show you real, sometimes dark life on the farm. You will run Kazimir’s life - a bachelor and alcoholic. Help him to become an exemplary farmer, start a family, take care of the farm or watch him going down.

games.title: Commandos 3 - HD Remaster
games.shortDescription: Fall in, soldier! Commandos 3 - HD Remaster sends you to the relentless and unforgiving battlefields of Europe. Remastered in high definition including reworked 3D models and textures, improved controls and refined UI.

games.title: Astride

games.title: Gunvein
games.shortDescription: Gunvein is a dynamic, aggression-based bullet hell shoot em up where you use lock on lasers, charged weapons, bombs hypers to overwhelm the enemies before they overwhelm you.

games.title: Commando Hero

games.title: Chromosome Evil 2

games.title: FALL
games.shortDescription: In the past, the world was almost invaded by zombies.You will play the commander of the remaining survivor camp, searching for hope for the last surviving companions, forming and assigning your special police squad to explore this post-apocalyptic world filled with zombies!

games.title: Learn Japanese RPG: Hiragana Forbidden Speech
games.shortDescription: Dialogue changes from English to Japanese as you learn and progress in this comedic RPG backed by professional Japanese voice acting. This is a full introductory Japanese course and adventure all in one. Master hiragana, basic grammar, and over 240 common words used in anime!

games.title: Deathtrap Dungeon: The Interactive Video Adventure
games.shortDescription: Deathtrap Dungeon is an interactive video realisation of Ian Livingstone's multi-million selling classic gamebook starring Eddie Marsan (Fast Furious presents Hobbes Shaw, Deadpool 2, Atomic Blonde) as narrator.

games.title: Dark Water : Slime Invader
