games.shortDescription: You play as the son of a restorer, a museum worker who died tragically. While searching for the memorabilia, the door suddenly closes and strange things begin to happen. The hero is waiting for immersion in the world of art and the paranormal.

games.title: Desktopia: A Desktop Village Simulator
games.shortDescription: Desktopia is a city-builder game which simulates an evolving, medieval-esque village along the bottom of your desktop, allowing you to work, watch, or browse something else while you play.

games.title: Trust No Bunny
games.shortDescription: Everybunny has a secret. Who do you trust to keep the town safe? Trust No Bunny is a hilarious and incredibly cute social deduction game for fans of Werewolf or Among Us. It’s a game for thinkers, schemers, downright liars, where guessing the traitors is only half the fun.

games.title: Zodiac fantasy 2
games.shortDescription: The little sisters have an important date (maybe several!) Now they need your help to cross the obstacles, use jumping or climbing flexibly to reach the date, the girls will thank you for it!

games.title: Runic Survivor
games.shortDescription: Combine Runes to craft unique spells! Survive the endless hordes of monsters as you work to break the four Runic seals! Runic is a casual horde shooter with rogue-lite elements and a charming retro aesthetic.

games.title: Sagres
games.shortDescription: Set sail for adventure in the Age of Discovery! Explore the seven seas as the fresh-faced ship captain Fernando. Customise your ship, battle against pirates and sea monsters, and assemble your crew to delve into the mysterious disappearance of the legendary explorer, Sir Antonio.

games.title: Tennis Manager 2023
games.shortDescription: Immerse yourself in the ultimate tennis simulation, where your decisions both on and off the court will shape the destiny of your academy. Be the number 1 manager and become a national Team Captain to lead your team to greatness. Serve your colors and win the World Cup of Tennis!

games.title: LEGO® Harry Potter™ Collection
games.shortDescription: The LEGO® Harry Potter™: Collection brings LEGO® Harry Potter™: Years 1-4 and LEGO® Harry Potter™: Years 5-7 together in one game, now remastered with enhanced graphics.

games.title: BEHEMOTH
games.shortDescription: Dodge ‘n flap your wings in this new arcade extravaganza from The Behemoth! In BEHEMOTH™, you become one with the chicken to secure your flock in the nest and collect as much candy corn as possible!

games.title: Ashes of the Union
games.shortDescription: A vehicular shooter with roguelike elements, offering a wild take on an alternate future of the Soviet Union. Build your combat vehicle and show nature who's boss!

games.title: Dungeon Antiqua
games.shortDescription: Dungeon Antiqua is a simple RPG inspired by the Wizardry and Final Fantasy games of the 1980s and 1990s, in which players traverse dungeons by repeatedly exploring and developing their characters.

games.title: Aquaculture Land: Fish Farming Simulation
games.shortDescription: Aquaculture Land is a fish farming management game. You will act as a freshwater fish farm manager to nurture different varieties of fish, produce high-quality commodities, and fulfill your customers' needs to grow your business.

games.title: Best Friend Forever
games.shortDescription: Pat the dogs... and then their owners. Step into the world of Rainbow Bay in Best Friend Forever, a dating sim-meets-dog care sim where you pat, pamper and train your pup while you search for your own forever friend.

games.title: TOTALLY BASEBALL
games.shortDescription: Play the full sport of Baseball (every position) on your own or with your friends! (No subscription needed!)

games.title: House Flipper VR
games.shortDescription: Virtual makeovers were never more real! Thanks to VR technology, you will be able to single-handedly take care of ruined properties, gaining your clients' appreciation and satisfaction from a job well done! Put on your goggles, take a firm grip on the controllers and become a master of renovation!

games.title: STRIKERS 1945
games.shortDescription: The vertical scrolling shooter game released in the arcade by 'Psikyo'. You can set the difficulty level, controls, screen orientation, etc. In addition, online rankings have been implemented! Aim to be the world's best Striker!

games.title: Cauldrons of War - Barbarossa
games.shortDescription: Cauldrons of War Barbarossa is the turn-based strategic wargame you will launch whenever you want your WW2 shot but don't have time for a monster strategy game.From June 1941 until the Battle of Moscow, play the USSR or the Axis forces in one of the largest and bloodiest operations in history.

games.title: The Fabled Woods
games.shortDescription: Welcome to The Fabled Woods, a dark and mysterious narrative short story. Despite the picturesque beauty, ugly and terrible secrets lurk among the shifting boughs, darkness that no amount of dappled sunlight can erase. Take the first step, and experience an unforgettable journey.

games.title: Kingdom Wars 4
games.shortDescription: It's 1347, the time of the Hundred Years' War. In this historical grand strategy and RTS hybrid you play as one of 200 minor lords across medieval Europe, Africa or Middle East. Rise up to take over your Kingdom and be crowned, then fight to preserve your empire as Black Death descends on Europe.

games.title: project BLARI
games.shortDescription: Try to survive in this semi open horror game inspired by the ps1 graphic era.

games.title: DIG - Deep In Galaxies
games.shortDescription: Free the galaxies in this action platformer! Jump, swing, dig and shoot your way through uncharted planets. Give hell to the Overlord's forces and face alien foes. Earn rewards after every battle and add them to your ever-growing arsenal.

games.title: Colorful Colore
games.shortDescription: Colorful Colore is a Puzzle Labyrinth game, where your objective is to get in the exit matching the correct colors in the way.

games.title: Love Puzzle
games.shortDescription: This is casual, intellectual, minimalist puzzle game. Control your square and find the way to pass the level. Gameplay is fun and relaxing.

games.title: Killing Time: Resurrected
games.shortDescription: Journey into a mansion on the Island of Matinicus where you'll arrive to find the mansion full of hellacious demonic creatures. Solve deadly puzzles, uncover the secrets behind a famous mystery and discover an ancient artifact from the Pharaoh Ramses, if you can live long enough to find it.

games.title: Line Path
games.shortDescription: A mind-bending puzzle game about filling all in one line Relax and enjoy

games.title: B-17 Flying Fortress : The Mighty 8th Redux
games.shortDescription: The classic game remastered. Feel the power of flying a 10-men crew on a B-17 over occupied Europe in WWII. Plan the mission, choose your men and take action in every post onboard, from pilot to bombardier and machine gunners. Get ready for a high-flying adventure in this all-time classic remake.

games.title: HeatStroke
games.shortDescription: HeatStroke is a simulation game tasking you to transcribe an unhinged short story while driving down a seemingly endless desert road.

games.title: Super-Patriota Simulator
games.shortDescription: Attention! In 72 hours something very important will happen, stay in the streets, do your part and wait for the armed forces! For the future of the country and for the future of your children! The Super-Patriot is coming!

games.title: Earl vs. the Mutants
games.shortDescription: Save humanity in a mutant-ridden apocalypse! Dive headfirst into Earl vs. the Mutants, a high-octane top-down survival action-roguelite set in the aftermath of a nuclear apocalypse.

games.title: Mass Effect 2 (2010) Edition
games.shortDescription: Are you prepared to lose everything to save the galaxy? You'll need to be, Commander Shepard. It's time to bring together your greatest allies and recruit the galaxy's fighting elite to continue the resistance against the invading Reapers.

games.title: Slay the Minotaur
games.shortDescription: Slay the Minotaur is a challenging roguelike dungeon crawler set in ancient Greece. Survive the onslaught of the labyrinth. Upgrade your skills, earn ranks, and face the Minotaur in the ultimate game of cat and mouse!

games.title: VR Driver School
games.shortDescription: VR driver school, designed specifically for the re conception and redesign of virtual reality. The game has just been launched and has become a driving school specific simulator software, perfectly restoring the driving school learning environment and making real-time judgments.

games.title: Machick
games.shortDescription: Defeat the heavily armed army of anti-magic toads and free the forest from destruction. Machick is a casual game where you craft your own wands, vanquish enemies, collect XP, and choose upgrades to go further on the journey.

games.title: PC Tycoon 2
games.shortDescription: Manage your computer company and develop your PC components, create your own laptop, monitor, develop an interactive operating system or build your PC. Research new technologies, improve your office and your factory, hire the best employees, buy other companies and build your computer empire!

games.title: Kanon
games.shortDescription: A tale of small miracles in a snow-covered town— Kanon, the very first game from visual novel studio Key, is now available on Steam! Now featuring HD visuals and full voice support! (The protagonist is only voiced in certain scenes.)

games.title: Journey to Incrementalia
games.shortDescription: Journey to Incrementalia is an active incremental auto-battler about a necromancer on a short quest. Cast diabolical spells, summon an army and open the gates of hell on your quest to break down 99 legendary walls and reach the lost city of Incrementalia.

games.title: Keen: One Girl Army
games.shortDescription: Keen: One Girl Army is a sliding puzzle game with turn-by-turn tactical combat and a hint of adventure!​ Guide Kim, a grumpy little girl raised by her grandmother on a journey to stop an evil secret society from destroying her village.

games.title: Vinyl Reality - DJ in VR
games.shortDescription: Vinyl Reality is the most realistic and authentic simulation of DJing with vinyl in VR. Load and mix your own tracks with two fully-functional turntables and a DJ mixer. Easily record or stream sets from awesome audio reactive stages. Personalize your experience with custom environments and avatars.

games.title: Spinch
games.shortDescription: Transcend the material realm and assume your true form as Spinch, a hyper-agile organism consumed by the quest to rescue a litter of its missing offspring, in this side-scrolling, psychedelic platformer from the mind of award-winning Canadian cartoonist, Jesse Jacobs.

games.title: Threshold
games.shortDescription: ** Note: The game has not been updated for a long time, please do not buy it, the author is redoing this game **

games.title: Dark Chess
games.shortDescription: THIS IS NOT CLASSIC CHESS! Dark Chess is a game of chess with fog of war, story-driven campaign with challenges, traps puzzles. A game-changing feature to conceal enemy army, add more fun and intrigue to a timeless classic. Fight your way through the Campaign or beat your friends and foes in PvP!

games.title: [Chilla's Art] Yuki Onna | 雪女
games.shortDescription: Yuki Onna | 雪女 is a PS1 inspired survival horror game. Some children went missing out of the blue. You receive a letter that says, 'Come alone or I'll freeze them to death.' Out of desperation, you decide to embark on a daunting rescue mission to an abandoned inn up the piercing cold mountains.

games.title: Nekoview
games.shortDescription: Nekoview is a simple manga viewer

games.title: Roller Riot
games.shortDescription: Get your revenge on the enemy cyborg roller derby gang! Roll and fight through a beautiful neon cityscape as CB, a genetically modified cyborg, bent on getting revenge for her past...

games.title: Faeland
games.shortDescription: Take on the role of skilled hunter, Sam, in Faeland, an adventure RPG set in a beautiful world inspired by 8-bit classics.

games.title: Game Dev Masters
games.shortDescription: It's time to become the Game Developer you always wanted to be. Make use of a large array of features, and player skills to create stunning 10 / 10 games. Compete with and eventually acquire other dynamic Ai Studio's. Raise the talent of your team and studio's in an effort to dominate the market.

games.title: MONARK
games.shortDescription: Could you face yourself and the threats around you to save the ones you love? Shin Mikado Academy is engulfed in a madness-inducing Mist, and only you can save everyone inside. Develop your Ego to break the pacts set by the Pactbearers and remove the corrupting Mist.

games.title: ALONE
games.shortDescription: You have to help a guy named Yeongchul trapped inside his home, navigate the house to protect himself from suspicious person.

games.title: Zool Redimensioned
games.shortDescription: The Ninja of the Nth Dimension is back! Explore vibrant retro landscapes, discover hidden secrets and take down menacing bosses in a modern reimagining of the classic action platforming adventure Zool.

games.title: Neko Candy Shop
games.shortDescription: Relaxing puzzle game with adorable neko girls.

games.title: NeverAwake
games.shortDescription: A girl who never wakes up. She has been fighting monsters in her dreams... 'NeverAwake' is a nightmarish twin-stick shooter with a unique worldview and original game rules.

games.title: Dungeon Dreams 2
games.shortDescription: Roguelike Romance JRPG. Create your character and get a room at the Magic Academy dormitory, to win the Challenge of the Infinite Dungeon! A game with town building, relationships, and many quests with alternate routes.

games.title: Inout
games.shortDescription: INOUT is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players. For years, the locals have been afraid of an old mansion in Madyland. A possessed maniac and an ancient evil have settled here. Become a member of a team of exorcists and expel the evil force!

games.title: Franchise Hockey Manager 10
games.shortDescription: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2023-24 season with plenty of additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup®.

games.title: Call of Sentinels
games.shortDescription: An innovative blend of Bullet Hell and Survival elements, high dynamics, variable builds, arena competition with players from around the world. Beautiful hand-drawn graphics. Twitch integration for streamers, allowing viewers to influence gameplay.

games.title: Akai Onna
games.shortDescription: Akai Onna | 赤い女 is a psychological J-horror game featuring a student.

games.title: NightClub Simulator
games.shortDescription: seduce girl or get into fight, you can do anythings in virtual night club that you can't do in real life.

games.title: Hot And Lovely ：Dream
games.shortDescription: Hot And Lovely: Dream is a classic match-3 casual game. Players need to move blocks to eliminate three or more prescribed tiles to complete the goal, and each level needs to be controlled within the specified number of steps. If it exceeds the number, the game will fail!

games.title: BOSSGARD
games.shortDescription: WHO’S THE BOSS? It’s finally you! One big, bad, player-controlled Boss goes against a team of Vikings, each with special abilities. Enter BOSSGARD, a hectic 1v2, 1v3, up to 1v5 bossfight multiplayer game in which you get to crush your friends as THE BOSS.

games.title: Lumberhill
games.shortDescription: A crazy multiplayer party game in which lumberjacks try to complete tasks with nature fighting them every step of the way. Race against the clock, fight wildfires, pirates, and extremely annoying monkeys as you travel around the world and through time. Play online/local co-op and pvp or play solo.

games.title: Smelter
games.shortDescription: You are Eve, fresh out of Eden and armed with a living suit of armor, Smelter. Explore a dangerous new world, battle its bizarre denizens and expand your empire in a desperate journey to find Adam.

games.title: Natsuki Chronicles
games.shortDescription: New dramatic horizontal shoot ’em up that takes place in the same setting as Ginga Force. An immersive story that follows protagonist Natsuki. Discover the story of her past as a rookie pilot up to present day with events that are parallel to those in Ginga Force.

games.title: Related
games.shortDescription: Waking up from a nightmare, Jessica finds confirmation to her suspicions. To figure out her past, she goes to an orphanage, where she hopes to find answers to questions that she tried so hard to forget.

games.title: Way To Yaatra
games.shortDescription: Get aboard on a thrilling voyage in search of the truth after the desolation of your village, using spears to climb a huge mountain while you walk the way to Yaatra.

games.title: Diluvian Ultra
games.shortDescription: Diluvian Ultra is a single-player, first-person shooter focusing on a retro aesthetic and fast-paced, strategic combat. The game is set in its own expansive fictive universe. Rather than gritty or dark, Diluvian Ultra is colorful and fantastical, like the cover of pulp sci-fi novels of the past.

games.title: Thermo Sudoku
games.shortDescription: How does Thermo Sudoku work? Each sudoku grid contains thermometer shapes (often drawn to create themes) and digits on thermometers must increase as one moves further from the bulb end.

games.title: Escape from Kyoto House
games.shortDescription: Your party finds themselves trapped in a Japanese-themed room. Solve puzzles, crack riddles and discover hidden secrets in your adventure to Escape from Kyoto House!

games.title: Space Court
games.shortDescription: As a newly appointed Judge, you will rule over Space Court and its denizens to keep the universe safe. Or possibly blow it all up. Either way, you’re tenured.

games.title: Defold
games.shortDescription: Defold is a free and open game engine used for development of desktop, mobile and web games.

games.title: Turbo Sliders Unlimited
games.shortDescription: Driving game with Unlimited possibilities. Spiritual successor to classic top-down racing games, but in 3D with modern online features, countless game modes and extensive moddability. For casual fun, serious competition, or to unleash your creativity with the editors.

games.title: Zapling Bygone
games.shortDescription: Zapling Bygone is a twisted metroidvania where you murder your foes and steal their abilities by wearing their skulls and absorbing their consciousness into your hive-mind.

games.title: Two Strikes
games.shortDescription: Dive into the heart of ancient Japan in Two Strikes, a 2D combat extravaganza with breathtaking hand-drawn animations. As a fearless samurai, warrior monk, or daring outlaw, engage in electrifying duels where every strike can be your last.

games.title: Ed-0: Zombie Uprising
games.shortDescription: 'Oedo x Zombie x Rogue-like' A rogue-like action where traditional Japanese characters (Samurai, Sumo Wrestler, and Ninja) destroy hordes of zombies. Since everything is randomly generated, no run will be the same. Decision making will be essential but there are some RPG elements as well.

games.title: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden
games.shortDescription: The second game in the unique Voice of Cards series, where all elements are presented entirely through the medium of cards, in the tradition of tabletop RPGs and gamebooks.

games.title: Gobby McGobblenutz Presents: The Art of the Dad Joke: Chapter 1
games.shortDescription: Gobby McGobblenutz is just your run of the mill Goblin trying to make some friends in a dark, lonely world... Will you be his friend? Or will his cringe-inducing jokes push you too far over the edge? Come find out on The Art of the Dad Joke!

games.title: Space Reign
games.shortDescription: An indie space-sim and strategy game featuring ship and fleet combat mixed with RTS elements. Complete contracts and Claim sectors for your faction in the near-future, where resource exploiting corporations are in a state of constant conflict over territory control.

games.title: SPACE ACCIDENT
games.shortDescription: Your hero is Andy Freeman, a technical engineer of the Zeus-M700 spacecraft, sent on an expedition to the satellite of Jupiter to colonize it. However, what is conceived does not always go according to plan…

games.title: DIRECT CONTACT
games.shortDescription: Direct Contact is about Authentic Warfare, First-person Tactical realism experiences. Most weapons are in the same specs for each classification today, making most modern combat asymmetrical.

games.title: HOTEL GREENWOOD
games.shortDescription: Hotel Greenwood is a psychological horror and thriller game played with a first-person camera. Explore this mysterious hotel with its intense and dark atmosphere, solve the events and witness the story behind the disaster that happened in the past.

games.title: Snow Plowing Simulator
games.shortDescription: Experience the serene joy of snow plowing in this relaxing simulation game! Drive powerful plows, clear roads, and keep your town safe. Uncover a surprising story, face survival challenges, and tackle advanced weather systems. Embrace winter's chill and become the ultimate snow-clearing hero!

games.title: Tower Walker: MMO Grind Simulator
games.shortDescription: Tower Walker is a fresh new type of addictive semi-idle auto-grinder rich with features, inspired by classic MMORPGS and RTS games with indirect control over your hero. The mysterious tower awaits!

games.title: Pocky & Rocky Reshrined
games.shortDescription: The original cute and hardcore shrine maiden shooter is now available on Steam! Completely new game, a sequel to the home original 'Pocky Rocky' (Super Nintendo Entertainment System)! The adventures of Pocky Rocky begin once again.

games.title: I, the Forgotten One
games.shortDescription: To defeat the rebel knights and stabilize the crown, you must journey through the most dangerous realm in the kingdom--your own wretched past.

games.title: THE MEME HUNTER
games.shortDescription: THE MEME HUNTER is a dynamic first–person shooter in which you will exterminate crowds of evil memes. They're everywhere. They're out for your blood. They will follow you wherever you go…

games.title: Cafe Master Story
games.shortDescription: Serve up food, drinks, and smiles in this retro cafe management sim!

games.title: Night Bus
games.shortDescription: Night Bus is a thrilling public transit simulator that costs less than a bus ticket! It's your first night on the job: Pick up passengers, take their fares, enjoy the beautiful countryside, and please ignore That Which Has No Eyes.

games.title: GUNHEAD
games.shortDescription: Gunhead is a fast paced strategic roguelike FPS where you take the role of a pirate mech with a gun for a head, looting derelict spaceships filled with monstrous drones made out of bone and steel. Sequel to the 2d roguelite Cryptark.

games.title: RUGBY 20
games.shortDescription: Rugby 20 gives you the complete rugby experience! With overhauled tactics management, optimised graphics and more realistic player behaviour, the game is a true reflection of modern rugby.

games.title: Urban Tale
games.shortDescription: Urban Tale is a realistic, vibrant and unique RPG that will allow you to fulfil your dreams, and pursue your most wanted goals in life. You start from scratch, having nothing in the city where you can meet a lot of people, that can help you throughout your adventure. Your goal is to succeed in life.

games.title: Project Exhibited
games.shortDescription: A thrilling first-person action-stealth game. Play as Dana, the inventor thief, and use your gadgets to fulfill your task; retrieving a special artifact from a private art collection in a mysterious palazzo.

games.title: Fifo's Night
games.shortDescription: Fifo’s Night is a 3D puzzle-platformer set in and around an enchanted, sprawling mansion. Explore elaborate rooms within, find hidden collectibles, fight a variety of monsters, and solve puzzles in an exciting game for all audiences.

games.title: Vagrus - The Riven Realms: Demo (Prologue)
games.shortDescription: Embark on a perilous journey across a realm forsaken by the gods and devastated by an arcane cataclysm. Accompanied by a hardy crew, you must trade, fight, and explore your way to success as the leader of a traveling company in Vagrus, an award-winning turn-based post-apocalyptic fantasy RPG.

games.title: Promesa
games.shortDescription: A contemplative experience where you’ll wander through the dreams, memories and fantasies emerging from a dialogue between a grandfather and his grandchild.

games.title: INPUT6
games.shortDescription: INPUT6 is a short, fast-paced, first-person horror game. Search through the abandoned robot factory avoiding malfunctioning robot by instantly switching between playing in separate sections of the facility. Figure out what led to the company's collapse. Be quick! You don’t have much time.

games.title: Fallen Leaf
games.shortDescription: Fallen Leaf is a retro side-scrolling adventure focused on tight, action-packed level design set in a whimsical world where almost anything goes!

games.title: Grandiose
games.shortDescription: Grandiose is a calming and creative base builder game full of botany, building and strategy. Land on the island that will become your domain in a universe soon to be borrowed from the ingenious and creative abilities of your mind.

games.title: MAKOTO WAKAIDO’s Case Files TRILOGY DELUXE
games.shortDescription: A game based on a simple concept: a mystery puzzle you can complete in an hour. Can you solve the cases narrated in this beautiful pixel-art adventure?

games.title: Heal Hitler
games.shortDescription: POV: You are Hitler’s psychologist in 1925. Diagnose his complexes by using both Jungian and Freudian psychotherapy and attempt to heal him. Resolve Hitler's trauma and prevent catastrophe via therapy and psychology. Succeed and avoid the war and holocaust.

games.title: Sparkling Memories
games.shortDescription: 欢迎走进柿树学园，这座全市瞩目的学习殿堂。与同学们齐心协力，办好这里历史悠久的「烟火大会」的重任，即将被你背负在肩上。从高一至高二，在这段有笑有泪的时光中，你将收获毕生难忘的友情与成长。

games.title: Skator Gator 3D
games.shortDescription: Stop the mayor from polluting the swamp in this short, 3D adventure! Explore new open locales with skateboard in hand or while grinding on pipelines — Greenjamin's skating into the third dimension in SKATOR GATOR 3D!

games.title: EarthRoyale
games.shortDescription: EarthRoyale is a Map simulation Observer game where the game each turn chooses one of many events to edit the world map

games.title: Nebula
games.shortDescription: Survive in the deep void of the galaxy against thousands of invaders! Nebula is a challenging bullet hell, twin stick shooter where you have to face endless waves of space enemies. Additional map resources and space drones can provide you a support but be wary, they can as well become a deadly trap.

games.title: MISTROGUE: Mist and the Living Dungeons
games.shortDescription: MISTROGUE is a 'Mystery Dungeon' style real-time action JRPG. Explore an ever-changing 'Living Dungeon'. Fight through the monster hordes and gimmicks with your own skill builds while paving your path with 'Maze Stone'!

games.title: Drift racing car
games.shortDescription: This is a racing game that can drift flexibly. You can make your own game vehicles, vehicle hubs and friction smoke. Multi vehicle viewing angle, arbitrary switching

games.title: Tokyo Necro
games.shortDescription: The Earth has plunged into an ice age, and the cities that survive have a new threat – Necromancers; those who reanimate corpses using inexplicable biotech. Now So'un and Ethica, two badass Living Dead Stalkers, must save Tokyo in this thrilling sci-fi visual novel!

games.title: SUKUR
games.shortDescription: ŞÜKÜR, It is a horror-thriller game with a first-person story. From the moment you enter the game, you will feel that you are alone in the forest and you will try every way to escape.

games.title: Tram Simulator Urban Transit
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Tram Simulator Urban Transit - get on aboard! In this game, you take on the role of a tram driver and manager. Drive 6 tram models. Transport passengers and drive them to the numerous stops. Plan your own routes, manage your timetables, and expand your tram network.

games.title: Backwoods Town
games.shortDescription: Backwoods town is an atmospheric forest survival simulator. Build your base, grow crops, fight bosses and rebuild the destroyed settlement, finding all its inhabitants along the way.

games.title: Chushpan Simulator 2
games.shortDescription: On their way from Ugryupinsk, Egor and Nastya find themselves caught in the middle of a conflict between two gangs — the Pavers and the Glaziers. Egor must find common ground with the Glaziers, deal with the Pavers, and rescue Nastya

games.title: Super Arcade Football
games.shortDescription: Super Arcade Football is a fast-paced, modern take on classic football games that's easy to learn and hard to master, with match modifiers, online and local multiplayer, and custom tournaments, every match is sure to be a nail-biter!

games.title: Capsa
games.shortDescription: Capsa combines exploration with a strong social component. It features a large, rich open-world that players can explore and discover together with other players and friends.

games.title: Red Ronin
games.shortDescription: Red Ronin is a Turn-based but fast paced dash 'n slash game where a bloodthirsty ronin and her companion bot search for revenge.

games.title: Tennis World Tour 2
games.shortDescription: Play as the world's top players, master each surface, perfect your game and strive to dominate the world circuit. Choose from multiple game modes, with singles and doubles games, local and online.

games.title: HereSphere VR Video Player
games.shortDescription: HereSphere is a cutting edge VR video player that enhances immersion. Features include an autofocus depth algorithm, software IPD adjustment, head-tracking, spatial audio, lens distortion and alignment corrections, online video streaming, and video tagging with advanced search features.

games.title: からかい上手の高木さんVR 1学期
games.shortDescription: Virtually experience the playful and relentless teasing of heroine, Takagi-san, in Teasing Master Takagi-san VR - 1st Semester (Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san VR). With sales of the original comic series exceeding 8.2 million copies in Japan, the romantic comedy makes its debut on as a VR animation.

games.title: Lair Land Story
games.shortDescription: Decide a mysterious girl's fate in this stunning visual novel raising sim!

games.title: Deskmate Girl
games.shortDescription: Can you become a perfect boyfriend and let your girlfriend open her heart to you?

games.title: Putin kills: Coronavirus
games.shortDescription: Great showdown 2020: COVID-19 vs BIGCOCK-19

games.title: Lawnmower Game: Next Generation
games.shortDescription: New low poly version for legendary saga. New different unlocked mowers. Be a king of Lawnmowers and cut all grass with all mowers

games.title: Cyberwar: Neon City
games.shortDescription: Explore a cyberpunk universe where monkeys rule. Challenge the fearsome Cyber Monkeys as you take on the role of a hero armed with a living shark weapon.

games.title: [ECHOSTASIS]
games.shortDescription: THE AWARD-WINNING CONCLUSION TO THE [ENIGMA] TRILOGY, [ECHOSTASIS] presents a world where our reality is not only curated by algorithms, but created by them.

games.title: Nuclear War Simulator
games.shortDescription: Nuclear war simulator is a detailed realistic simulation and visualization of large-scale nuclear conflicts with a focus on humanitarian consequences. It lets you design conflict scenarios and estimate the consequences using a population density map and realistic weapons effects.

games.title: Horror Night
games.shortDescription: A new multiplayer, third-person, horror experience: Escape from an appaling environment by solving different puzzles with the help of your friends, and hiding from a hideous monster... or maybe becoming one ;) Unlock new maps, cosmetics and skins with the new Horror Night DLCs

games.title: Esports History
games.shortDescription: Esports History is an RPG sim where you start as a regular guy, and work your way up to the very top of esports. Defeat bosses in tournaments, make a name for yourself within the esports community, and become a real pro!

games.title: Star Stuff
games.shortDescription: Star Stuff is a deceptively cute programming puzzle game. Program and work alongside bots to tackle the most important (and undoubtedly safest) task in the galaxy: fixing a star factory. Ready for your first day on the job?

games.title: CORPUS EDAX
games.shortDescription: An immersive first-person-melee RPG where you create your character and fight, talk or sneak your way out of confrontation. From concrete buildings to futuristic environments - start from the bottom and make your way through narrative missions to the top of the city in a bid for control.

games.title: Bughouse
games.shortDescription: Play as Christopher, a kid left home alone with a terrifying STALKER on the loose! Try and survive in this 80's, PS1 inspired, Home Invasion Survival Horror game - OR DIE TRYING!

games.title: ENTROPOLY
games.shortDescription: ENTROPOLY is a time-trial platformer inspired by platform fighters. Wavedash into the psychedelic realms of the elements and help Poly fight chaos to restore balance.

games.title: Pinball Spire
games.shortDescription: Action adventure meets pinball in this one-of-a-kind pinballvania adventure. When a mysterious spire appears from thin air, it's up to an intrepid pinball to bump, spin, shoot, and flip its way to the top and solve the tower’s mysteries!

games.title: Hitchhiker - A Mystery Game
games.shortDescription: Hitchhiker is a mystery game set along lost highways, where your goal is to solve the puzzle of your own backstory.

games.title: Degraman: Act I. Vincent
games.shortDescription: An otome visual novel - play a powerless victim of a terrifying, unfair world. 200+ choices, 50+ endings, 20+ hours of play - and only one way to escape.

games.title: 36 apples
games.shortDescription: Collect apples and uncover the secrets of a self-contained world.

games.title: ArchiTac
games.shortDescription: Stranded on a deserted planet, you must explore and gather resources to craft buildings so that TAC can find and repair his spaceship.

games.title: Monster Truck Championship
games.shortDescription: A true Monster Truck simulation! A unique and challenging motor racing experience where local or online victory depends solely on your driving skills. 16 customizable trucks, 25 arenas and 3 leagues to win to become champion!

games.title: The Dawn of Art
games.shortDescription: Explore the Chauvet Cave 36,000 years ago, with Daisy Ridley’s voice as your guide. It’s in the Ardèche gorges, in the south of France, that our ancestors drew humanity’s first masterpieces, giving life to their beliefs. Maybe you will also meet the cave bear…

games.title: The Highrise
games.shortDescription: THE HIGHRISE is a first-person survival game set in a high-rise building that has been sealed off by an alien monster invasion. Gather resources to make fighting weapons and survival tools. You must find and send a rescue signal at the end of your desperate survival.

games.title: The Door in the Basement
games.shortDescription: The Door in the Basement is an atmospheric pixelated horror game set in a mysterious subterranean world.

games.title: Godstrike
games.shortDescription: Godstrike is a twin-stick shooter where time is your health and currency. Face off against ruthless bosses in tense, 1v1 showdowns as Talaal, the last Herald.

games.title: Cute Cats
games.shortDescription: Cute cats want to play with you! Chill out with them in your free time! Find differences between two nearly similar artistic paintings.

games.title: Minesweeper Ultimate
games.shortDescription: Play classic minesweeper or face new challenges in hex and triangular minesweeper modes.

games.title: Bunny Girl Story
games.shortDescription: The girl works in the Bunny Club. She loves to sing songs and dance. But she is alone. However one day there is an opportunity to change everything.

games.title: Super Raft Boat Together
games.shortDescription: The world's been flooded. All you have left is your Super Raft Boat… and your friends! Work together to expand your raft while fending off the strangely violent (and wealthy??) creatures of the sea in this multiplayer roguelike shooter. Will your crew survive and reach the Final Island?

games.title: NO STRANGERS
games.shortDescription: An online horror game of exploration, teamwork and betrayal for 3-15 players.

games.title: The Sojourn
games.shortDescription: The Sojourn is a first-person puzzle game set in an immersive colour-drenched world of light and darkness. Think your way through dozens of puzzles as you traverse parallel worlds, awaken mysterious artifacts and overcome challenging obstacles on an unforgettable journey.

games.title: Starstruck: Hands of Time
games.shortDescription: Starstruck: Hands of Time is a story-rich rhythm adventure game where you play guitar and abuse time travel! Control a giant hand destroying a miniature town, or play as the two guitarist kids living in it. For extra fun, optionally plug in a Guitar Hero controller!

games.title: Doctor Who: The Runaway
games.shortDescription: Step inside the TARDIS with the Doctor in this beautiful, animated, interactive story from the Doctor Who team.

games.title: That Flipping Mountain
games.shortDescription: A physics driven parkour game inspired by 'Getting Over It' and 'Jump King'. Flip, ski, and dive yourself up a massive mountain of stuff. Fall down, rage, get up, shake it off, parkour-on!

games.title: Touhou Mechanical Scrollery | 幻想討幻経
games.shortDescription: A 3D bullet hell mid-air hunting action game based on the Touhou Project. Fly freely through the air and face down humongous foes with both melee action and 3D bullet patterns (Danmaku)!

games.title: Heavenworld
games.shortDescription: Heavenworld is an open world adventure game mixing role playing, survival and management with NPC survivors. Each game is unique and managed by a game master who influences events. A powerful map editor is also available.

games.title: Lightless
games.shortDescription: Lightless: The 21st Sacrifice is the first episode of an atmospheric horror game series set in 2018 Iran, Saqqez that tells the story of Navid, a writer who finally comes home, only to find himself strangled by a dark past that will not let go.

games.title: Lonesome Village
games.shortDescription: Relaxing puzzle-solving and life-sim meet in a cozy, no-combat, coyote adventure. Uncover the mysterious, magical past of Lonesome Village and save this town from the hands of evil.

games.title: HINGE VR
games.shortDescription: HINGE is a psychological horror VR adventure. You suddenly find yourself in an abandoned skyscraper, devoid of all your senses and memories. The laws of physics are distorted, and time has collapsed. The only way out is to step into the terrifying unknown and piece together the fragmented clues

games.title: Alekon
games.shortDescription: Photograph dozens of whimsical creatures, solving puzzles to get them to strike collectable poses! Then befriend them through unique quests and minigames, from snowflake design, to tuning and playing crystal harps, to organizing parties!

games.title: System Purge
games.shortDescription: Trapped in a buried, forgotten facility, you must reach the core of an ancient machine to rescue your lost lover. System Purge is a challenging, atmospheric 2D platformer.

games.title: Underland
games.shortDescription: Use the elements at your disposal, such as excavators, pumps, plumbing, among others, to drill the soil to the indicated location. The dynamic scenario, fluid mechanics and the laws of physics must be manipulated correctly to achieve the goal. Find the city of Underland!

games.title: Glyph☀️
games.shortDescription: Glyph is a cute, physics-based adventure starring a mech-scarab and his trusted guide, Anobi, challenged with rebuilding an ancient civilization buried under the desert sand. Jump, double-jump, smash and glide through the air in this vertical platformer with amazing controls.

games.title: Undernauts: Labyrinth of Yomi
games.shortDescription: Escape from “Yomi” – a dungeon filled with riches – and danger. Make use of your powerful skills and magic items to create exits and reach the surface alive.

games.title: Toroom
games.shortDescription: Toroom is a dungeon crawler roguelike-like top-down shooter, where the protagonist just wants to come back to his bedroom after waking up in a world of fantasy. Fight your way through multiple biomes, clear rooms full of enemies, get as much loot as possible and defeat the bosses in your way.

games.title: Tell Some Story: Foz
games.shortDescription: Action-adventure + Third person shooter. The year is 2042, the near future, the gloomy world of cyberpunk will offer you the role of detective Foz. Random circumstances drag the hero into a showdown between gangs and corporations, where he has to make a choice on whose side he is.

games.title: Bean and Nothingness
games.shortDescription: A difficult tile-based puzzle game about turning beans into monsters -- and monsters back into beans.

games.title: SBK™22
games.shortDescription: Saddle up your Superbike and show what you’re made of while racing in the official 2022 WorldSBK™. After ten years, SBK™ returns with a title more immersive and engaging than ever!

games.title: Oxide Room 104
games.shortDescription: A bone-chilling body-horror game with escape room gameplay. Bad decisions have brought Matthew to this terrifying motel. Now it’s up to you to decide how to escape - will you make it out alive?

games.title: Automon
games.shortDescription: Fast-paced auto-battler. Fight, capture and upgrade Automons, build a diverse party, battle bad Bosses and become the Automon Champion!

games.title: Touhou Genso Wanderer -FORESIGHT-
games.shortDescription: Delve into the latest chapter of the Genso Wanderer Series, Touhou Genso Wanderer - FORESIGHT - a brand new dungeon crawler RPG adventure set in the Touhou universe.

games.title: Thunder Ray
games.shortDescription: Thunder Ray is Arcade-Boxing, Retro-like gameplay with blood and violence. Defeat all the best fighters in the galaxy to become the GOAT of the universe.

games.title: RGB Rush
games.shortDescription: How accurately can you recreate a random colour? Forget using a colour picker, learn to form hex codes in your mind. Impress your crush. Prove your abilities under the clock, blindfolded. Practice today.

games.title: Escape From Lavender Island
games.shortDescription: Escape from Lavender Island is a 3rd person open world exploration game. Follow Zede Aksis as he wakes up from a dream about a city only to realize that what he saw in his sleep is a physical reality he cannot find a way out of.

games.title: Beam Eye Tracker
games.shortDescription: Turn your webcam into an AI-powered head eye tracker and ditch the bulky tracking hardware. Enable gaming extensions like OpenTrack for immersive eye and head tracking. Gain insights and improve your gameplay using the eye tracking overlay or enhance your live streams.

games.title: Midnight Scenes: A Safe Place
games.shortDescription: Phil's life has crumbled to dust. The four walls of his room have become his safe haven. He yearns for sleep...but terrible nightmares haunt him. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.

games.title: DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia
games.shortDescription: Play as Shido and unravel the secrets of the mysterious spirit Ren in the visual novel follow-up to DATE A LIVE: Rio Reincarnation, based on the acclaimed light novel and anime series.

games.title: Blackthorn Arena: Reforged
games.shortDescription: Re-experience the thrill and challenges of managing a Gladiator arena in this management/simulation game. With new content, new graphics, Quality of Life updates, and all DLCs packed into this new experience, this is how Blackthorn Arena was meant to be experienced.

games.title: Hollow's Land
games.shortDescription: Hollow's Land is relaxing game where you kill skeletons of fire who are trying to put out your bonfire. Throwing snowballs under the northern lights.

games.title: Catch Me If You Can
games.shortDescription: Chase your friends in this heart-racing 'Tag' based game. Use a grappling hook and bouncy physics to your advantage. Features proximity voice chat.

games.title: Crush the Industry
games.shortDescription: Work your way to the top of a cutthroat game studio in this retro roguelike deckbuilder! Crush the Industry features strategic combat with a unique twist and deep replayability.

games.title: Kristala
games.shortDescription: Kristala is a dark fantasy ARPG featuring Sekiro-inspired combat, acrobatic parkour, and exploration to uncover a detailed, dark story. Embark on a thrilling journey as you battle mutated monsters, undead foes, and tortured spirits to uncover the source of a mysterious, all-consuming curse.

games.title: Ashina: The Red Witch
games.shortDescription: Join Ash on the journey of an afterlife-time! Travel through a mysterious spirit world filled with strange creatures, interesting characters, and memorable moments! Ash must find her way back home and save her sister from the powers that be.

games.title: Nearly Dead
games.shortDescription: Nearly Dead is a 2D open world survival game. It's a game about survivors who try to remain alive in a situation where demons from a different dimension have turned most humans into zombies.

games.title: vrkshop
games.shortDescription: vrkshop is a VR woodworking game. You are challenged to build projects with hand tools without snap-to-guides or limits on how to cut or fasten the lumber. The precision of your project is left entirely up to you. Have fun. Be productive.

games.title: Purplis Sandbox
games.shortDescription: Create your own worlds, build interesting mechanisms and just beautiful buildings, everything depends on your imagination.

games.title: Return
games.shortDescription: Return to your home planet after 200 years of space travel in this atmospheric, art-driven adventure. Shoot, slash, and roll your way through dangerous enemies and ancient bosses, purchase items and unlock powerful weapons, and explore your unfamiliar home for parts to repair your ship.

games.title: Beyond Galaxyland
games.shortDescription: Beyond Galaxyland is a thrilling adventure-RPG combining cosmic exploration, strategic turn-based combat, and epic boss battle events across a vast solar system. Join Doug and his gun-toting guinea pig on an exhilarating quest to save Earth, itself.

games.title: SNK VS. CAPCOM: THE MATCH OF THE MILLENNIUM
games.shortDescription: Back in 1999, SNK and CAPCOM brought their best fighters together for a fighting game extravaganza! The dream collaboration that can fit in your hands can now be enjoyed on Steam!

games.title: Smart Factory Tycoon
games.shortDescription: Smart Factory Tycoon inspired by Little Big Workshop is a tycoon management game about running your dream factory with robots. Design your dream factory, plan all steps of production, research new technologies and become a tycoon!

games.title: Christmas Celebration With Sakuya Izayoi
games.shortDescription: Celebrate Christmas with Sakuya Izayoi from the Touhou Project in this cozy visual novel! Explore the colourful sights of the human village in Gensokyo as it hosts a one of a kind festival with several venues and gorgeous sights to see!

games.title: Salty Hounds
games.shortDescription: A unique dating sim adventure that gives you total freedom to romance five handsome guys in an open-world metropolis.

games.title: Pocket Academy
games.shortDescription: Make your dream school in this management simulation game! School got you down?

games.title: Kamaeru: A Frog Refuge
games.shortDescription: Foster a sanctuary for frogs and restore the biodiversity of the wetlands in Kamaeru, a cozy frog collecting game, where you take pictures of frogs, play mini-games and decorate your habitat. Hop right to it!

games.title: RUSLICSTAN INVADES
games.shortDescription: Save Ukraine from swamp hordes of savages in this First Person Horde-Shooter!

games.title: Merchant of the Six Kingdoms
games.shortDescription: Become a medieval merchant and master the arts of bartering, haggling, and investing, Explore 20 markets, barter with 200 characters, and trade in over 1,800 items in a dynamic bartering and haggling system that will challenge and reward.

games.title: Giants Uprising
games.shortDescription: Giants Uprising is a medieval fantasy action adventure game full of Giants and unlimited destruction! Take on the role of a powerful Giant who finally breaks free from enslavement to seek revenge on the ruthless human race.

games.title: Before I Forget
games.shortDescription: A woman alone in a house. A mystery and a love story. Explore the present to uncover the past, in a short story of love and loss and a life well-lived. A narrative exploration game that examines a world where memories are constantly fading and jumbled.

games.title: The Warmth Between Us
games.shortDescription: It is late December in Taipei. The pavement glows like silver under the winter rain. That's when we met for the first time. The warmth between us has a certain comfort that I’ve never felt before.

games.title: Mask of Mists
games.shortDescription: Mask of Mists is an action-adventure game in a first-person view in which you are immersed in exploring the world full of magic and dangers!

games.title: Skully
games.shortDescription: On a mysterious remote island, a skull washes up on shore and is reawakened by an enigmatic deity. Dubbed Skully, the newly reanimated being has been summoned to intervene in a war between the deity’s three siblings, whose quarrel jeopardizes the island they call home.

games.title: Electro Ride Prologue
games.shortDescription: Racing neon cars from the former Eastern Bloc. Start at the Berlin Wall. The first routes and quick race mode will give you a taste of the Electro Ride competition. Neon lights, superfast, unique, classic, iconic cars. Get crazy about colorful streets!

games.title: Dead Event
games.shortDescription: Dead Event is a indie RPG survival game in which the player grows up as a creature. The creature will grow bigger overtime and with interactions in-game also lose some growth on death. Form a colony or hunt alone, become part of a player-created ecosystem. Survive, eat or be eaten...

games.title: Don't Cheat On Me
games.shortDescription: Don’t Cheat on me is a multiplayer game where players play as the Husband, the Wife or the Neighbour, trying to dominate this marriage.

games.title: Bish Bash Bots
games.shortDescription: Bish Bash Bots is a unique mix of casual tower defense strategy and all-out brawling action. Team up in couch co-op / online play or go it alone and fight to save the world by building upgradable turrets, unlocking gadgets and bashing bots with giant hammers.

games.title: Lady in Mystery
games.shortDescription: Welcome to the detective agency in old Seoul. This visual novel provides unique mystery and lesbian romance. Players can choose which one of 4 female characters will be the closest to the main character, 'Heesoo.' Some of your choices might lead you to a dark and dangerous path.

games.title: Secret Agent HD
games.shortDescription: Return to the remote island classic world of rewards and traps in the HD remake of Secret Agent! Guide 006 through puzzles arcade challenges of your favorite missions, then uncover the whole new Episode loaded with all new puzzles, enemies, challenges, hazards help 006 finally defeat DVS!

games.title: Pnevmo-Capsula: Domiki
games.shortDescription: «Pnevmo-Capsula: Domiki». Atompunk world gone the way of the cumbersome automation of the USSR. In the form of a mechanical capsule, you will have to find a way out of the level, moving along the rails, solving quests and puzzles, overcoming houses, towers and platforms.

games.title: Hell of an Office
games.shortDescription: Hell of an Office is a 3D precision platformer in first-person view that combines action and speedrunning as you try to escape HellO, the most infernal office in the (under)world! Be quick, use your stapler to rocket jump and dash. Can you escape before the lava catches up to you?

games.title: Artist Life Simulator
games.shortDescription: Live the life of a starving artist in 19th century alternative history. Survive poverty, alchoholism, madness, depression, and 67 different feelings. Paint masterpieces by combining inspirations, sell them for riches (or scraps) and create a painting that will change the world.

games.title: Archmage Ricka
games.shortDescription: In order to retrieve the illegal property embezzled by the evil Lord, Ricka received a mission to capture the Lord. But it was a trap. She fell into a dungeon arranged by the Lord in advance. Although the demons in the dungeon are weak, the existence of various traps makes it difficult to escape!

games.title: Sakura Hime 4
games.shortDescription: Adorable nekomimi, enchanting sorceresses, and stunning girls from a different realm have enveloped you. Aim to be the most devoted caretaker and have a wonderful vacation with them!

games.title: Trap of MUSK:Europe Night
games.shortDescription: An exotic love story set in the land of hot sand. The target, who has never truly loved a woman. And the client, who loves women in a twisted way. How will you manage between these two? Who is it that destroys the sacrifice of thirsty love--?

games.title: IfSunSets
games.shortDescription: 「IfSunSets」 is a survival RPG adventure game. During the day, secure necessary supplies across the island, and survive the night against strong and terrifying monsters that track you down. You can utilize resources you've secured to build a base to fend off threatening monsters.

games.title: Mareld
games.shortDescription: Mareld is a card-driven Roguelike role-playing game where you play as a traveler lost in the Lost Forest. You will recruit companions, collect resources, craft items, explore the world, defeat enemies, find your way back home, or uncover the secrets of this extraordinary world.

games.title: Geneforge 2 - Infestation
games.shortDescription: Wildly open-ended adventure in a unique fantasy world. Use battle or diplomacy and trickery to change the world, served by an army of custom-made mutant monsters. Almost 90 zones to explore and 50+ hours of gameplay. Enormous range of abilities, factions, quests, and paths to victory.

games.title: Don't Shout Together
games.shortDescription: If you scream, you and your entire team will die. You need to leave the dangerous forest before the timer runs out by either assembling a car or calling the police. If the set time expires, the entire team will perish. Time progresses when you move. Don't make the team wait for you!

games.title: To Be In Love With Girls Group
games.shortDescription: 'To Be Love With Girls Group' is the world's first real-life interactive video game for nurturing girl groups, produced by 'Guanghe Media'. Game players will take on the role of a girl group agent from the first perspective in the game to search for and discover girl group trainees

games.title: Ten Bells
games.shortDescription: You're trapped in an old English pub. Unravel a chilling tale by identifying anomalies while trying to escape. Confront the horror as you survive Ten Bells's endless loop.

games.title: Fly Punch Boom!
games.shortDescription: The WILDEST ANIME FIGHT. Fly super fast, smash your friends through skyscrapers and break the planet with one punch! Up to 4 players local 2 online. Now with workshop for INFINITE CHARACTERS!

games.title: ROBOTICS;NOTES DaSH
games.shortDescription: Half a year after the events of ROBOTICS;NOTES ELITE, Kaito Yashio is introduced to Itaru Hashida through Nae Tennouji. Unsettling incidents start occurring all around them, harbingers of an event that will again plunge the world into chaos.

games.title: CyberCorp
games.shortDescription: Brutal fast-paced isometric Co-op Loot Shooter in Cyberpunk world. Equipment-based combos. Exotic Weapons and Armor. Easy to start, hard to master. Play solo or with friends.

games.title: VR Giants
games.shortDescription: VR Giants is a local coop VR game in which one VR player and one gamepad player work together. The VR player controls a giant and must protect and support the tiny player who is controlled by the screen player. The tiny player can use the body of the giant as an extension of the level.

games.title: Radical Rabbit Stew
games.shortDescription: Radical Rabbit Stew is a hare-raising action-arcade game, featuring fast-paced whack-a-rabbit gameplay, scintillating puzzles, super-sized boss fights, juicy pixel graphics and a sizzling soundtrack, perfect for new players and 16-bit retro fans alike!

games.title: Rebirth Online
games.shortDescription: Adventures await in a world brought to life by realistic graphics! Experience genuine adventures in the grand world of Rebirth Online. Battle, craft, explore, and combine different types of equipment and abilities to create your own style of play.

games.title: Desecrators
games.shortDescription: Desecrators is a retro FPS inspired by '90s six-degrees-of-freedom shooters. Plunder your way through the galaxy to destructive weapons and technology powerful enough to take on the ultimate heist: The legendary vaults of the Galactic Treasury.

games.title: Viticulture Essential Edition
games.shortDescription: This is the official digital adaption of the boardgame Viticulture by Jamey Stegmaier Alan Stone.

games.title: Kapital: Sparks of Revolution
games.shortDescription: Sandbox economic simulation game about class struggle. European country is in a deep crisis. You are the mayor of the capital. Social unrest is inevitable. What price will you pay to save your people from anarchy?

games.title: Heroes of the Three Kingdoms 4
games.shortDescription: 《三国群英传IV》是由奥汀科技研发的一款即时战略类游戏，是三国群英传系列的第四作。玩家将在游戏中重历三国时代，指挥武将驰骋于华夏神州大地之上，征战于天南地北之间，平定乱世，以一统中原为目标，最终建立属于自己的英雄事业。

games.title: Graze Counter GM
games.shortDescription: A refreshing and highly re-playable bullet hell style shooter that WANTS you to play dangerously! Ride the razor's edge of life and death in this high-risk high-reward danger oriented arcade style shooting game.

games.title: Clip maker
games.shortDescription: Get a cool tool bundle for creating 4K 360 degree video, up to 8K video clips, movies, animation, image art, visual novels, stories, manga, comics, wallpapers or just have a fun making characters behave as you would like. Specially created for amateurs and artists to bring your stories to life.

games.title: 100 hidden cups
games.shortDescription: The strange cups are hidden on the paper. A difficult adventure for the eyes.

games.title: Souls of White Star
games.shortDescription: Souls of White Star is a sci-fi turn-based card wargame Roguelike strategy game. The different design of [double-sided technology moving cards] and [bandwidth draw cost] will test your judgment and decision more!

games.title: Delivery INC
games.shortDescription: Delivery INC is a fast-paced time management game where you’ll be challenged with quick decision making and planning. Build a fleet of vehicles and drivers. Make deliveries before the customer’s patience runs out. Put your logic and delivery skills to the test in any real-world city.

games.title: Mimicry
games.shortDescription: Monster vs. human squad in a sci-fi multiplayer online horror game!

games.title: Space Prison
games.shortDescription: Survive the galaxy's toughest prison and rise to the top of a space gang! Explore, fight, craft, trade and learn convicts' stories to escape the facility. Space Prison is a turn-based tactical survival game with deep strategy and social RPG elements.

games.title: A Fisherman's Tale 2
games.shortDescription: A Fisherman's Tale 2, sequel to the award-winning A Fisherman's Tale, is a new mind-bending VR puzzle-adventure. A poetic story with unique VR puzzle mechanics. Detach, Replace and Control your hands, solve puzzles, explore new locations and discover the truth.

games.title: Basements n' Basilisks: Storms of Sorcery
games.shortDescription: A visual novel paying satirical homage to the world’s greatest TTRPG. Make important choices, roll countless dice, build lasting relationships, explore magical lands and experience all the rest of the crap you expect from a fantasy game without the hassle of finding actual friends to play with!

games.title: Crab God
games.shortDescription: Crab God is an atmospheric underwater strategy game. Guide your Crabling colony through wild ocean depths, and defend the egg of the next Crab God.Restore and protect diverse coral reefs, making a difference in the real world as you progress in-game. Make waves, praise the claw!

games.title: Operation: Polygon Storm
games.shortDescription: A fastpaced, military tug-of-war game with minimal micromanagement. Choose and deploy from a mix of specialized military units to overwhelm the enemy. Experiment with a huge variety of unit compositions, synergies, abilities, and upgrades to lead your army to victory!

games.title: Radiant Silvergun
games.shortDescription: Set on the earth and in space on July 14, 2520 A.D., the film explores the mystery of mankind's extinction. Various terrains become battlefields. Enemies attack from all directions. There are 23 bosses in total. Aim for a high score by making full use of score bonuses and level-up weapons!

games.title: Joy Life 2
games.shortDescription: In the game, players need to find two cards with the same picture and successfully eliminate them. If the cards on the flop are inconsistent, no changes will occur. After eliminating all the cards in the picture and entering the next level,

games.title: KAMLA
games.shortDescription: Find a way out of an old mansion as a priest, you have been tasked to exorcise a woman who has been possessed. Solve puzzles and complete objectives to cure her demonic possession in this SURVIVAL HORROR experience.

games.title: Sonar Shock
games.shortDescription: Submarine’s haunted! Hunt and be hunted in this horror dungeon crawler inspired by the decay of the Soviet Union (and immersive RPGs from the 90s).

games.title: Bounty Below
games.shortDescription: Bounty below is an idle adventure game about mining and smithing items. While your units are mining for you delve into the endless dungeon to gain even more ore!

games.title: 3 Minutes to Midnight - A Comedy Graphic Adventure
games.shortDescription: In a race against time, Betty embarks on a thrilling, comedy-packed adventure to crack a conspiracy that starts with a bang and ends at 3 Minutes to Midnight.

games.title: Towaga: Among Shadows
games.shortDescription: Towaga: Among Shadows is a short and intense shoot-em-up game in which you wield the powers of the light to fend off enemies. It's fast-paced, hand-drawn and... free!

games.title: Startup Panic
games.shortDescription: Quit your job and build an exciting startup! Survive the tech bubble, compete with rival CEOs and expand your office from bedroom programmer up to the heights of global corporate sabotage! As long as you don't get hacked... or kidnapped...

games.title: Space Wreck
games.shortDescription: The biggest little RPG in the world. Post-apocalyptic retro space adventure with an extreme focus on role-playing and replayability. Inch wide, miles deep - intentionally short yet surprisingly deep.

games.title: Urban Cards
games.shortDescription: Urban Cards is a deck-building roguelike game where earning money is the key to staying afloat in an unfair world. Build businesses, hire workaholic employees and thieves to steal from the competition. Create the perfect deck and work your way to the top!

games.title: Guiding Light
games.shortDescription: Guiding Light is a co-op game in which you and a friend need to rescue stranded aliens from all kinds of sticky situations. One player is an alien who goes down to the planet to execute the rescue operation, while the other pilots the UFO to help guide the alien on the ground.

games.title: Ironlights
games.shortDescription: Ironlights is a VR dueling game with skillful, fluid melee combat. Parry, block, and strike down your opponents using a variety of physics-based weapons. Test your skills in multiplayer battles, or fight to the top of the league in the huge single-player campaign!

games.title: This Way Madness Lies
games.shortDescription: Shakespeare and Magical Girls, what could be better? Save the worlds of Shakespeare from the forces of Nightmare in this fast-paced turn-based JRPG comedy.

games.title: 亭上满月映西枝~The Forever Moon
games.shortDescription: 《The Forever Moon》 is a puzzle adventure and visual novel doujin game of Touhou Project. It is a love story about Kaguya Houraisan and Fujiwara no Mokou, and a story of Eientei, Bamboo forest of lost and Hakurei Shrine.

games.title: Castle on the Coast
games.shortDescription: A hand-drawn, retro 3D collectathon. Parkour through a magic castle as George the Giraffe! String together sweet moves to explore crystal caverns, stone laden halls, and trippy alternate dimensions.

games.title: Wolf's Gang
games.shortDescription: This is a sample game created in 'RPG Maker MZ' by Caz. As a monster, build up your army to take revenge on the heroes in this classic Fantasy RPG.

games.title: Paper Beast - Folded Edition
games.shortDescription: An exploration and adventure game about wildlife sprung from the depths of the internet. An unknown power seems to upset its balance. Join forces with exotic creatures to unravel the mysteries of this universe.

games.title: Heads Will Roll
games.shortDescription: Hardcore survival RPG with non-linear story that lets you taste the life of a medieval soldier.

games.title: Sea Horizon
games.shortDescription: 《Sea Horizon》 is a Roguelike turn-based RPG. You can explore the world by choosing different characters. Every journey can be unique and legendary. But don’t forget the darkness is lurking. Choose your path wisely because every single step is essential.

games.title: Neko Beach
games.shortDescription: At Neko Beach girls are hot by the sun and they are waiting for you with attention and shamelessness. And of course, there are the sea and palm trees.

games.title: Cat Slide Tiles
games.shortDescription: Move the sliding tiles to unblock a path for the kitten to walk to the exit.

games.title: Tales of the Mirror
games.shortDescription: Tales of the Mirror is a landscape-mode visual novel game created by Cotton Games. As a player, you solve a series of mysteries in the mid and late Ming Dynasty, in the south of Yangtze River.

games.title: Within the Range
games.shortDescription: RTS with physical details. Formulate strategies based on terrain and unit characteristics

games.title: Station Manager
games.shortDescription: Build your own spectacular, multi-story station for your favorite trains!

games.title: Tomboy Adventure
games.shortDescription: Start a relaxing adventure together with your childhood friend!

games.title: UFO: Unidentified Falling Objects
games.shortDescription: Unidentified Falling Objects is a unique mashup of platforming and puzzle destroying gameplay. Players are dropped into the puzzle where they must dodge the falling obstacles and destroy blocks to make big combos.

games.title: Kunoichi Demon Slayers
games.shortDescription: In the not-so-distant future, demons suddenly appear worldwide, leaving chaos and destruction in their wake. But amidst the despair, a group of ninja warriors emerges to defend humanity and vow to eradicate the demons.

games.title: Someday You'll Return: Director's Cut
games.shortDescription: How far would you go if your daughter didn’t come home? Someday You’ll Return: Director’s Cut is a first-person psychological horror. This story-driven game offers enhanced features, an improved story, and additional content. Enter the woods if you dare and begin a search you’ll never forget.

games.title: Angvik 2
games.shortDescription: Angvik 2 is an action roguelike platformer with a unique style. Explore a variety of character builds as you navigate randomized levels, offering new challenges and surprises with each adventure.

games.title: WarriOrb
games.shortDescription: Demons, giants, mutants, and a talking Ball with hybrid limbs?! In WarriOrb you play as a mighty demon trapped in an unlikely body. The path ahead is not an easy one. Will you do whatever it takes to regain your freedom?

games.title: Unferat
games.shortDescription: Unferat is a warlock simulator, giving the player the opportunity to go from a village boy to a powerful dark sorcerer.

games.title: Gravulse Experimental
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Gravulse, an innovative space curvature laboratory that is trying to 'flip' the laws of physics, literally. Here you have to go through many test levels using various new technologies!

games.title: pemsa
games.shortDescription: pemsa is an unofficial cart runner for the famous PICO-8 fantasy console. We've included some classic games developed for this console with permission from the authors, including Celeste, Slipways Hug Arena.

games.title: RAYZE
games.shortDescription: RAYZE is an AIM RACER. Hit a target to accelerate. Miss and you slow down. Hit a wall and lose. Find the fastest route. Get to the finish line. Simple? Yes. Easy? Hell no. Ready? 3... 2... 1... Let's RAYZE!

games.title: PlayForm: Human Dynamics
games.shortDescription: PlayForm is an experimental physics sandbox. Physically simulated humans run, jump, climb, push, pull and smash their way through diverse worlds. Have fun with various tools and obstacles to create thrilling situations and experience next-gen physics.

games.title: The Tribe Must Survive
games.shortDescription: The Tribe Must Survive is a survival base builder strategy game set in a harsh Lovecraftian Stone Age. Build your camp, overcome disasters and uncover new areas. Manage fears and diminish internal conflicts, as your Tribe grows. Every decision matters. Will your Tribe survive?

games.title: Escape From Mandrillia: Local Asymmetric VR vs PC
games.shortDescription: Local VR vs PC horror game: 1 VR player controls a lone robot trying to escape an underground lab; up to 2 PC players control giant alien monkeys. Customize your experience with gameplay modifiers, ranging from tense survival stealth to brutal nonstop action!

games.title: Grand Prix Story
games.shortDescription: Enjoy racing at your own pace in this racing team management simulator.

games.title: Partum Artifex
games.shortDescription: A first-person atmospheric horror-puzzle game that focuses on the narrative to tie together the gruesome world with creative puzzles. Explore the mind of a twisted serial killer who wants nothing else than to show his work of art as well as tell his story to the world.

games.title: Agent in Depth
games.shortDescription: Agent in Depth is a daring action-platformer featuring fast-paced action and instant-death combat. You’ll run, jump, aim, and deflect bullets with your katana to blow up your enemies. No checkpoints, no upgrades: just pure skills. Deflect, die, learn, repeat. Be better, be faster.

games.title: 宝石少女/Girl & Gem Magic
games.shortDescription: Gorgeous girls + Costume Break + Jewel Elimination, conquer the beauties you encounter by adequately utilizing your strategy and luck! Caution: Entering 'TSS' does not make any change

games.title: Blue Wednesday
games.shortDescription: Blue Wednesday is a relaxing and lovely adventure game focused on story, music, and characters. Explore the city, meet various characters, and have conversations. Listen to their stories, play mini-games, collect music albums, and play music.

games.title: Korea Dynasty (조선메타실록)
games.shortDescription: This game is a 3D open world survival exploration game that survives in the Korea Dynasty. Players Begin with slaves, change their status in Joseon, survive, and escape. Once free, travel around the country, explore hundreds of ruins, hunt, and collect what you need to survive.

games.title: Nope Nope Nope Nope Nurses
games.shortDescription: The thrilling final installment of Dark One!'s hit visual novel series! Hapless protagonist Yamada is once again at the mercy of the tender depredations of the world's worst staff of nurses... and this time, it's up close and personal with the ruthless Head Nurse who dominates all the rest!

games.title: Super Algebrawl
games.shortDescription: Add up, multiply, clone, and divide your party members to beat the monsters on your path!

games.title: Epstein
games.shortDescription: Survive a mysterious island and thwart the sinister plans of Jefry in 'Epstein'. Battle the blood-dependent morbiders and forge alliances with other survivors to confront Jefry in his grand temple. Master survival tactics and strategic gameplay in this intense adventure.

games.title: StarFringe: Adversus
games.shortDescription: This is the story about the beginning of the conquest of outer space by earthlings. It began as a global idea of saving mankind from hunger and lack of resources, and ended as a brutal and merciless war in space far from Earth.

games.title: Whateverland
games.shortDescription: Find your way out of a magical prison in this non-linear point'n'click adventure full of mini games and challenges. Get to meet the charismatic Whateverlanders, steal and deceive or be a good boy to discover all the different endings of Vincent's story.

games.title: Gunman And The Witch
games.shortDescription: Wild West City-Builder meets Top-Down Shooter! Challenge your shooting and management skills in this 2D indie game.

games.title: Watcher Chronicles
games.shortDescription: Become a glutton for punishment and persevere, alone or with a friend, against 20+ merciless bosses and legions of skeletal nightmares in this savage yet charming 2D souls-like.

games.title: The Night is Grey
games.shortDescription: Graham’s alone in a forest filled with strange wolves. While he’s fleeing for his life he finds a lost girl in an abandoned lodge that won’t survive without his help. Try to find their way to safety in this slow-burning cinematic thriller filled with puzzles, hand-drawn animation and lots of mystery

games.title: Kovox Pitch
games.shortDescription: Doomer Rhythm Baseball

games.title: Cybernetic Fault
games.shortDescription: Prove your ability to read names next to the big red buttons! Show your ability to fight for life in a science center that is falling apart from the consequences of an insane scientific experiment!

games.title: Catie in MeowmeowLand
games.shortDescription: Catie in MeowmeowLand is a classical humorous point-and-click adventure game. Help little Catie get back home from the bizarre cat world of MeowmeowLand!

games.title: Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers
games.shortDescription: Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers is the follow-up to 2019's Arcade Spirits, a visual novel of love and pixels, in which you seek friendship and romance while working in an arcade. Now the tables are turned, as you seek friendship and romance while PLAYING in an arcade!

games.title: The Search For Fran
games.shortDescription: ' The Search for Fran ' Welcome to the City Park. You are here to search for Fran. While searching, You can also talk with people and go on Quests , Collect Glorbs , Throw a Ball , Drive a Car , Fly a Ship , Fix Traffic Jams, Try a 'Challenge' and much more !

games.title: Cyberfrags '69
games.shortDescription: Move fast and shoot fast in Cyberfrags '69. Double jump, wall-run, and blast your way to victory in intense PvP and Co-Op, or play as Cyber-Frank as he slaughters the Cyber-Nazis invading his home!

games.title: Deadwater Saloon
games.shortDescription: Dive into the wild west as a saloon owner in a volatile frontier town. Customize your character and face the consequences of your choices as you forge friendships and enemies of townsfolk, travellers, outlaws and lawmen. Build the most famous saloon in the territory, or be overwhelmed and destroyed.

games.title: Beneath the Mountain
games.shortDescription: In Beneath the Mountain, you play as the King of a new Dwarven civilization seeking to find their fortune beneath the mountain. You dig your way through the mountain, encountering many dangerous foes along the way, all while defending your kingdom from periodic Orc invasions.

games.title: Blossom Tales II: The Minotaur Prince
games.shortDescription: The Minotaur King has returned...and it's all your fault! Lily's back for a new 'classic' action-adventure set hundreds of years after The Sleeping King!

games.title: Master Key
games.shortDescription: Master Key is a top-down adventure game with a strong focus on item-based exploration and secrets. Embark on a journey to discover what that key could be used for and meet colorful characters!

games.title: The Adventurer's Domain Online
games.shortDescription: Multiplayer Online RPG offering a shared world for players to adventure merging ‘classic’ MMO vibes with more modern third person action combat systems.

games.title: PC Creator - PC Building Simulator
games.shortDescription: Try yourself as a PC builder and build your dream PC from 200+ real components!Complete different PC building and PC repair orders to upgrade your business: build a PC from zero, install popular OS', upgrade computers, install different programs and games, fix PC parts, and much more.

games.title: Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure
games.shortDescription: Dive back into your NIS roots and experience a game that laid the foundation for the beloved Disgaea series with Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure. Sharper graphics and updated image optimization bring this classic title into the present!

games.title: The Golden Rose: Book One
games.shortDescription: Explore an alternative medieval Europe in this low-fantasy epic adventure! How far are you willing to go to take back your stolen treasure?

games.title: Fallen Bride Mege
games.shortDescription: Mege is the childhood sweetheart of the protagonist. Lucky enough, he is able to marry Mege with everyone's blessing and lives a happy life. But the sudden news of layoffs broke his peaceful days.

games.title: Red Line
games.shortDescription: Moving into a shabby apartment, a saturnine girl with hidden secrets finds a notebook that allows her to communicate with another world. A thrilling adventure taking place across multiple timelines ensues.

games.title: The Will of Arthur Flabbington
games.shortDescription: A comedy point-and-click adventure game about a dead uncle, a hidden treasure, a reluctant ghost sidekick, old people and pizza.

games.title: Star Leaping Story
games.shortDescription: Players will help a white-robed girl and her friends uncover the truth of the planet using unique dash gameplay. The storyline is fully voiced by renowned actors, with meticulously designed levels and energetic music for you to enjoy!

games.title: Magicube
games.shortDescription: A magical puzzle platformer made with PICO-8. Be thinky to get the legendary treasure.
