games.title: Fuhrer in LA - Special Edition
games.shortDescription: Fuhrer in a LA is a grindhouse-styled top-down action-adventure game which takes place around 1947, unraveling the truth about the demise of the Fuhrer post World War 2.

games.title: Isles of Yore
games.shortDescription: Immerse yourself in a prehistoric ecosystem brought back from extinction. Survive and carve out your niche on islands teeming with danger and opportunity!

games.title: Road Maintenance Simulator
games.shortDescription: Experience the everyday life in a German street maintenance service and complete a variety of realistic tasks in the area of road construction and maintenance! For your work you will have unique vehicles and various usable tools at your disposal.

games.title: Helix Slider
games.shortDescription: A fast paced action avoidance game that will hopefully not make you barf. Spin around an endless twisting tube and slide your way past all the obstacles for as long as you can!

games.title: Aimi
games.shortDescription: Memories swirl all around you...Or are these memories? Familiar faces and places you think you remember but somehow now seem so different. Why are you here? Where is here?

games.title: Cyberpunk SFX
games.shortDescription: What can be more spectacular than a girl armed with rockets and a sense of humor? Yes, she is about to start solving the problems of the 21st century. And if you want to make sure she doesn’t create a few new ones, you’ll have to show her the way.

games.title: Eggcelerate!
games.shortDescription: Eggcelerate! is a silly yet very challenging time-trial racing game where you try over and over again to improve your time without dropping an egg.

games.title: The Mystery of Caketropolis
games.shortDescription: A bakery falls to arson and a city falls to chaos. With the harmony between human and dragon crumbling, can Rimentus solve the Mystery of Caketropolis before his kind face exile?

games.title: 卫国战争 The Patriotic War
games.shortDescription: The enemy has invaded the territory, the motherland needs you, soldier! Gather your troops and defeat all enemies!

games.title: 长明火计划 Project: Eternal Flame
games.shortDescription: 科幻末日AVG+另类卡牌闯关游戏。军校学生雨人和他的伙伴们，在暑假里遭遇了一系列异常之事，由此挖掘出七年前那重重迷雾之下的真相。他们行动起来，奔走在国与国战争的夹缝中，只为追寻自己认可的信念……他们能否成功？又会付出怎样的代价？

games.title: Pompom
games.shortDescription: You don't control Pompom the hamster’s movements, you control everything else. Lay down blocks, springs, cannons, umbrellas, use whips and alter the world, creating a safe path for Pompom to defeat the evil Captain Cat.

games.title: Wonderputt Forever
games.shortDescription: Explore ever-evolving levels with three different gameplay modes in Wonderputt Forever, an adventurous mini-golf game.

games.title: Decisive Campaigns: Ardennes Offensive
games.shortDescription: Decisive Campaigns: Ardennes Offensive is the fourth wargame in the Decisive Campaign series. Covering the battles in the Ardennes between December 1944 and January 1945, it brings to life Operational wargaming by lowering the scale to just above tactical level.

games.title: Knock'Em Out
games.shortDescription: Fight with your whole body. If you lose an arm, it's just a scratch. If you lose the other, it's a flesh wound. If you lose your legs, headbutt them. LET'S FIGHT, FIGHT, FIGHT!

games.title: Footgun: Underground
games.shortDescription: Roguelike with balls! Prove your ball skills and dribble your way through a randomly generated, dangerous track network full of deadly challenges! Face post-apocalyptic mutants, improve your balls with high-tech upgrades and escape the pixel art underground labyrinth.

games.title: Project Third Eye
games.shortDescription: Enter the groundbreaking world of Project Third Eye, a VR physics game where creativity meets interactivity. Build anything with powerful tools and add logic using the visual scripting panel. Embark on an immersive adventure of endless possibilities. Get your copy now!

games.title: Unrooted
games.shortDescription: Unrooted is a vibrant and eye-catching precision platformer with lush environments and a stunning musical score. Take up your courage and squash your fear of heights. Travel upwards to lands no sapling has dared to explore before. But heed with caution, the higher you journey, the more you risk.

games.title: I'm on Observation Duty 7
games.shortDescription: As an employee of a mysterious organization your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies using your sharp eyes and good memory. Can you survive the entire night shift or will you succumb into paranoia?

games.title: Fera: The Sundered Tribes
games.shortDescription: Fera: The Sundered Tribes is an enthralling mixture of monster hunting survival action RPG with village building and tribe management with groundbreaking aerial traversal and combat mechanics.

games.title: Lair of Torment
games.shortDescription: This is an indie horror game with first-person puzzles. Terror and fear have enveloped the city. The maniac has returned. You sneak into his lair to try and stop him before he goes too far...

games.title: Tormenture
games.shortDescription: Tormenture is a psychological horror game where you play as a child trapped in a cursed 8-bit game with a dark secret. To survive, you must find four relics and solve reality-blurring puzzles. But beware—some creatures may escape the game and haunt you in the real world. A game within a game.

games.title: Cyber Avenger
games.shortDescription: Cyber Avenger is a top-down action game where you take on the role of a highly skilled covert operative on a dangerous mission to stop a group of terrorists. You must navigate through five maps, facing a variety of enemies, including shotgunners, snipers, melee fighters, kamikazes, and more.

games.title: Nightmare Knight ~Sacred Maiden & Fallen Magic~
games.shortDescription: The young girl Rayne, who became the sacred knight of the kingdom, was entrusted by Jas, the leader of the sacred knights and her lover, to investigate the disturbances occurring in a distant town named 'Hakudeti'.

games.title: Goblin Boom
games.shortDescription: Embark on the role of a cunning goblin, whose passion is to place explosive bombs around the map. Your goal is to defeat enemies, complete levels, and become a true master of explosions! Get ready for an explosive adventure in the world of goblins and bombs!

games.title: Skeleton Village
games.shortDescription: Old dilapidated houses, crumbling planks, an old moldy well, an oppressive atmosphere and limited space. The walls erected around the perimeter put pressure on the nerves.

games.title: Slime Slayer
games.shortDescription: You play as an adventurer who descended into the dungeon in search of profit. But it's not that simple. The dungeon is full of dangerous slugs! Either you are them, or they are you! Dodge these deadly little monsters. But don't forget about the attack either – kill them all.

games.title: Run and Hunt: Skeleton Rebellion
games.shortDescription: You are a brave traveler who got lost in a dark labyrinth, beware of the evil skeletons. The evil skeletons know where you are, and they are already hunting you. Can you defeat them?

games.title: Pizza Boy Z
games.shortDescription: Pizza Boy Z is 3D runner game, where you play for ordinary pizza delivery person who has become an unusual hero.

games.title: Boom and Rum
games.shortDescription: 'Boom and Rum' is an exciting action-puzzle game with elements of arcade 3D, where players immerse themselves in the world of complex mazes. Your task is to find the exit, overcoming obstacles and using explosives to destroy walls and enemies standing in your way.

games.title: Can't revert
games.shortDescription: Can't revert is a first-person psychological horror game. You repeatedly find yourself in a house where your wife and son are dead. Discover hidden clues in the house and uncover the secrets of their deaths. Experience the constant tension and fear in the repetitive space.

games.title: Edgar - Bokbok in Boulzac
games.shortDescription: Crackpot outcast Edgar sets out to Boulzac to save his squash, and instead uncovers an unearthly secret at the heart of the city. A colourful, surreal and utterly bonkers point-and-click narrative adventure.

games.title: Wayward Strand
games.shortDescription: Wayward Strand is a heartfelt story told in a curious way. Hop aboard an airborne hospital and meet its fully-voiced cast of eclectic characters. As time passes for everyone on board, explore the interwoven lives of the patients and staff; discover something new on each and every playthrough.

games.title: Snapshot VR
games.shortDescription: Snapshot is a VR arena shooter built for e-sports with competitive solo and team play. Inspired by the real-life sport, Snapshot feels like playing paintball in the future. One shot, one kill. In competitive teams of up to 5, communication and coordination are the keys to victory.

games.title: TRANSFORMERS: BATTLEGROUNDS
games.shortDescription: BUMBLEBEE and the Autobots have a new commander – you. Assemble your squad and roll out for battle against the Decepticons... and team up in local multiplayer!

games.title: Wing of Darkness
games.shortDescription: This high-speed 3D shooting game allows players to experience exhilarating battles in the sky, as well as a series of cutscenes depicting the growth of the main characters throughout the story.

games.title: Roto Force
games.shortDescription: Shoot and dash your way through frantic missions! A twin-stick shooter set in a rotating world. Unlock weapons, move quickly and fight tons of bosses.

games.title: Boiling Steel: Preface
games.shortDescription: They promised a good job and a bright future. But advertising posters always lie. Instead of a quiet life - war. Instead of a body, a steel shell. Instead of weapons - tools. Thousands of light years from home. You are alone. Nowhere to run. Good luck my friend...

games.title: Sunset Kingdom
games.shortDescription: Sunset Kingdom is a kingdom management game. In Sunset Kingdom your aim is to become the monarch of a prosperous land! Prepare to expand your kingdom, buildings roads and bridges between towns, castles, farms and more! Fend of bandit raids, get crushed by vikings, let your people starve to death and try again!

games.title: Knights of the Chalice 2
games.shortDescription: Knights of the Chalice 2 is a 2D RPG with turn-based combat. Create six Adventurers and set forth on an epic adventure against Evil. Overcome the odds with superior tactics. Enjoy a whole new dimension of complexity and variety based on the 3.5 ruleset! Includes a Module Editor.

games.title: 法利恩戰記（Furion Chronicles）
games.shortDescription: The emergence of the Empire's flying city has no surprise decided the direction of the whole war. In order to avoid defeat, the countries and counties in the southern mainland signed a peace agreement with the Empire. At this time, the southern continent of farien, the city-state union of caldis, was attacked like a tide of demons

games.title: Trendpoker 3D: Free Online Poker
games.shortDescription: Play Online Poker without restriction or cost! Compete with community, your friends or family play this truly free Texas Hold'em Poker.

games.title: [Chilla's Art] Onryo | 怨霊
games.shortDescription: Onryo | 怨霊 is a survival action horror game set in Japan. Your mission is to lift the curse of a haunted house using your exorcistic camera. As you explore the house and uncover its secrets, you will face enemies and puzzles.

games.title: Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition
games.shortDescription: Nongunz is a roguelite action-platformer. Battle grotesque creatures, kill quickly to maintain your combo meter, and rescue worshipers to become part of your idle army to buy upgrades.

games.title: 2ECONDS TO STΔRLIVHT: Forever My Diamond
games.shortDescription: As graduation looms, true feelings begin to surface. Will Grace find the courage to overcome her shyness and bare her heart to Sera, or will her handsome rival Akira get to her first? A free VN about being really gay for your best friend. Part of the NOISZ series, and prequel to NOISZ STΔRLIVHT.

games.title: Animal Rescuer: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Animal Rescuer: Prologue is a free standalone version of the game Animal Rescuer, featuring the initial part of the story. Our hero is helping lovely animals through exploring an epic world with faster gameplay and increased quest and combat intensity.

games.title: City of Beats
games.shortDescription: Shoot. Groove. Loot. Repeat. Cross an ever-changing city skyline, flowing through encounters in tune with the cityscape’s beat. From the weapons you fire, to the enemies you shoot, to the zen-like flow, the only way to win is to become one with the beat.

games.title: Empires Shall Fall
games.shortDescription: Empires Shall Fall is a turn-based tactics game set in a dieselpunk world. Upgrade your army and command your troops, then exploit terrain to eradicate your enemies with sheer power and sharp tactics.

games.title: Trash Quest
games.shortDescription: Trash Quest is a compact metroidvania with a single spawn point, run and gun action and tight platforming. Navigate an interwoven maze of rooms through this space station, destroying robots, collecting power ups and unlocking shortcuts.

games.title: Bloodless
games.shortDescription: Stylish, action-adventure game featuring counter-based, non-lethal combat centered around ronin Tomoe's signature dash-counter mechanic, fighting with nothing but her bare fists to disarm her former allies, the samurai army of Shogun Akechi.

games.title: Midnight Driver
games.shortDescription: Dive into the golden era of Japanese street racing. Choose from a list of iconic cars and perfect your driving skills in beautiful mountain roads and then Challenge your friends and rivals in downhill uphill or ring battles. At night, the streets are yours.

games.title: Centipede: Recharged
games.shortDescription: Blast bugs and chase high scores in this glorious revival of an old-school classic, all while jamming to a heart-pounding original score by Megan McDuffee. Play solo or tag in a friend for local co-op across 30 unique challenges or the endless arcade mode.

games.title: Citizens: Far Lands
games.shortDescription: Citizens is a blend between turn based city builder and a puzzler for strategy masterminds. Build a thriving settlement, extract and process resources and manage your population by catering to their needs, thus allowing you to build bigger and better!

games.title: Below The Ocean
games.shortDescription: Dive into the world 'Below the Ocean'! Master thrilling moves like tether-swinging, bubble-jumping, bungee-bouncing, and sling-shot in a mesmerizing underwater adventure. Solve intriguing puzzles and seek hidden treasures. Are you ready to embark on this unforgettable journey?

games.title: Firelight Fantasy: Vengeance
games.shortDescription: Firelight Fantasy: Vengeance - a game about spectacular sword battles from the third person.

games.title: It's Kooky
games.shortDescription: It's Kooky is a hand drawn hidden object game. Unlike any other, you will have to find those quirky characters with unusual behaviours hidden throughout the map of different locations. Have a kooky fun time!!!

games.title: Dr. Chatelet: Faith 神医
games.shortDescription: Amputations, bloodletting, alchemy - all of which seem unthinkable today - were the treatment options that medieval doctors revered. You must face challenges one after another and experience gains and losses in the course of your constant adventures

games.title: Under A New Sun
games.shortDescription: While searching for a new home, an unexpected failure in your ship has left you stranded on a planet surprisingly similar to Earth. Discover a vast open world, hunt for food, develop technologies, and build yourself a new home to survive!

games.title: Movavi Video Suite 2023 Steam Edition - An all-in-one video maker: an editor, converter, screen recorder, and more!
games.shortDescription: Simplify your game video-editing routine with Movavi’s all-in-one video maker. Edit footage, convert multimedia files to 180+ formats, record video instructions and tutorials, and grab streaming videos. Have fun and maximize the number of views on YouTube, TikTok, and Vimeo.

games.title: Last Whisper
games.shortDescription: Last Whisper Survival is a cooperative zombie survival game where exploration of the open world is key. As you venture further, you'll need to upgrade your gear and level up your character and skill tree to handle the increasing challenges as you move through the world.

games.title: Twilight Oracle
games.shortDescription: Journey to a strange world in search of the fabled Oracle in this fantasy comedy point click adventure. Play as Leo, a struggling student with the ability to breathe underwater, and explore a desert island and the depths of an alien ocean to uncover your school’s dark past.

games.title: Monica's Newlywed Life
games.shortDescription: Monica has married her childhood sweetheart and is now settling in the city with her new family. But it's going to take one million gold to buy her citizenship! Work odd jobs and fight monsters to make enough gold before time runs out!

games.title: Step By Step
games.shortDescription: In a game where you can't stop moving, every step is progress. But whether that progress is forward or backward, that is up to you...

games.title: Bonnie's Bakery
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Bonnie's Bakery! Play as Bonnie, a cute baker who needs to gather ingredients so she can make pastries! Serve up your fresh, homemade pastries to the local townsfolk and hunt for very fresh ingredients!

games.title: Route8
games.shortDescription: 'You're lost on Route 8. You must find a way to escape. This eerie road is terrifying.''Night falls, the phone rings. Who are you? You find yourself driving along Route 8, repeating endlessly.'

games.title: Daemonologie
games.shortDescription: A short folk horror story about the Scottish witch trials. You play the role of a witch finder. Speak to the locals and sort their truths from their lies. On the last morning a witch must hang, best you know who by then.

games.title: Burning Knight
games.shortDescription: Steal everything you can and flee from the Burning Knight's castle in this action-packed roguelike! The game features tight bullet hell, tons of items, characters to meet... and secrets!

games.title: Lawless Lands
games.shortDescription: Lawless Lands is a dark medieval role-playing game featuring a grim setting and innovative mechanics that allow players to delve into a low-fantasy, apocalyptic world of epic proportions. Defy and destroy the darkness that has taken hold over these Lawless Lands.

games.title: Robot Rumble 2
games.shortDescription: Build your robot. Battle your robot. Robot Rumble 2 is the premier robot combat building simulator, where you create your robot from real-world inspired parts, then drive it in the arena to defeat other robots.

games.title: OVERPASS™
games.shortDescription: Take control of big-name buggies and quads to negotiate scree slopes, steep inclines and various obstacles on extreme off-road and technically challenging tracks. Find the best route, and manage your acceleration, differentials and drivetrain to dominate in local or online competitions.

games.title: Gearshifters
games.shortDescription: An arcade-action shoot-'em-up rogue-lite. Steer, drift, spin, smash and gun through waves of enemy vehicles. Go to war against extreme-machine bosses. Build up and tune your tactical loadout of car mods, defences and weaponry for each treacherous transport mission. Drive. Destroy. Get paid. Upgrade!

games.title: FIT Food
games.shortDescription: FIT Food is a multiplayer card game with a new battle mode called CUBE RUN. We developed it to make nutritional education in schools, universities, companies, and healthcare organizations more engaging.

games.title: Cave Quest
games.shortDescription: Play a thrilling Match3 game! Match gems of the same kind to destroy them and to get bonuses and power-ups.

games.title: Getaway Storm
games.shortDescription: Survive the fast, chaotic roads of Getaway Storm together!

games.title: Rising Hell - Prologue
games.shortDescription: Welcome to the first layer of hell! Climb out from the ever-changing abyss while you fight hordes of blood-lusting demons in this vertical platformer rogue-lite.

games.title: Lullaby Days
games.shortDescription: Marchen fantasy raising simulation 『Lullaby Days』 is a game where the goal is to grow a duckling girl into a hero. Your duckling girl will grow through education, part-time work, exploration, and more. Create 70 endings in the Kingdom of Oberebach with around 90 sub-characters.

games.title: Persian Nights 2: The Moonlight Veil
games.shortDescription: Travel to the magical land of Persian Nights and save your sister from a dire fate. Feel the taste of orient in this sumptuous and beguiling hidden object adventure.

games.title: Euphoria: Supreme Mechanics
games.shortDescription: The ability to discern hidden connections is both a gift and a curse. The covert mechanisms of reality do not reveal themselves to any and all, and there is a price to pay for this knowledge…

games.title: Cybershock: Future Parkour
games.shortDescription: Cybershock: Future Parkour is a runner game with outrun aesthetics in which you are an antivirus. Your mission is to destroy all the viruses on your computer before they destroy you. For this you must parkour through the different levels and avoid all the obstacles that stand in your way.

games.title: Minesweeper: Collector
games.shortDescription: Tired of boring common square levels? Finally there is a brand new minesweeper with different game modes! Each level is a part of collection. Complete collections to obtain keys and gain access for more episodes. Achieve higher levels to unlock new items, chests, pets and much more!

games.title: Leons Identität
games.shortDescription: Leons Identität (Leon's Identity) is a first-person adventure game which rigorously unfolds the drifting-off of a young man into the alt-right radical scene and his unexplained disappearance.

games.title: Sayonara Golden Days
games.shortDescription: Discover the reason why a college gaming club broke apart in this unfinished game made by its club members, and relive the golden days that vaguely exist in our memories.

games.title: Elysium Above 履云录
games.shortDescription: In SRPG Elysium Above, you will be a Commander of state Bo to direct the heroes to fight against enemies, and defend the newly restored land that has been annexed for 11 years! Wit the era of chaos and excitement with eight heroes!

games.title: Stardom
games.shortDescription: 《明星志願》由大宇資訊於1995年1月15日推出，是一款模擬養成遊戲，也是《明星志願》系列遊戲的開篇之作。在遊戲中，玩家將扮演周映彤的高中同學，並經營一間經紀公司。必須於兩年內按照董事長的要求，取得三項大獎的經營類遊戲。

games.title: Cave Digger 2 Dig Harder
games.shortDescription: Go on a mysterious journey in the wildlands in this 1-4-player VR action-adventure game inspired by Western, Dieselpunk and Lovecraftian themes. Explore old mines, nautical caves and ruins of ancient civs to unravel the secrets of the valleys. But beware! Best to keep a 6-shooter close just in case.

games.title: Fossilfuel
games.shortDescription: Fossilfuel, is a horror action shooter, where the player must fight their way through Jurassic monsters and Super Soldiers, in this multi-ending, adrenaline-fueled cyberpunk experience!

games.title: Treasures of the Aegean
games.shortDescription: What happened to the Minoan civilization? Join parkour master Marie Taylor and treasure hunter James Andrew in a historical action thriller, as they unveil the secrets of a forgotten kingdom which has been tragically trapped in and endless time loop.

games.title: CUCCCHI
games.shortDescription: CUCCCHI is a game where you explore beautiful dioramas and go through dangerous and trippy labyrinths, in a journey inside the paintings of Enzo Cucchi.

games.title: MegaFactory Titan
games.shortDescription: A factory building game on an infinite procedural world. Build a smart factory that manages logistics automatically. Trade, negotiate, and fight with Colonists, Rebels, Terrorists, and Pirates.

games.title: Night Loops
games.shortDescription: Journey through the psyche… Welcome to the Seaside Hotel, where the final hour of your night shift awaits. Tend to guests, explore their dreams, and lose your sense of Self – time and again. In this dark, labyrinthine adventure, unravel the path to the truth below.

games.title: Lifecraft
games.shortDescription: Survive and evolve as an organism with this simulation game in which you will literally start as a single cell and manage and organize all its functions to a fully fledged system! Assemble, breathe, eat, fight threats, produce energy, grow, anything is possible!

games.title: NeuraGun
games.shortDescription: NeuraGun is a third-person science fiction puzzle game. The player will have to go through a maze of mysteries that will lead him out of the tangled scientific complex.

games.title: Neko Doll
games.shortDescription: Come and meet your neko doll, let her accompany you to complete challenging levels, unlock her mysterious realm, and experience the joy of intimate contact with neko in different scenes.

games.title: The Gallery
games.shortDescription: An art curator is held hostage by a portraitist who threatens to detonate a bomb unless their demands are met. 'The Gallery' contains two interactive narratives - set in 1981 (with a female protagonist) and 2021 (with a male protagonist).

games.title: Upload Simulator
games.shortDescription: A incremental game about downloading files, uploading, and upgrading your setup. This is the official PC version of Upload Simulator.

games.title: The King's Dilemma: Chronicles
games.shortDescription: Lead the King’s Council for generations as the consequences of your decisions decide the kingdom’s resources and political standing. Form alliances, solve dilemmas, and prepare for the final uprising that was foretold by an ancient prophecy

games.title: Dead Beacon
games.shortDescription: Dead Beacon is a first-person survival horror inspired by late 1990s games and taking place in the Beacon manor, a location crawling with zombies and creatures governed by a malevolent will. Survive using the given array of weapons and escape the island.

games.title: Christmas Night
games.shortDescription: Christmas Night is a story-themed horror game about Christmas and its beliefs. Will we be rewarded for being a good girl this Christmas or will we be punished for being a spoiled person?

games.title: Sun Down Survivors
games.shortDescription: Sun Down is a roguelike survivors-type game with a twist. Between upgrading your abilities during and between runs, you can craft turrets, collect battle-ready pets, and buy store upgrades to survive hordes of enemies through four changing seasons.

games.title: The Last FARMER
games.shortDescription: 'The Last Farmer' is not just a tale of survival; it's a journey of restoration. Amidst the sprawling deserts of a forgotten Texas, your farm becomes a symbol of hope and persistence.

games.title: Lower? Higher!
games.shortDescription: your pawnshop will usher in guests with different needs every day, bargain with them, let the income soar! With the expansion of pawnshops, activities such as sending shop assistants and responding to emergencies are also essential. you seem ordinary transaction may cause the butterfly effect.

games.title: Moonless Moon
games.shortDescription: When night falls, she wanders into another world... Moonless Moon is a text-based adventure game following a girl as she travels through a variety of different worlds.

games.title: The Chosen Warriors
games.shortDescription: The Chosen Warriors is a new old school side scroller beat 'em up inspired by games like Golden Axe and Knights of the Round.

games.title: Ciel Fledge: A Daughter Raising Simulator
games.shortDescription: Daughter Raising Simulator with in-depth management gameplay, backed by an outstanding City Pop soundtrack. Take a young girl under your wing and raise her to adulthood. Set in a future where humanity has fled earth, your choices for your daughter will determine the outcome for humanity.

games.title: Lovely Fox
games.shortDescription: Lovely Fox, a 3d adventure game about the life and times of Lovely fox and her friends. Your tasked with finding special flowers for the Flower king. Guide Lovely fox as she decides to help others or not. Take a role in the well being of her aging grandfather, who she adores very much.

games.title: Dieselpunk Wars
games.shortDescription: Dieselpunk Wars is a vehicle building game, focused on combat with advanced physics and damage simulation. Use over 300 elements to build a war machine of your dreams. Construct vehicles that ride on the ground, soar through the skies, or dive underwater. Prepare for combat and test your skills!

games.title: Old Gods Rising
games.shortDescription: As the consultant for a maverick director's new film: 'Old Gods Rising,' Professor Tom Winston arrives at Ashgate University to find that things are not quite as they seem. Has he become the unwitting star of Kayfer’s latest project? Or, has he stumbled into something far more sinister?

games.title: SAMUDRA
games.shortDescription: SAMUDRA is an award-winning hand-illustrated deep sea journey.

games.title: Family Man: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Family Man: Prologue is the free intro to the upcoming Family Man -- a dark, story-led RPG. You owe money to the mob... and they plan to collect.

games.title: FPS Infinite
games.shortDescription: Phr00t's Software is all about procedural generation, optional VR support and fun! This is a full free game inspired by Metroid Prime: explore randomly generated worlds for new abilities to unlock new ones. Will you upgrade your missile launcher or teleporting abilities? Will you escape in time?

games.title: Space Cats Tactics
games.shortDescription: Fight nerve-wracking spaceship battles in this turn-based tactical space opera RPG! Manage your crew of feline warriors to adapt to every strategic situation and dive into a thrilling space opera story where your choices will determine your path.

games.title: Swords and Sandals Crusader Redux
games.shortDescription: The world of Swords and Sandals is at war! Join the Crusade against Emperor Antares! For the first time since 2007, the beloved Swords and Sandals Crusader returns, reforged from the ground up. Fast paced, addictive tactical warfare is back and better than ever!

games.title: Lucky and a life worth living - a jigsaw puzzle tale
games.shortDescription: A dog’s life nowadays. Discover happy moments from the daily life of the dog Lucky with his parents. A new minimalist jigsaw puzzle game, with 6 scenes illustrated by @Katia Numakura with her cute art style.

games.title: BORIS THE ROCKET 🚀
games.shortDescription: As a moustached soviet nuclear missile operator, you’re the last frontier of your motherland’s defense. Survive a freezing Siberian winter, untangle nasty bear intrigues and adapt to always changing environment in this cold war simulator.

games.title: Cocaine Dealer
games.shortDescription: A clicker/management drug dealing simulator. Get your product cut and wrapped quickly and out on the streets. Build your crew, expand your operation, and climb the supply chain. Stay ahead of the cops, keep your crew in line, or pay the price.

games.title: Moose Life
games.shortDescription: Moose Life is a trippy, psychedelic trance shooter. Created in the style of a 1980s arcade game, Moose Life offers you an exhilarating ride into the trance zone. Spectacular shooty action and a top techno soundtrack will raise your mood. If you have VR, immerse yourself for greater satisfaction.

games.title: Rocco's Island: Ring to End the Pain
games.shortDescription: Join Evelyn on her quest to save a mysterious island in a puzzle-based atmospheric adventure with a story that spans across 30,000 years of time. Interact with fantastic characters to learn past secrets and transform the Four Elements’ kingdoms, leading up to an epic finale with shocking reveals.

games.title: FALAFEL Restaurant Simulator
games.shortDescription: Start your own Falafel shop in a big city and manage your business to make your own successes story

games.title: [TDA00] Muv-Luv Unlimited: THE DAY AFTER - Episode 00 REMASTERED

games.shortDescription: AccrO is a Full Acrobatic Quadcopter Simulator, with realistic flight behavior and complex physics simulation. A training tool for freestyle drone enthusiasts.

games.title: Love Mystery Club
games.shortDescription: This game is based on the theme of love light reasoning. Even if you choose the wrong option, it will not lead to game over. It is very suitable for casual players who like love reasoning but don't want to waste their brain cells.

games.title: RoboSkate
games.shortDescription: Roll the board. Whir the motors. Scrape the metal. RoboSkate is a short and challenging physics based adventure where you master the controls of a robotic arm stuck to a skateboard and overcome the trials of a short yet treacherous journey.

games.title: Anomalous
games.shortDescription: A SHORT and sweet pixelated low fidelity 90s throwback hyper-fast action shooter. Survive and fight through a city overrun with manufactured monstrosities, biomass horrors, and a military authority trying to purge everything living. Heavy metal / techno soundtrack featuring BOD Music

games.title: SHUT IN
games.shortDescription: SHUT IN is a dark comedy/psychological horror adventure game which explores depression and isolation by trapping you inside your own house. Explore a hostile home, solve puzzles, and withstand sarcasm from a rude and unreliable narrator. Idiot.

games.title: Rooten
games.shortDescription: There is only you and the Forest. In 'Rooten' there are no compulsory tasks, time just goes by, and days pass by independently of you. You can explore the Forest, try to get out, or even do nothing at all. The forest has always been here, and always will be. You won't change it no matter what.

games.title: Kinduo
games.shortDescription: Kinduo is a local cooperative game where two elemental friends overcome obstacles to return to their island, push boxes, use electricity to connect objects, break ice blocks, blow things up and more in this cute and colorful co-op game!

games.title: Ninja Stealth 4
games.shortDescription: He's back!

games.title: Fantasy General
games.shortDescription: Fantasy General invites you to enter a world of heroes, swords, magic and beasts. You must lead your army into battle with the Shadowlord’s forces and defeat each of his lieutenants across varying terrain and battlefields.

games.title: Map Of Materials
games.shortDescription: Vincent's epic adventure awaits you! In Map Of Materials, you'll find him stranded on a mysterious island, where he'll use all his skills and knowledge to escape and return to his old life. Will he make it out alive?

games.title: QUIT TODAY
games.shortDescription: 'QuitToday' is a beat ‘em up game around the workplace theme. You will step into an epic resignation adventure and kick your colleagues' asses.

games.title: Rhythm Journey
games.shortDescription: Rhythm Journey is a story based, hardcore 2-buttons rhythm game.

games.title: Astor: Blade of the Monolith
games.shortDescription: Rip through hordes of enemies with fury and style in this fast-paced action RPG. Play as Astor, a young warrior determined to unveil the secrets behind his creators’ unforeseen demise. Wield an arsenal of runic weapons to hunt down the evil haunting the planet Gliese and save it from impending doom.

games.title: Clown Of Duty
games.shortDescription: Experience the fast-paced contact with enemy, beautifully hand-crafted locations, gunsmithing, player customization and more, only in Clown of Duty!

games.title: The Last Man Survivor
games.shortDescription: The Last Man Survivor is a gloomy roguelike in which you have to fight tons of enemies, slay giant bosses, discover new abilities and characters, and also find out the dark secret of the Last Survivor

games.title: Crystal Guardians
games.shortDescription: Crystal Guardians is a tower defense game with rogue-like elements. Fight of waves and defend the world crystal. Gear up your towers with a powerful combination of items for your strategy. In an ever expanding map, find hidden powers and conquer the enemies.

games.title: Glory to Ukraine!
games.shortDescription: On 24 February, Russia invaded Ukraine in an escalation of the Russo-Ukrainian War. Your task is kill the invaders. Use any available weapons: knive and axe, machine gun and grenades. Be careful, enemies are crafty and merciless. The fate of Ukraine depends on you.

games.title: Project Of Cooling The Earth
games.shortDescription: Players must survive in the ruins of the human world and face various survival challenges and dangers. Players need to search for resources in abandoned cities and wilderness, including food, water sources, construction materials, etc., to maintain survival and build safe shelters.

games.title: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush
games.shortDescription: Rebel Rush is a single-player speedrunning driving platformer where you sacrifice himbos for hideous carkour moves.

games.title: Anima Flux
games.shortDescription: Anima Flux is a co-op metroidvania with two genetically enhanced soldiers, special agents of a theocratic dictatorial regime. Fight your way through swarms of mutants through a desolate, dystopian space city and save humanity's last stronghold, if, of course, anyone is still alive...

games.title: PARANOID
games.shortDescription: Paranoid is a horror that tells the story of Patrick who has been living in isolation from the outside world for many years. One day he receives a phone call from his sister, who announces her visit more than a dozen years after she disappeared.

games.title: Quantum Suicide
games.shortDescription: Quantum Suicide is a game of betrayal, deception and romance in the cold depths of space.

games.title: Table of Tales: The Crooked Crown
games.shortDescription: Table of Tales: The Crooked Crown is a role playing adventure that brings tabletop gaming to life in virtual reality! Also includes a new non-VR mode for players without VR hardware. Join a band of scoundrels in this unique sea-faring tabletop RPG adventure!

games.title: Weakless
games.shortDescription: Weakless is a beautiful, puzzle-adventure game with stunning organic environments, filled with curious life forms and a bioluminescent glow. Play as two Weavelings – carefree, wooden creatures – one of which is deaf, the other blind. Switch between the two, solve unique puzzles and save their world!

games.title: Criminal Dissidia
games.shortDescription: Criminal Dissidia is a Roguelike card game with the adventure and ACG theme. Build your own deck, discover the open world, and experience various fun in this mysterious land. Your duty is to save your hometown from the Mutanian invasion, prepare youself!

games.title: Curse of Anabelle
games.shortDescription: Curse of Anabelle is a story driven adventure-horror/puzzle game which players can experience in the first person perspective. The storyline is based on real world myths and legends.

games.title: The MoneyMakers Rallye
games.shortDescription: A turn-based rally through Europe with the goal of becoming the richest!

games.title: Output Pasture
games.shortDescription: Output Pasture is a fast-paced Tower Defense Game which combines the elements of roguelike. Unlock, combine unique animals to battle together, and fight the evil Machine Legion.

games.title: JEF
games.shortDescription: Travel the galaxy, find a dog, watch billionaires put together Ikea furniture for regular people, learn about the Sourcefield, get mentally healthy.

games.title: BadLads
games.shortDescription: BadLads is a neo-noir multiplayer roleplay game centered around each player having their own job. Cities are ruled by President. Civilians are assaulted by Gangs and protected by Police. Adventure, collect, craft, base build, gamble, socialize, overthrow, customize yourself and your belongings.

games.title: Space Elite Force II
games.shortDescription: Space Elite Force II is a frenetic space-shooter with weapon customization and insane bosses battles. Embark in your ship and fight for the survival of the human race!

games.title: Anime Artist 2: Lovely Danya
games.shortDescription: Anime Artist 2 is a unique sim experience for PC: A Puzzle game with light RPG elements. Help our lovely Danya becoming an Anime Artist. Draw, Color, Collect art while making money and unlocking various dresses and hair styles for her... but most importantly... her heart!

games.title: Knight's Retreat
games.shortDescription: A chess game without any chess. Rearrange your troops to bring your best Knights back to your Kingdom in an abstract medieval world.

games.title: Kings Of Streets
games.shortDescription: Starting from a homeless person who wakes up at a bus station. All you have is a penny in your pocket and some cash in your bank account. Go out into the city and work hard to earn your first money. The streets will be your home.

games.title: The Last Shot
games.shortDescription: An adventurous engineer, a diesel-punk world divided by endless conflict, and a whole lot of colossal guns. Sounds like a good time! With massive war machines threatening your home, will you be the one small cog that brings it all to a halt?

games.title: -SPROUT-
games.shortDescription: -SPROUT- is a mini precision-platformer built for speed-running. Run, jump and dash your way through 100 levels across five unique lands, and restore your world to its former glory.

games.title: Flat Eye
games.shortDescription: Flat Eye is a resource management sim with an emphasis on story and narrative choices. Oversee the world’s leading technological hub while you explore stories linked to discoverable technology and interact with your most loyal customers. Flat Eye - We're watching.

games.title: Gemini Strategy Origin
games.shortDescription: The Gemini Strategy: Origin is the work of TSM series. This game still adopts the way of strategy. You can get free DLC which from the publisher to active more adult content .

games.title: Ballex²: The Hanging Gardens
games.shortDescription: Ballex² is a third-person rolling ball game, the sequel to Ballex. You will control a ball, enjoy the scenery of the four seasons, overcome obstacles and solve various puzzles.

games.title: Farmer And Tree
games.shortDescription: Adopt barren hills, plant trees, and experience the sweet joy of doing nothing!

games.title: Puzzle Box Palace
games.shortDescription: Puzzle Box Palace is an escape room style puzzle game where you are pulled into your grandfather's magical puzzle box. Solve puzzles, manipulate the puzzle box, and jump across furniture as you look for a way out.

games.title: Phi
games.shortDescription: Phi is a meditative action adventure game. The player controls Phi, a snake, navigating through a dark, lonely world in search of lost souls to bring to their final resting place. The game places strong emphasis on the movement of Phi.

games.title: Live Inc.
games.shortDescription: Live Inc. is an online 2vs2 heist game where two opposing players play in a cat and mouse scenario and their team members play as overseers of the map. Teams can use unique mechanics to interact with the map and must work together to outsmart their opponent.

games.title: Fueled Up
games.shortDescription: Fueled Up is a chaotic couch co-op spaceship recovery game for up to four players. You and your crewmates must fuel, fix and rescue damaged spaceships before the evil space octopus gets its tentacles on them!

games.title: Kiki & Ana - The Child
games.shortDescription: 'Kiki Ana - The Child' is a cute story experience. Focused on story, art, and music. Must avoid hazards which some people find difficult. Takes about an hour to complete. WARNING: flashing lights, light gore.

games.title: LiBER
games.shortDescription: We all dreamed of adventures full of mysteries and mysticism, dreamed of finding ourselves in unusual situations and emerging from them as a hero. Liber is an adventure about travel in time, the search for truth and oneself, about friendship and revaluation of values..

games.title: Sweet Dreams Alex
games.shortDescription: Alex is still small, but her dreams are big. You are her Dream Builder, tasked with constructing labyrinths full of distractions to keep Nightmares away until the morning comes. Sweet Dreams Alex is a wholesome puzzle and construction game, filled to the brim with atmosphere and charm.

games.title: Self-Delusion
games.shortDescription: Self-Delusion is a first-person survival horror in the original setting of Slavic fairy tales. You will faces such unique monsters like: Kolobok, Leshy, Boggart, Lapot and other creepy creatures. Explore, hide or run. Just don't get devoured by them.

games.title: Drunken Dad Simulator
games.shortDescription: In Drunken Dad Simulator you'll play a drunken bear who has to look for his beer bottles at a child's birthday party. In the process he causes a lot of mayhem and all sorts of strange things happen.

games.title: No!Ah!'s Ark
games.shortDescription: No!Ah!'s Ark is an advanced Whac-A-Mole game. The Big flood came and the world was destroyed. You're the chosen one, Noah. You have to save the animals and the girl you love.

games.title: Sigma Impact
games.shortDescription: A physics-based 2D action roguelite set in a dungeon of glass. Master intense combat, be immersed in captivating visuals with adaptive music and sound design tailored to your gameplay.

games.title: Bad Dream: Stories
games.shortDescription: Bad Dream: Stories is a collection of older games in the Bad Dream series in a new, remastered form. Play the series of short point click titles and travel through the disturbing and atmospheric world of dreams.

games.title: Logic Light
games.shortDescription: A minimalist puzzle experience to restore the electricity of the houses after a blackout

games.title: Puzzles For Clef
games.shortDescription: Join Clef on an adventure set on a magical sky island where her family once lived. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and experience a story of sisterly love – and something more, if you are willing to dig deeper…

games.title: Venture Towns
games.shortDescription: Make your own metropolitan utopia! Stores, mansions, towers--anything goes!

games.title: Nancy Drew®: Mystery of the Seven Keys™
games.shortDescription: A thrilling blend of adventure, mystery, and history! Play as Nancy Drew to uncover the truth behind the theft of a client's heirloom necklace. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover a sinister web of cyber crime, and sleuth through Prague's mysterious streets entwined with medieval legends and alchemy.

games.title: SGS Korean War
games.shortDescription: The first intense conflict of the Cold War, this war is very often forgotten, its very rapid and dynamic but unknown aspect obliterated by months of stagnation following the first year of operations in Korea. Can you make it remembered?

games.title: Rift Loopers
games.shortDescription: Survive the horrors of the multiverse, alone or with your comrades, as you battle against an onslaught of insectoid like creatures. Combine abilities in different ways each loop to overcome and return safely to your universe.

games.title: Creative Console
games.shortDescription: 'Take control of all game elements! By selecting Creative Cards, you can change the camera angle, place objects, switch skins, summon enemies, and even create a football match. Becoming an outstanding game designer, creating unique levels and gameplay, with unlimited creativity awaits you.'

games.title: Mr. Hopp's Playhouse 3
games.shortDescription: Two young girls must solve puzzles, avoid traps and overcome hellish enemies to find The Six Medallions and put an end to The Entity's reign, once and for all.

games.title: Gore Screaming Show
games.shortDescription: A deeply unsettling visual novel following a boy who returns to his hometown expecting to find peace; however, it isn't long before his hopes are dashed by the monster known as Gore Screaming Show.

games.title: Ocean Is Home : Island Life Simulator
games.shortDescription: Ocean is Home is an island life simulator and an open world adventure rolled into one. Starting with a small house and an old pickup truck, you can build an estate and become a significant person in a warm tropical paradise.

games.title: Jack Holmes : Master of Puppets
games.shortDescription: Survival Horror in first person where you must manage your ammunition well, explore varied scenarios and face nightmarish beings, while investigating the macabre experiments with children, the result of a mind unhinged by madness and family loss.

games.title: Random Chat
games.shortDescription: Based on the weekly Naver Webtoon 'Random Chat,' this new visual novel breathes life into the story by re-forming it into a love simulation game!

games.title: Confabulation
games.shortDescription: Your memory is fading. Things around your home keep changing; they are not what they appear to be. Find what is wrong, take pictures to restore your memory. Try to remember. Learn what you have forgotten, learn what has happened. It is not what it seems to be.

games.title: Cowboy 3030
games.shortDescription: Step into the Wild West future of Cowboy 3030, a third-person shooter with 3D bullet hell and roguelike elements. Play solo or team up with friends, as various heroes with unique abilities. Take on notorious alien outlaws, forge unique builds in every run and rise to become top gun of 3030!

games.title: Pudding
games.shortDescription: 'Let's defeat the demon lord together!' A thrilling action-adventure of destruction!

games.title: Rampage Agents
games.shortDescription: Rampage Agents is a VR game that fuses battle royale with multi-player action adventure games. Obtain powerful agents with unique powers and team up with your friends now!

games.title: Yars Rising
games.shortDescription: From the renowned development studio WayForward Technologies, Inc. (Shantae, River City Girls, Advance Wars 1+2: Re-Boot Camp) comes Yars Rising, a 2D action adventure exploration of one of Atari’s richest, and best known classic titles.

games.title: Widow in the Endless Labyrinth
games.shortDescription: The story begins with a missing superhero and Widow the supervillain is the only suspect in this case. Does she have something to do with the missing superhero or is she trying to hide something? This game is an action-roguelike game with randomly generated mazes.

games.title: DINNERDINNNER
games.shortDescription: 'DINNERDINNNER' is a horror adventure game set in the modern era. You become a diner staff member and encounter strange events – customers with bizarre stories, engaging in trivial conversations, and discussing incomprehensible matters.

games.title: Dawnmaker
games.shortDescription: Dawnmaker is a turn-based city building and deckbuilding game, made by 2 strategy fans. It feels like playing a solo board game. Build luminous cities, optimize your deck and create powerful combinations between buildings and cards to bring life back to a dead world. Play the demo now!

games.title: Fear the Moon
games.shortDescription: A story driven cryptid horror game featuring survival horror elements where you come face to face with a Midwest cryptid dubbed 'the Wolfman'. Play as Jane and fight to survive the full moon while uncovering dark secrets in the Wolfman's territory.

games.title: MASH VP! Re:VISION
games.shortDescription: [Fusion, synthesis, coalescence][MASH VP! Re:VISION] is a next generation music game with exciting 2 column gameplay! Featuring new tracks composed by hugely popular music game artists, choose your favorites to mash up and create a new sensation!

games.title: ReEarth
games.shortDescription: ReEarth is an exciting TD (RTS) indie game. Here, you will play as humanity's last hope. You will fend off the oncoming swarms by continuously building your base and dispatching various types of units. Prepare for the challenge and save the future of humanity!

games.title: Shokudo Underworld
games.shortDescription: Run your own sushi shokudo in a mysterious underworld. Satisfy the appetite of your customers, collect suspicious ingredients from bizarre fantastical creatures, and realize your dream of creating ... the legendary Chawanmushi!

games.title: Fruit: Chain Effect
games.shortDescription: 'Fruit: Chain Effect' is a link-and-match game where you collect and combine fruits. Obtain fruit items by completing levels or through market drops every 2 hours. Fruits come in Legendary, Rare, High, and Common rarities, with limited drops to maintain balance.

games.title: Elder Legacy: Survival
games.shortDescription: Elder Legacy: Survival is a fun cooperative open-world survival game where you and your friends will find ways to defeat bosses and progress through biomes together.

games.title: Time Over
games.shortDescription: Unlock the secret to unparalleled success through the power of teamwork!

games.title: Dust Fleet
games.shortDescription: Assume command of a battle fleet and deploy immediately to the Dust Zone, commander. Our main food supply station has gone dark and the United Earth Nations (UEN) needs to know why in this 4X RTS space sim. Manage your ships, control space stations, and watch your back.

games.title: Alchemist Adventure
games.shortDescription: Explore a world full of adventure in this action RPG that tells the story of Mya, a powerful alchemist who travels across the dangerous lands of mythical Isur trying to recall the lost memories of her past.

games.title: Lunacy: Saint Rhodes
games.shortDescription: Lunacy: Saint Rhodes is a first-person psychological horror adventure game. Explore your dark family history, solve puzzles and experience a gut-wrenching feeling of terror. You are being watched; never alone, never safe.

games.title: Drakkar Crew
games.shortDescription: Hey rookie, climb aboard! We're heading for adventure across the North Sea on our reliable Viking ship! Choose from one of the charismatic characters, hire some warriors and engage in bloody battles!

games.title: Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Regilus, a paradise planet turned into a popular tourist destination! But your holiday adventure soon turned into a nightmare. Stranded on an alien planet you need to find your way out. Remember though, not everything here is as it seems.

games.title: GONNER2
games.shortDescription: In this sequel to GoNNER: Journey your way through deep dark chaotic places with unimaginable sparks of colour as you go on a mission to help Death rid a mysterious presence from her lair. Battle crazy bosses, lose your head (a lot), in this messy, cute, fast-paced procedurally-generated platformer.

games.title: Biomass
games.shortDescription: Uncover the secrets of the sinking metropolis in this action RPG. Clash beam sabers, or be a gunslinger. Make alliances or go it alone. Your actions have consequences - those whom learn the nature of this world will be able to shape it as they see fit.

games.title: Zombie Admin
games.shortDescription: It's the zombie apocalypse, but you can't miss a work day! Scavenge for weapons, survive... and don't forget to restock the toner cartridges over at accounting. This humorous top-down shooter has you working your way up the corporate ladder, all the way to the rescue helicopter on the rooftop.

games.title: Spider Queen cave
games.shortDescription: The student sister who has been secretly in love for a long time has been missing for three months. Tonight, my sister suddenly called and asked me to go to an abandoned villa in the suburbs. I have no choice but to prepare for departure. It is said that the villa is a famous and dangerous house.

games.title: Gamer Shop Simulator
games.shortDescription: Gamer Shop Simulator - business simulation game where you own a store with goods for gamers. Here you will learn everything about the operation, development of your own store.

games.title: The Under Presents
games.shortDescription: From the creators of “Virtual Virtual Reality” - Welcome to the Under! A time and mind bending, multiplayer, theatrical adventure featuring a cast of colorful live and pre-recorded characters, time wizardry, magic to perform and stories to uncover.

games.title: Dr Livingstone, I Presume? Reversed Escape Room
games.shortDescription: Experience the reversed escape room game. Solve many different types of puzzles and venture deeper and deeper into the mansion's heart. Investigate what lies behind the mysterious letter from your dearest friend.

games.title: Beautiful Feet Cabin
games.shortDescription: The player plays a masseuse in the game and runs a beautiful foot cabin. Receive all kinds of city beauties every day, massage their feet and legs. Relieve pressure for her and satisfy self little hobbies at the same time.

games.title: Religion inc God Simulator
games.shortDescription: Create your own unique religion in god simulator strategy sandbox games

games.title: Serafina and the Key to the Egg
games.shortDescription: After receiving a challenge which could determine the future of her village, if not the whole world, Serafina sets out for the city of Mirado. There she will have to do anything she can to take part in auction to win treasure of great power, the Key to the Egg.

games.title: The Demon Lord is New in Town!
games.shortDescription: A Resource Management Adventure Game -- Play as Van, a demon lord who has had his power sealed, and has been banished to the world of mortals. Make friends and work towards regaining your former glory!

games.title: Reboot
games.shortDescription: In the fall of 2050, nearly a decade after an AI crisis ended, the Bates and two others are trying to find their last hope, Ocean City. The shortage of supplies and the threat of zombies have already made things difficult for them, and the appearance of a band of bandits has added to their woes.

games.title: Mechanic 8230: Escape from Ilgrot
games.shortDescription: Mechanic 8230: Episode 1 is an adventure game in the point-and-click genre. Help the mechanic find his robot friend RO-2 and together unveil the secrets of the world destroyed by the Cataclysm.

games.title: Toy Soldiers: HD
games.shortDescription: Command antique WWI Toy Soldiers in the trench-filled battlefields of Europe. Deploy an exciting arsenal of guns, artillery, flamethrowers, tanks and planes to defend your WWI toy dioramas. Take direct control of individual units or command the entire battlefield from above.

games.title: Shattered Heaven
games.shortDescription: Shattered Heaven is a single-player deck builder card game with RPG elements and an ambitious branching narrative, set in a dark fantasy world. The game focuses on a card game and roguelike gameplay fueled by a great replay value, thanks to procedural dungeons, a deep crafting system.

games.title: RedEx
games.shortDescription: RedEx is a 2D shooter with Tower Defence mechanics, with a minimalist pixel art stile. You are to fight against mercenaries of underground smuggling organization which pretends to be a logistic corporation called RedExpress.

games.title: Suzukuri Dungeon: Karin in the Mountain
games.shortDescription: The diabolical demon queen Karin has risen—and you’re in charge of the dungeon she calls home! Expand your budding labyrinth, train monsters to defend it, and build amenities to shake intruders down for cash before you send them packing!

games.title: Dreadhunter
games.shortDescription: Plough through hordes of deadly monsters and defeat vicious bosses in an intense fast paced shooter RPG where all items are “legendary”, levels are ever-changing and combat is razor-sharp.

games.title: I See Red
games.shortDescription: Matthew Taurus, after losing everything in a horrifying event, turned from honorable policeman into vengeful outlaw. Get ready to rage through dangerous spaceships in this frantic twin-stick shooter roguelite, where you must find your enemies and destroy them.

games.title: Absolute Tactics: Daughters of Mercy
games.shortDescription: Absolute Tactics: Daughters of Mercy is a turn-based, tactical RPG featuring strategic battles, intriguing puzzles and exciting quests. Customize your heroes’ unique, class-based attacks and abilities to defeat Father Eldritch's oppressive armies throughout dozens of unique, hand-crafted maps!

games.title: Surmount: A Mountain Climbing Adventure
games.shortDescription: Fling yourself into a mountain climbing adventure! Become the first to reach the top of the highest mountain in the world and meet eccentric characters along the way!

games.title: Roll The Cat
games.shortDescription: Did you ever wake up in the middle of the night because you heard the cat meowing? This game is just about that! Meet a family with five naughty cats and solve puzzles while trying to convince them to sleep.

games.title: Rebirth evolution
games.shortDescription: 2D pixel style simulation business strategy game Build and operate your own survivor base, recruit and cultivate various professional combatants. Clear zombie strongholds, reduce regional infections, survive in the apocalypse, and establish your own power.

games.title: The Age of Navigation
games.shortDescription: It is a single-player game with the theme of navigation. Our goal is to do our best to restore the magnificent era of navigation.

games.title: Antivine
games.shortDescription: Do plants feel? A unique boy from the village and a girl lost her memory stay together for the adventure in the Chengying plain, a breathtaking place but fulfilled with bushy vines. Through changing viewpoints and the way of thinking, solve puzzles and move towards the source of the Treeman.

games.title: TAISHO x ALICE: HEADS & TAILS
games.shortDescription: Like a coin, TAISHO x ALICE has two sides: the real world and the Looking-Glass World. Without darkness, there can be no light... It's time to take a peek behind the curtain in TAISHO x ALICE: HEADS TAILS!

games.title: Chrono Survival
games.shortDescription: On the eve of the end of the world, become the last hope for the world by standing alone against thousands of monsters. Chrono Survival is a hyper arcade rogue-lite game that combines simple gameplay and challenge.

games.title: Swords Fantasy: Battlefield
games.shortDescription: Swords Fantasy: Battlefield is a game from the 3rd person, including battles with swords.

games.title: KAOS SurVival
games.shortDescription: KAOS SurVival is a survival game in an open world, where the player can explore and find items that will make his life easier. The player can build a shelter or a large fortress to keep his possessions and defend himself from other players.

games.title: Floor44
games.shortDescription: Floor44 is a hardcore luckiness detector kinda game with randomly generated maps, the goal is to make it to the top floor. You can rely on your skills to reach floor30, but you'll need more than that to make it to Floor44.

games.title: Zodiac fantasy
games.shortDescription: The little sisters have an important date (maybe several!) Now they need your help to cross the obstacles, use jumping or climbing flexibly to reach the date, the girls will thank you for it!

games.title: A Mage Reborn
games.shortDescription: Walk the path of a legendary mage, combining four different schools of magic to devastating effects.

games.title: I commissioned some bees 2
games.shortDescription: I paid 10 more artists to hide bees in their artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

games.title: Sole Saga
games.shortDescription: Fast-paced action rogue-Like survival with a touch of Soul-like, Challenging yet rewarding gameplay!, Battle with horde of monsters, Build your favorite hero with powerful skills and weapons in Action Rogue-like style, Fight your way to the epic boss and become a legend.

games.title: Five nights at Stalin
games.shortDescription: A horror game in which the main antagonist is Stalin himself, or rather his statue. The player must use all the resources given to him to stand up to the mighty foe, or else he will face either dismissal or something worse...

games.title: Stop Dead
games.shortDescription: A rogue AI is hell-bent on destroying its creators and has swept you up in its plans. Use your superhuman abilities to run, jump, slide, and pull hundreds of objects as projectile weapons to blast everything in your path in this funny and chaotic first-person telekinetic brawler, STOP DEAD.

games.title: Ready, Steady, Ship!
games.shortDescription: Grab a buddy for this chaotic couch co-op delight. Use various tools and equipment to assemble the most efficient conveyor belts to keep the goods flowing! Best played in 2-player couch coop.

games.title: Fateweaver: The Alchemist's Quandary
games.shortDescription: You are The Fateweaver; an ancient beast of legendary status. It is your job to determine which way Fate will unravel as you dig deep into the psyche of those who beckon. Decide whether to help those who beg for your mercy, or invoke the wrath of the Gods upon those you deem unworthy of existence...

games.title: SolForge Fusion
games.shortDescription: SolForge Fusion is a CCG card-battler with robust single-player and PvP modes, where players use uniquely generated card ‘fusions’ to outmaneuver their adversaries. A game designed by Richard Garfield (Magic: The Gathering) and Justin Gary (Ascension Deckbuilding Game).

games.title: Truth of Beauty Witch -Marine's treasure ship-
games.shortDescription: A miraculous collaboration between Houshou Marine and 'Tsugunohi' has come to fruition! When the main character becomes a crew member of a pirate ship led by Houshou Marine and realizes a certain fact, you are struck by a series of horrors. Can you unravel the secret behind Houshou Marine's beauty?

games.title: PERIMETER: Legate Edition

games.title: Kitty Survivors: Rogues of Catmere

games.title: Cozy Keep: Farm, Craft, Manage

Explore the world, hunt, and cultivate the land! Own the best shop in the region and save your father from the wrath of the King!

games.title: Natti

games.title: BloodDome99

games.title: Mary Skelter Finale

games.shortDescription: Prepare your defenses during the day and survive until dawn. Defender Bros is a Top-Down Tower Defense Roguelike where you play as a Soldier defending your Base. games.title: Son of Perun Kharkiv

games.title: Amazing Grace -What color is your attribute?-

On Christmas, it all burns down—and the girl who loves it most rewinds time to the start of Advent. Find the truth in the loop and paint it on this canvas of a town!

games.title: Ghost Road Awakening

games.title: Facehand

games.title: Escape The Glubinka

games.title: Ghostbane

games.title: _message:

games.title: Amber Alert

games.title: Water Delivery
games.shortDescription: Water Delivery is a first person, horror experience where you play as a water delivery boy. Ride along in the delivery truck from house to house. Deliver filled water jugs, find and return empty jugs, and collect all the payments. Will you be able to finish your final route of the evening?

games.title: Yugo: the non-game

games.title: Banquet for Fools
games.shortDescription: The Pavura needs four volunteers to solve the mystery of an abandoned village. Answer the call in this party-based action adventure RPG.

games.title: Massive

games.title: Take That
