games.shortDescription: Before Yoru try to end his own life, a succubus girl named Lilith appeared.

games.title: Traffic Jams
games.shortDescription: In this wacky VR game, control traffic your way in the face of outrageous events and flagrant road rage. Easy? Think again! Traffic Jams throws in monsters, (un)natural disasters, and up to 4 non-VR friends in party mode!

games.title: ISOLAND: The Amusement Park
games.shortDescription: ISOLAND: The Amusement Park is the latest installment of Isoland series from CottonGame, featuring the classic and unique art style, and intriguing puzzles. As always, Isoland: The Amusement Park has a second-run mode, which presents puzzles and paths different from the first play-through.

games.title: Field Hospital: Dr. Taylor's Story
games.shortDescription: Field Hospital is a text-based bureaucratic detective game about hard decisions. Decide who to treat and whom to refuse. Face consequences. Study patients’ info and read their stories. Investigate the tangled case of Dr. Taylor.

games.title: Mini Words: Top Games
games.shortDescription: The best videogames through the decades. Test your knowledge about the games considered the best over the years in “Mini Words: Top Games”, a unique mix of logic puzzle, word search, and trivia.

games.title: Z-Race
games.shortDescription: Z-Race is a fun arcade hand-racing VR game. Control futuristic ships designed in the style of your favourite VR creators with their voice acting. Fly at super-fast speeds on chic sci-fi tracks, collecting nitro boosts and coins, avoiding energy traps and obstacles to become the first!

games.title: Chicken Bomb
games.shortDescription: It’s not justa a bomb game. It’s a CHICKEN BOMB GAME. A modern game with the old games taste.

games.title: Sakura Knight 3
games.shortDescription: Estelle's adventures in the land of Lemuria come to a head in this yuri fantasy visual novel. Estelle faces a fierce challenge in the form of the wicked dragonkin Saga, all while deciding which member of her party she wants to pledge her to heart to. It's hard to fight evil and fall in love!

games.title: The Mikado Birdgirl in Taichung
games.shortDescription: Wang Cheng-En escaped the Miaoli emperor's clutches with Pisuka. This time, they follow Mika to a holy city Taichung State. What awaits him? Will he eat lead, end up being buried as a bloated corpse in a ditch in the middle of Taiwan, or lead an ordinary daily life together with young girls?

games.title: A Case of the Crabs: Rehash
games.shortDescription: A complete remake/remaster/rehash of the award winning Flash game: A Case of the Crabs! Play as smart-ass detective, Nick Bounty, in this hilarious point click adventure and hunt down a nefarious counterfeit crab ringleader!

games.title: RXC - Rally Cross Challenge
games.shortDescription: Battle the world in reckless races as you bash, slide, and jump your way to the checkered flag. This isn't just another top-down arcade racing game. Made by two brothers, RXC is a physics heavy racing game with a traction and handling model that challenges sim racers and is still fun for newcomers.

games.title: MECHBLAZE
games.shortDescription: An inferno roars over a destroyed secret military base. Then, from the flaming rubble...an invincible super robot is reborn! Mechs born of advanced science and modern weaponry battle in heavy weight Run 'n Gun mech shooter!!

games.title: White Day VR: The Courage Test
games.shortDescription: The Notorious cult-classic Korean horror White Day returns with a unique VR experience! Step into the eerie darkness of classroom 1-1 and earn your place in the Occult Club by braving the horrors within. Will you survive the courage test?

games.title: Arcus
games.shortDescription: Defend the village from invading enemies in this third person story based game!

games.title: Save daddy trump 2: The Final Triumph
games.shortDescription: Daddy Trump is kidnapped again and now locked to container. You Kiki Trump are only hope. Destroy Peaceland country enemies and their leader Corrupt. Only by killing leader you can save daddy Trump and Restore peace to Peaceland

games.title: Sentimental Trickster: Yaoi BL Gay Visual Novel
games.shortDescription: A slice-of-life visual novel with darker twists hiding within! Haru Amari wasn't looking for love, just a new beginning far from his past. Instead he finds himself in complicated relationships where he must decide between his needs and those of the men around him.

games.title: Ragdoll: Fall Simulator
games.shortDescription: In this game, you can launch your character anywhere, watching as his limbs dangle and hit all the obstacles.

games.title: Sakura Forest Girls
games.shortDescription: Yaya, a plucky young huntress, and Aiyana, a shy girl born into a family of shamans, go on a journey to find their missing childhood friend, Koko. Along the way they meet a mischievous witch, Maia, and sparks fly.

games.title: Gordian Rooms 2: A curious island
games.shortDescription: Your adventure continues in Gordian Rooms 2... The escape island game where you venture further into the mysteries of the Gordian Society! Challenge your wits and conquer every puzzle on the Isle of Lye!

games.title: Dininho Adventures: Definitive Edition
games.shortDescription: Help out Dininho in what might be the most heroic adventure of your life! Explore this colorfull and dangerous world, rescuing all the defenseless babies. But be carefull, 'He' will be waiting at the end of every road. I trust you! Go and be the Dinoland hero.

games.title: Way Back Witness
games.shortDescription: 《归路：见证 》是一款架空世界回合制RPG游戏。 玩家将在这本不属于自己的世界内，见证忒瑞阴德上的悲欢离合，是是非非。 在冒险和旅行中，踏上那条注定不平凡的归路。

games.title: Seance
games.shortDescription: A humor-filled whodunit detective game about two detectives who use supernatural powers to solve murder mysteries that are too difficult for the police to handle alone.

games.title: Coronation
games.shortDescription: Coronation, an online open-world medieval game where you fight bandits, train with villagers, build castles and wage war against other players. NOTE: The game is undergoing a major overhaul at the moment, please wait for the next patch in 2024.

games.title: Vagabond
games.shortDescription: Explore procedurally generated living worlds in this 2D sandbox RPG. Meet hundreds of characters in cities, complete quests, craft powerful items, buy and furnish your home or fight monsters in dungeons.

games.title: NHRA Championship Drag Racing: Speed For All
games.shortDescription: NHRA™ is back – bigger and better than ever! Immerse yourself into the teams, tracks, tuning, and strategies, then strap into the driver’s seat in your ultimate quest to become the Champion among the true Beasts of the Strip™.

games.title: INHUMAN
games.shortDescription: 'INHUMAN' is an independent horror game. The story takes place in the conspiracy of an ancient clan, and the protagonist is in a psychedelic state and can't even distinguish herself. With further exploration and confrontation with all kinds of ghosts, the puzzle will be solved step by step...

games.title: 东方远空界 ~ Ultimate Vitality of Imagination
games.shortDescription: 「东方远空界」is a fangame of Touhou Project, a STG game with Touhou style.

games.title: Car Tuning Simulator
games.shortDescription: Car Tuning Simulator is designed so that you can create, modify and paint your own, luxury car, and then go to the track to test it in action!

games.title: Super Grappling Gecko
games.shortDescription: Swing over spikes and pits, find the secrets of a mysterious tree and overcome difficult challenges as a brave tiny lizard in this small adventure.

games.title: After Dark VR
games.shortDescription: After Dark VR is a VR online co-op survival horror where you play as either a Hunter on the hunt to strike down your next victim or as Survivors working together to stay alive and escape.

games.title: Dog Adventure
games.shortDescription: Dog Adventure is an incredibly challenging side-scrolling game. If you like challenging platformers, then this game is definitely for you. In this game you play as a funny dog ​​that needs to get into its house. Complete all the hardest levels of this game with funny music!

games.title: Deathsmiles I・II
games.shortDescription: Angels swooping across a disastrous sky! The shoot 'em up of gothic horrors is back

games.title: Dolmenjord - Viking Islands
games.shortDescription: Arrange Viking villages in the islands to expand their domains, in this logic puzzle game! After years of battles, a group of Vikings decided to conquer new lands. Under the protection of the god Njord, a new clan sets out in search of glory!

games.title: Chernobyl: Origins
games.shortDescription: 'Chernobyl: Origins' - is a quest game with psychological horror elements. You have to solve a lot of puzzles to find out the terrible secret of the catastrophe at the nuclear power plant. The game will take you to 1986, to the Chernobyl nuclear power plant.

games.title: My Bunny Girl
games.shortDescription: One day a lonely guy finds an amulet and puts it on his pet. His rabbit is transformed into a beautiful girl. He is embarrassed and does not even know what to say, but for the beauty girl he is not a stranger, because he is her master!

games.title: Maid PizzaHub
games.shortDescription: In the PizzaHub you will try any pizza for every taste. Spicy, sweet or maybe both? Come to our pizzeria!

games.title: F*ckable Kim
games.shortDescription: In this 2D fighter you must save humanity from a cruel, merciless, bloodthirsty dictator aspiring to world hegemony.

games.title: Age of Undead
games.shortDescription: Age of Undead is a multi-genre game (turn-based, RTS, FPS) that allows you to face the frightful Zombie Apocalypse with 3 unique factions: the Army, the Infected, and the Survivors. Make strategic choices in the Campaign, then go into battle and fight to survive!

games.title: Death or Treat
games.shortDescription: The Halloween spirit is missing! Play as Scary and help him save HallowTown. 'Death or Treat' is a 2D action-roguelite and hack slash, with handpainted environments and traditional animation. Explore all the worlds and defeat hordes of enemies using different weapons and skills.

games.title: Assassin's Vol.
games.shortDescription: 'Assassin's Vol.' is a level puzzle game. You need to drag the female protagonist with the mouse to complete the level and finally rescue her successfully. However, after attacking more enemies, it seems that their abilities can be absorbed. Well, let's work together to make her stronger!

games.title: Suns of Wiraqocha
games.shortDescription: Help the God Wiraqocha to recover all the stolen suns that have been hidden in different dimensions, which you can access through the Great Gate of the Sun, to return light to the Milky Way.

games.title: Dungeon Golf
games.shortDescription: It’s mini golf in a dungeon (duh). Whack your way through lava, traps and monsters using a lute, your fists, or your own skeletal leg. You can even score a hole-in-none! Compete with your friends online or together to be the true Dungeon Golf champion.

games.title: SokoFrog
games.shortDescription: SokoFrog is a puzzle game about pushing boxes, help your frog friend get to the next level.

games.title: EternaMine
games.shortDescription: Mine, fight monsters, upgrade your gear, obtain rare items, unlock new powers and mine some more in the massive follow-up to the popular title 'Haste-Miner 2'. Eternamine offers a casual yet engaging gameplay experience, expand your mining empire and discover the secrets that lie beneath the earth.

games.title: Tourist Trap
games.shortDescription: Face an evil corporation™ with the help of a talking monkey in Tourist Trap, a surrealist dark comedy point and click adventure set in a South American coastal city.

games.title: Right and Down and Dice
games.shortDescription: Explore randomly generated card dungeons where you can only move Right and Down, use Dice to defeat mighty enemies, gather powerful artifacts, and learn new abilities! Will you be able to escape from the dungeon?

games.title: The You Testament: The 2D Coming
games.shortDescription: This 2D remake of the biblical epic puts YOU on the scene of each story, where you can either repeat history or rewrite it! Follow in the footsteps of a prophet as he seeks to enlighten the masses, and find your place among them as the struggle to survive tests your faith...

games.title: Dude Simulator 5
games.shortDescription: Dude Simulator 5 is an open world sandbox game. Your goal is to become president! However, it will not be so easy to do this, which means that many adventures await you on your way.

games.title: Trash Horror Collection 3
games.shortDescription: We bring you 10 short horror/comedy games in this collection. Inspired by the 'Tales From the Crypt' series and cult horror movies from the 80's/90's.

games.title: Aleph
games.shortDescription: Aleph is an enigmatic cube, a repository of human lore and simulacra. After the fall of human civilization, as a traveler, you depart from the space station and eventually reach the ruins of the dilapidated city, searching for scattered cubes to read the images and texts left behind by humanity.

games.title: 天行镖客 (Sky Escort)
games.shortDescription: Sky Escort is a rogue-like card game featuring TD and management. Players roleplay an airborne mercenary,escorting clients' cargo to earn rewards. Buildcard decks, recruit crew members, and customize arms to enrich gameplay. Multiple factions can be chose from, each with unique combat style.

games.title: HYNPYTOL
games.shortDescription: They're coming. There's no hope. Still, you're a HYNPYTOL.

games.title: Bottle Can Float
games.shortDescription: Watch the bottles quietly flowing down the river, listen to the pleasant sound of running water, throw small stones into the water, and discover the small animals living by the river... I believe you will definitely gain a wonderful mood.

games.title: Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer
games.shortDescription: ──終わってしまった世界の夏、少女はあてのない旅をする。通話を介して終わってしまった世界を共に生きるアドベンチャーゲーム。

games.title: Yep!
games.shortDescription: Intonight Prequel: YEP, presents your wonderful encounter at the nightclub.

games.title: Rift's Cave
games.shortDescription: Rift's Cave is an adventure/puzzle solving Virtual Reality game for the Oculus Rift. You will live an epic adventure exploring fantasy environments, solving mysteries and using your magic skills to defend yourself from what lies within.

games.title: Space Mechanic Simulator
games.shortDescription: Become a Space Mechanic! Get your hands dirty, explore the depths of space and repair broken machinery. Diagnose problems using diagrams and tools, perform repairs, manage your resources and watch the simulated machinery come alive. Or just gaze upon the beauty of the Solar System.

games.title: Spire of Sorcery
games.shortDescription: Lead a party of runaway mages through the dangerous world of Rund. Discover alchemy. Master magic. Explore the land. Survive the challenges.

games.title: Artificiality-人造物-
games.shortDescription: This is a story puzzle RPG. Lead the Main character Hiber, who woke up from the snowstorm with no memory, on a journey home to find his memories, stop the snowstorm in this city, and the farewell and parting with the important thing——

games.title: Perfect Round Disc Golf
games.shortDescription: A disc golf simulation by the disc golfer, for the disc golfer! Inspired by classic golfing games, updated for our favorite sport. Collect real discs, upgrade skills, and keep hunting the perfect round!

games.title: Gado Fight
games.shortDescription: A pure fighting game

games.title: Eudemons Online
games.shortDescription: Experience an fantasy story with faithful pets across Yartland in Eudemons, a western style online multiplayer RPG. Fight, explore, social interact with friends, and raise pets to enjoy your own adventure.

games.title: Bake 'n Switch
games.shortDescription: Bake ‘n Switch is a cute, yet tough couch co-op and PvP party game for 1-4 players. Embark on a 'Bun Solo' single-player adventure or team up with other Bakers to catch, throw, and bake a'dough'rable living bread creatures!

games.title: ARISEN - Chronicles of Var'Nagal
games.shortDescription: ARISEN is a narrative card game where you use your emotions to create your own story in a dark fantasy universe.

games.title: Ionia
games.shortDescription: IONIA is an hour-long single-player interactive story for all ages. Get up close with music-inspired creatures in a lush forest teeming with life. Every purchase benefits real-world wildlife, with 5% of proceeds going directly to the Steve Irwin Foundation, Wildlife Warriors Worldwide.

games.title: Terra Alia: The Language Discovery RPG
games.shortDescription: Discover a new language with Terra Alia – a unique language learning experience where you can embark on a thrilling RPG adventure in the world full of magic and mysteries!

games.title: Earth Analog
games.shortDescription: In this space flight adventure game you take control of exploration vessel Eurisko XI on a quest through deep space. Visit fascinating fractal-based exoplanets and solve their mysteries. Fly through dangerous landscapes. Collect artifacts to unlock new pathways. Your goal: find our new home.

games.title: Pair-a-Site
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Pair-a-Site, the dating website of the future! But you aren't here for love. Take on the role of an alien computer virus who can control the minds of anyone they attract! Your end goal? The president of the world.

games.title: Freddy Spaghetti
games.shortDescription: Meet Freddy. Freddy is spaghetti. Oh, and conscious. Follow along Freddy's story as you plunge head first into challenges and obstacles.

games.title: Saving You From Yourself
games.shortDescription: You are a transgender therapist. The patients you encounter might regret transitioning. Your job is to protect them from that.

games.title: Cricket Captain 2020
games.shortDescription: Cricket Captain 2020 is the perfect companion if you are missing live matches, as the hugely anticipated season is disrupted. We have created the 2020 season as it was originally intended, including rain-delays in one-day matches, and the new 100 ball competition.

games.title: House Sitter
games.shortDescription: ​Explore the wacky world of House Sitter, and discover what secrets lie in wait. Meet new friends! Choose their fate!... Uncover who you truly are. But most importantly, get those chores done before Mom comes home.

games.title: Void Tyrant
games.shortDescription: Collect an intergalactic bounty of eccentric allies and deadly weapons, explore vibrant planets, and engage in risky turn-based battles to restore the Eyes of Chronos and save the galaxy in this strategic roguelike deckbuilder!

games.title: Dennkind Dock
games.shortDescription: Extent your Desktop with the stylish designed and animated Dock. Add games and apps to the integrated library. Customize with Skins and Extensions. Create your own user profiles to quickly switch between multiple environments.

games.title: The Running Man
games.shortDescription: If you want to relax, this game is not for you, this game is made to make you rage. go through challenging and hard levels and run to the finish line. will you take the challenge?

games.title: Motoride Rollercoaster VR
games.shortDescription: Motoride will take you to a journey full of joy and danger. Admire beautiful view from top of the mountains, go deep into dark caves and discover ancient forgotten ruins. An extremely exciting ride on a cross bike in virtual reality can make you dizzy.

games.title: Keepers of the Trees
games.shortDescription: “Keepers of the Trees” is a couch co-op puzzle platformer that gives you the power to control nature. Along with a friend, you will test your platforming mettle, work together to solve puzzles by growing special plants, and explore a lush, fantasy forest world.

games.title: First Session
games.shortDescription: A blend of RPG, psychological horror, and narrative exploration. You are a virtual drug addict, evolving between digital universes and a megalopolis. Complete missions to buy your next dose, build a relationship with your AI, and learn to survive with the mysterious creator of Wild Dose.

games.title: The USB Stick Found in the Grass
games.shortDescription: A forensic challenge – find out who the owner of the USB stick was and reconstruct their story.

games.title: Pummel Paladins
games.shortDescription: Pummel Paladins is a 1v1 brawler with a creative twist. Don't be mistaken, just because the knights lost their weapons doesn't mean they are going to stop their destined duel. Push, parry, utilize the environment and items to outplay your opponent in this retro, dungeon arena!

games.title: Attack at Dawn: North Africa
games.shortDescription: Attack at Dawn is a WWII strategy game that mixes the ease of real-time action with the depth of operational gameplay, all on beautifully crafted North Africa maps. Plan your strategy like Rommel or Montgomery and better the real history.

games.title: The Cleaner
games.shortDescription: The Cleaner is a hardcore die 'n' retry inspired by John Wick, Hotline Miami and SuperHot. You control a highly-trained ' cleaner ' with a unique power. No cliché storyline, no cutscenes, start the game and play.

games.title: Sakura MMO Extra
games.shortDescription: Join Viola in this light-hearted yuri fantasy story set in the magical realm of Asaph, as she tackles her biggest challenge yet: working at a maid café.

games.title: A Way To Be Dead
games.shortDescription: A Way to be Dead is an asymmetrical multiplayer (up to 5 players) horror game. Players can take on the role of killer, the victims, or even the undeads. Escape | Kill | Eat...

games.title: The Picture in The House
games.shortDescription: A journey through ancient mysteries and forces described by the original short story 'The Picture in the House' written by H.P Lovecraft.

games.title: Poached : Hunt The Hunter
games.shortDescription: As a game ranger, use your expert tracking skills and cunning to outsmart invading poachers.

games.title: CyberWaifu
games.shortDescription: Engage in video chat and interaction with cyber waifu, supporting custom character models and settings, and support workshop.

games.title: The Penguin IQ Test
games.shortDescription: Can you save the penguin? Help him get back to the ice floe. This game will pretend to measure your intelligence quotient and give you a result between zero and one hundred eighty.

games.title: Otherwar
games.shortDescription: OTHERWAR is an surprising mash-up of Tower Defense Bullet Hell games. Build and manage fortifications to defend the Gate of Heaven against the Hordes of Hell, while soaring over the battlefields as the defender Angel, and meet the monsters in direct combat!

games.title: Darkness Under My Bed
games.shortDescription: Wander through intricate maze under the bed, and discover the secrets hidden in the long, dark tunnels. Document the existence of monsters. Retrieve the stolen treasures and memories.

games.title: Super Retro Fighter
games.shortDescription: Classic STG game Have fun with your friends just like your childhood!

games.title: Medieval Machines Builder
games.shortDescription: Medieval - times of constant sieges. Acquire plans, gather resources, create most powerful and destructive machines and then test them in battle. Thanks to your creations you will conquer more than one castle. The knights wage wars, but thanks to your machines they win them.

games.title: Cards of the Dead
games.shortDescription: Cards of the Dead is a survival card game. Play your cards right and you might escape the zombie apocalypse!

games.title: ARK and ADE
games.shortDescription: ARK and ADE is an action-jammed VR FPS shooter in which you get to experience the glory of the 80’s arcade era in a neon fused setting 🤘😎. Shoot your way through retro-futuristic levels filled with enemies, iconic over the top bosses and never ending bullets. Insert coin to play! 🤖

games.title: Facteroids
games.shortDescription: Facteroids is a 3D factory building game about asteroid mining in space. Prospect, mine and manage your production lines in a variety of scenarios and procedurally generated worlds across the entire Solar system.

games.title: my brother lives in a canyon
games.shortDescription: my brother lives in a canyon is a short adventure game about two brothers reminiscing over short-wave radios.

games.title: Fostering Apocalypse
games.shortDescription: The demon summoned to embark the second apocalypse is only a child, and a woman who has lost it all resolves to save her. A half-hour long narrative game with survival gameplay elements and two endings.

games.title: Sven's SudokuPad
games.shortDescription: Play your own sudokus in Cracking the Cryptic's beloved puzzle app.

games.title: Stones Keeper
games.shortDescription: Stones Keeper is a turn-based strategy game with RPG elements in which you explore a detailed fantasy world, lead the Order of the Griffin, recruit and enhance your fighters, control a flying island, search for artifacts, and learn the secrets of the ancients.

games.title: Miraculous: Rise of the Sphinx
games.shortDescription: Paris needs a hero! Once again, the city of lights is in trouble as it faces a new menace! As you take on the personas of the globally renowned superheroez Ladybug and Cat Noir, you’ll need to unveil the diabolical plan hatched by archvillain Hawk Moth—and squash it!

games.title: SOMNI
games.shortDescription: Somni is a thrilling paranormal investigation first person shooter. Investigate your surroundings and survive your encounters with Ethereal Beings or Cryptids.

games.title: Time Commando
games.shortDescription: For retro gaming lover, discover a jewel of 1996: Time Commando Let's fight across 9 time periods: prehistoric, Roman, feudal Japan, Medieval, Conquistador, the Wild West, and the modern wars

games.title: Deadnaut: Signal Lost
games.shortDescription: Deadnaut: Signal Lost is a sci-fi horror turn-based roguelike where loyalty isn't earned - it's installed. Scavenge derelict ships and abandoned moons filled with hellish creatures, brutal AI and insanity storms. Gather gear and upgrades to fight or evade the hi-tech supersoldiers hunting you down.

games.title: Bad Cat
games.shortDescription: There are many different burgers in the world: a bacon burger, a chicken burger, a royal burger. But there is also a cat named Burger, and this guy is definitely too tough for you.

games.title: Polylithic
games.shortDescription: Polylithic is a survival game unlike any other, set in the most pivotal moment in mankind's history: the Stone Age. Experience life as a Paleolithic hunter-gatherer, settle down as a Neolithic Farmer, form tribes, or go at it alone in a world where we're not yet the apex predator.

games.title: Profession investigator
games.shortDescription: Profession Investigator is an immersive simulator with a text-based interface in which you have to deal with real criminal cases. The game uses materials from court archives and specialized literature.

games.title: Ganryu 2
games.shortDescription: Play as Miyamoto Musashi in this beautiful 2D platformer and travel through a 17th century fantasy Japan, from north to the island of Ganryu-jima where everything happened between Musashi and Kojiro. The game is inspired by the story of Takezo Musashi from the famous novel “The Stone And The Sword”.

games.title: Warplan Pacific
games.shortDescription: WarPlan Pacific is an operational level wargame which covers all the nations at war in the Pacific theatre from December 1941 to 1945 on a massive game scale.

games.title: Kill It With Fire VR
games.shortDescription: The spider: Usually hairy, often poisonous and ALWAYS up to something. Take your arachnophobia to new heights in Kill it With Fire VR, and deal with spiders by any means necessary!

games.title: TAPE: Unveil the Memories
games.shortDescription: Use a special video camera that can rewind time to explore memories of the past in TAPE: Unveil the Memories, a first-person narrative mystery adventure set in 1990s Northern Spain.

games.title: Forrader Hero
games.shortDescription: Forrader Hero – turn-based game with roguelike elements where heroes can’t step back and must fight through the end to save their soul in ‘Forgotten Proto.World’ fighting hordes of monsters, undead creatures, and their overlords.

games.title: 天香与小百合 - Tinheung & Sayuri
games.shortDescription: Tinheung Sayuri is a game of visual novel. This is a short Yuri story across age, nationality and gender.

games.title: Mr. Run and Jump
games.shortDescription: Help Mr. Run and Jump defeat the terrifying Void and collect all of the Power Gems from the Realms of Color! Venture through a dazzling and dangerous world, dodging countless enemies and conquering hundreds of fierce platforming challenges to save the day!

games.title: Pilfer: Story of Light
games.shortDescription: A 3D platforming journey, featuring a cute raccoon that must save the forest from darkness! Master dozens of different level mechanics as you run and jump through course-based worlds, saving other animals along the way.

games.title: Ghost Signal: A Stellaris Game
games.shortDescription: Ghost Signal is a VR action roguelite set in the Stellaris universe, where you captain your ship to battle a multitude of alien species. Partake in dynamic space wars, encounter planet sized creatures, gather valuable loot to conduct research, and more. No journey is the same.

games.title: Wilderless
games.shortDescription: Wilderless is a walking/hiking/photography simulator set in a fantasy wilderness. Players can explore a beautiful, procedurally generated natural open world. Tons of options allow you to configure many aspects of the world, and you can choose your initial world seed to generate different worlds.

games.title: Raiders of Valhalla
games.shortDescription: Lead a fearless horde of Viking dwarves, strengthen them with legendary equipment, conquer unknown lands, and witness the colossal destruction they leave behind. How far will you be able to take your warriors? The journey to glory begins now!

games.title: Gore Storm
games.shortDescription: Battle massive hordes of alien monsters to secure humanity's presence on planet Gore. Upgrade your base, hire troops, and install turrets to fight back the ever growing waves of aliens.

games.title: Eggstraction
games.shortDescription: Eggstraction is a multiplayer (4vs1) heist game where four feathered friends must face off against an egg-napping farmer. With chaos around every corner, can the chickens rescue their stolen eggs, or will they end up back in their cage?

games.title: Alchemist's Fantasy R ~ A Girl's Alchemic Furnace ~
games.shortDescription: The young alchemist Meti from the village, along with her boyfriend Nero, begins a quest to find their missing master. Meti's ability to synthesize magical creatures helps the couple overcome various challenges they encounter on the way, and they discover a secret that changes their lives.

games.title: Suicide Guy: The Lost Dreams
games.shortDescription: The Lost Dreams is the new chapter from the Suicide Guy game series: a first person puzzle game set in a world of new crazy dreams. In this adventure you'll have to find a way to wake up from your nightmares.

games.title: Chroma Wars
games.shortDescription: A retro, turn-based strategy game on a square-map where you engage in techno-fantasy warfare in the world of Etrom! Command powerful armies, repel abyssal foes, and save your base in the dying desert fighting high-skill strategic battles.

games.title: Selene's Unbearable Night
games.shortDescription: A third person survival horror game. Search for key objects, solve puzzles and face dangers in order to escape. Inspired by the old survival horror, with two playable characters and modern mechanics delve into the narrative story of Selene's Unbearable night.

games.title: Experimentation
games.shortDescription: A linear visual novel about five short stories, unrelated at first glance. Be prepared for mysticism, gloomy atmosphere and light psychological horror. Not recommended to play if you are experiencing depression or severe psychological state.

games.title: Doodle Adventure of Chameleon
games.shortDescription: Chameleon is a side-scrolling platformer with a hand-drawn doodle style. In this world of doodles, you will play as a chameleon created by a young boy's imagination. With the whimsical and imaginative adventures the young boy envisions, the charming chameleon embarks on thrilling adventures!

games.title: Bot Maker For Discord

games.shortDescription: Play the CEO of a multi-national conglomerate in this business simulation. Grow crops, raise livestock, build mines and oil wells to get the raw resources needed to make more than 75 types of consumer goods.

games.title: Zemblanity
games.shortDescription: Zemblanity is an atmospheric first-person horror game. What seemed like a little creepy invitation over from an old childhood friend turns into disturbing uncovering of mysterious forces ruling in the mansion. Will you find a way out?

games.title: World Championship Boxing Manager™ 2
games.shortDescription: The boxing world is at your fingertips in this deeply detailed and outrageously entertaining sports management simulation. Enlist competitive fighters, recruit top-notch staff, and ride the hype train all the way to endorsement city! Watch your fighter rise to the top, or get KO’d trying.

games.title: SEARCH ALL - SPIDERS
games.shortDescription: Is a hidden object game in which you need to find all the spiders in a large location. Spiders will be located in a variety of places, from the most prominent to barely noticeable places

games.title: Devil's 5 Days Mischief Game
games.shortDescription: Traveling with Ria, a devil contracted as both a companion and girlfriend, the protagonist faces her disdain due to a mundane lifestyle. They encounter a powerful adventurer, leading to an odd five-day competition where the winner becomes Ria's new contractor.

games.title: My Slow Life with the Princess Knight and Her Devoted Handmaiden
games.shortDescription: Garland used to be a formidable adventurer... But then he was betrayed and left for dead. Now he has a reputation as the Dragon Survivor and no one left in the world he can rely on. When he brings two beautiful servants into his life to tend his wounds, will he learn to open his heart again?

games.title: Void Prison
games.shortDescription: Void Prison is a fast paced, endless arcade twin stick shooter that puts you inside of an ever shrinking ring. Survive by fighting emerging enemies around you and don't get consumed by the void. Complete achievements to unlock new skins and powerups and get on top of the leaderboards!

games.title: Battlerace
games.shortDescription: Battlerace is a first-person shooter with dynamic battlefields. Apply your own strategy using the available arsenal and lead your team to victory on a map with up to 16 players.

games.title: Boiling Point: Road to Hell
games.shortDescription: Saul Myers is back in action and ready to take on the world to get his daughter back. Do you have what it takes to complete his mission?

games.title: 風色幻想SP:封神之刻
games.shortDescription: 以全新故事为主轴的《风色幻想ＳＰ》，除了再一次以极为震憾动人的深刻内容与华丽的人物风格获得了玩家们极大回响外，它成熟的内容系统亦也让该作品创造了更胜前作的爆发性销售量，甚至还获得了当年代表着最有人气的游戏大奖GAMESTAR之肯定，可说是实至名归的千禧年PCGAME界代表作品。当然，这款简称为风ＳＰ的风色异色作，亦是老玩家们最为津津乐道、风色迷决不能错过的风色经典之作。

games.title: Estencel
games.shortDescription: Atmospheric souls-like. Fight enemies and bosses and explore the gloomy city.

games.title: Mystery of Mortlake Mansion
games.shortDescription: Mystery of Mortlake Mansion is a hidden object adventure game with a deep and interesting story. The player is summoned to Mortlake Mansion by an elderly gentleman, who was so obsessed with magic that he dedicated his entire life to tracking down and learning the secrets of his favorite magician.

games.title: Alchemist: The Potion Monger
games.shortDescription: First-person Alchemist Simulator with RPG elements. Explore the world, gather ingredients, and sell or use potions you craft to help others and fend off enemies. Adopt pets to help you with your alchemy knowledge (and to pet them). Decorate your home however you like and brew your destiny!

games.title: Lost Cartridge - Cold Read
games.shortDescription: While trying to find a payphone during a powerful storm, Mitch instead finds himself in a library filled with horrors and traps all laid out to end his life. Guide him to sanctuary or his demise in this horror adventure game found on a strange cartridge.

games.title: MIND CORRIDORS: Paroniria
games.shortDescription: A fever-dream-like puzzle horror game. Descend to the depths of a sleeping curse, survive every floor and find your way out of the never ending nightmare.

games.title: Temporian
games.shortDescription: Trapped in the past, your survival hinges on your ability to adapt and innovate. From foraging for food to mastering the art of technology, every decision you make shapes your destiny. Will you return to your own time, or make the past your new future in this mind-bending survival game?

games.title: League Manager 2023
games.shortDescription: Complete your own squad, try to win the league, and experience a thrilling win in the World Championship. The journey to E-Sport League glory awaits.

games.title: Pixel Town: Akanemachi Mystery 2
games.shortDescription: Disturbances have returned to Akanemachi. It's now up to Aya and her new ally, Fuu, to quell the evil and bring peace back to Akanemachi for good!

games.title: Frogun Encore
games.shortDescription: Frogun ENCORE is a dashing standalone expansion/sequel to indie hit FROGUN! Join now older Renata and Jake in a trek around the whole world to prevent the return of Beelzebub. ENCORE builds on FROGUN's retro PS1/N64 formula. Plus, enjoy the whole adventure in true couch co-op.

games.title: A Street Cat's Tale 2: Outside is Dangerous
games.shortDescription: [Adventures of House Cat Cinnamon]*A street cat's tale 2 is a narrative-led puzzle adventure game about the struggles of stray cats.

games.title: Lotte
games.shortDescription: A minimalistic five-minute puzzle platformer, where you become a fly when you die. Immerse yourself in a soothing forest and use your ability to become a fly to solve puzzles.

games.title: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS 2
games.shortDescription: The Earth is in pieces...again! We've gotta do more to save the planet!

games.title: Cyberside Picnic
games.shortDescription: Cyberside Picnic is a eulogy for the cyberian commonplace that just eluded us. A love letter to a lost future of alternative video games, delete and overwrite.

games.title: Praise Dead
games.shortDescription: Praise Dead is a roguelike auto-battler where you create zombies from the parts of dead villagers and monsters. Use your zombies to defeat waves of demons, and to harvest resources to improve and upgrade your village.

games.title: Geometry Survivor
games.shortDescription: Geometry Survivor is rogue-lite survival where you fight waves of enemies. Unlock innovative upgrades in the shop, acquire new ships and conquer the unforgiving grid world.

games.title: Athos
games.shortDescription: Welcome to a captivating journey into the world of Athos. Build a formidable base to protect yourself from the wild and unpredictable environment, and master the art of taming mighty dinosaurs to be your loyal companions. Welcome to a world where survival is not just a choice but a way of life!

games.title: Install Fee Tycoon
games.shortDescription: Chaos3D, The popular game engine, has started charging developers each time their games are installed. They are also paying you to re-install those games. Get Rich, and destroy the video game industry in the process!

games.title: Fallen Seeds
games.shortDescription: As Evod, a special agent of the Earth Empire, you embark on a thrilling adventure to the enigmatic planet of Ulthar, inhabited by the zoomorphic tribe of the Flock, a biotechnological extraterrestrial civilization. Your mission is to unravel an ancient mystery that holds the key to your destiny.

games.title: Other Side Of Mist And Mountain
games.shortDescription: In 2005, a sophomore student named Maha Igarashi boarded a private train to Soukyo City. However, she vanished upon alighting at the 'Kisaragi' station. Five years later, her lover, Shizuno Yokoyama, initiated an investigation into her disappearance, unraveling a series of mysteries along the way.

games.title: PO'ed: Definitive Edition
games.shortDescription: PO’ed is an adrenaline-pumping space shooter that features gameplay elements inspired by generational powerhouses DOOM and QUAKE. Play as a chef who crashlands on an alien planet infested with extraterrestrial foes. Using a menu of “household” weapons, PO’ed puts your wits and reflexes to the test.

games.title: Polda
games.shortDescription: Pancras is a neurotic cop investigating a case of mysterious kidnapping in the town of Lupany. Help him find out, who’s behind the abduction of two orderly citizens!

games.title: Farmcoz
games.shortDescription: Cozy Sandbox Game about Farming and Building. Is it raining outside? Just chill and relax with warm and cheerful atmosphere of Farmcoz. Farm, Build, Explore, Explode and Unlock all items. Good luck!

games.title: Disillusion ST
games.shortDescription: A strange journey throughout an elaborate labyrinth awaits, featuring hundreds of characters and happenings as you try to gather items that once brought happiness to others.

games.title: Avian Enigma
games.shortDescription: Avian Enigma is a sci-fi visual novel game featuring in a world where birds have become extinct. The story begins with a young man working in a factory accidentally saves a bird. Soon, a girl who has a mysterious relationship with birds appears in front of him. A romance with a tiny twist begins.

You wake up with a bad hangover and don’t recognize your home. You see a boy and you understand... that something is wrong with him. Someone's presence causes anxiety, fear and is about to plunge you into the realm of horror. But you don’t lose hope and try to get out of this nightmare.

games.title: 墙之恐惧: The Walls Still Stand
games.shortDescription: Step into the eerie Kowloon Walled City in 墙之恐惧: The Walls Still Stand, an indie horror walking simulator. Complete daily tasks, uncover dark secrets, and explore with 3D spatial sound. Think critically to unlock all six endings in this 1-2 hour journey. Can you escape the city's grip?

games.title: FATAL ERROR - RTS
games.shortDescription: FATAL ERROR is a real-time strategy game on the digital battlefields of a computer world under attack. With your TAC-AID and advanced programming, you must eliminate all threats to the Mainframe and take the fight to the viruses. Discover an abstract world of limitless potential…and lurking dangers.

games.title: One Dollar Simulator
games.shortDescription: This is, in truth, the best simulator of 2020! This simulator will transform your dollar from your ordinary and everyday world - into a DOLLAR of the world of beauty and harmony!

games.title: Aeon Must Die!
games.shortDescription: Ignite the galaxy. Aeon Must Die! Experience a unique beat ‘em-up introducing breakneck risk-reward gameplay, innovative AI and tactical fighting, all packaged in an incredible art style.

games.title: The Captain is Dead
games.shortDescription: It’s the last 10 minutes of your favorite sci-fi TV show… except that this time things have gone seriously wrong and The Captain Is Dead! This turn-based, survival/strategy puts you in the Captain's chair as you try to save your crew from being blown to bits by aliens...

games.title: Ballistic Craft
games.shortDescription: A bullet hell of your own making! Play the game where strategy and creativity meet - duel rival wizards in real time battle arenas with custom shot crafting to win the League of Crafters!

games.title: The Adventures of Looppy
games.shortDescription: More than a platformer![/]

games.title: Battle Axe
games.shortDescription: Battle Axe is an arcade top-down hack slash featuring high-quality visuals created by veteran pixel artist Henk Nieborg, true to form game mechanics, and music from the legendary VGM composer Manami Matsumae – retro gamers rejoice!

games.title: Virtuoso
games.shortDescription: Grab an instrument and get ready to jam in Virtuoso, your own virtual music stage! This VR musical sandbox lets anyone play and perform music in new, immersive ways. Explore a range of unique instruments made for VR and share your tracks with the world!

games.title: The Walking Evil
games.shortDescription: The Walking Evil takes you to the great classic of the survival horror of the 90s, where you guide the main character with a fixed system of cameras, which enhances the feeling of being in a real horror movie.

games.title: 黄河大合唱 Song of Yellow River
games.shortDescription: The Song of Yellow River focused on the Anti-Japanese War from 1931 to 1945. This game will lead players to experience one of the most brutal battles in human history. From far to near, from north to south, guide players to understand the history of the anti-Japanese ancestors.

games.title: Into A Dream
games.shortDescription: You are his last hope. The only one who can rescue him. Delve deep into the dreams of Luke Williams, a man diagnosed with depression, unfold the heartbreaking story of his life and prevent him from... fading away.

games.title: Domino Simulator
games.shortDescription: Domino Simulator is a physics-based sandbox game in which you place various domino tiles and pieces to construct domino chains. Enjoy the odd satisfaction of watching your creation fall one after the other. Ultimately, the floor is yours to fill and the how and the what is completely up to you.

games.title: SGS Afrika Korps
games.shortDescription: The game recreates the campaigns and battles of Erwin ‘Desert Fox’ Rommel’s legendary Afrika Korps, in Libya between 1941 and 1942. Play the Axis forces to conquer the most valuable prize of all: the Suez Canal. Or command the 8th Army soldiers, the famous Desert Rats, to repel the invaders.

games.title: Touhou Double Focus
games.shortDescription: The Touhou derivative exploration action game Double Focus is now on Steam! Control crow tengu journalist and low-ranking patrol tengu Momiji Inubashiri and explore the world inside a book!

games.title: Lost Circus VR - The Prologue
games.shortDescription: Meet a mysterious Clown and his abandoned circus. Will You dare to start a thrilling night excursion? If You dare to get into a barrel on the old, rusty cart, pushed by a strange Clown - get ready for an extreme experience.

games.title: One Try, One Kill
games.shortDescription: One try, one kill - a gory TDS game, in which you must clean the areas of ruthless mercenary. The game is a top-down so you could view the battle situation as it's best.

games.title: Silmaris: Dice Kingdom
games.shortDescription: Unforgiving storytelling adventure with dice rolls and turn-based management. Make the right choices and roll the dice to rally the monarchs to your medieval kingdom by diplomacy, war or deception.

# Arch Linux para Linux gaming

Esta página reúne referências para instalar e configurar ferramentas de jogo nesta distribuição. O gerenciador de pacotes identificado é **pacman**.

## Escopo da família

Use o ecossistema pacman e a ArchWiki como referência principal. CachyOS, EndeavourOS, Manjaro e outras derivadas podem alterar repositórios, kernels ou ferramentas; valide sempre a documentação específica da derivada antes de aplicar comandos.

## Versão e ciclo de atualização

Modelo rolling. Confirme o estado do sistema com `pacman -Q` e leia as notícias oficiais antes de atualizações que envolvam kernel ou Mesa.

Antes de seguir qualquer guia, registre também o kernel com `uname -r`. A referência vinculada ao artigo é a fonte de verdade para a sua edição.

## Drivers e Vulkan

Use os pacotes Mesa/Vulkan e NVIDIA documentados na ArchWiki; em hardware multilib, valide também bibliotecas de 32 bits.

Antes de alterar drivers, registre `lspci -k -d ::03xx`, o driver carregado e a saída de `vulkaninfo --summary` quando a ferramenta estiver disponível.

## Steam, Proton e runtimes

Para jogos Windows, Proton e Wine dependem de runtimes, drivers gráficos e Vulkan. A compatibilidade pode mudar por versão de distribuição, kernel, GPU, driver, Proton e anti-cheat; a ausência de dados na plataforma não é confirmação de funcionamento. Prefira os guias filtrados pela distribuição ou caminhos cross-distro via Flatpak quando apropriado.

## Otimização segura

Prefira atualizar o sistema inteiro antes de investigar regressões e registre a versão de kernel/driver em cada teste.

Teste primeiro o jogo sem launch options. Em seguida, altere uma variável por vez — por exemplo, Proton, MangoHud, GameMode ou resolução — e registre o resultado junto com o ambiente. Não publique FPS sem fonte, método, preset e resolução declarados.

Esta página não atribui um score de gaming enquanto não houver uma metodologia e fonte publicadas.

guides.title: Instalar Steam pelo Flatpak
guides.description: Guia cross-distro para instalar o aplicativo com o ID com.valvesoftware.Steam. O pacote no Flathub é comunitário e não possui suporte oficial da Valve.

steps.title: Confirmar Flatpak e o remoto Flathub
steps.explanation: O comando requer que Flatpak e o remoto flathub já estejam configurados no sistema. Consulte a documentação do Flatpak caso o remoto não exista.
steps.warning: Não execute comandos de repositório sem confirmar a política da sua distribuição.

steps.title: Instalar o aplicativo Steam
steps.explanation: O identificador listado pelo Flathub para o Steam é com.valvesoftware.Steam.
steps.warning: O Flathub identifica esta entrega como pacote comunitário e sem suporte oficial da Valve.

steps.title: Conceder acesso a uma biblioteca em outra unidade, se necessário
steps.explanation: Use apenas quando a biblioteca estiver em outro caminho e você souber qual diretório deseja compartilhar com o aplicativo.
steps.warning: Substitua o caminho pelo diretório real. Esta permissão amplia o acesso do aplicativo a arquivos locais.

guides.title: Instalar Steam na família Arch
guides.description: Instalação do pacote Steam para Arch Linux. Derivadas podem alterar repositórios e opções de kernel.

steps.title: Validar repositórios e arquitetura
steps.explanation: Confira a documentação do Arch e da sua derivada antes de instalar. O pacote Steam pode depender de repositórios multilib e de bibliotecas de 32 bits.
steps.warning: Não habilite repositórios sem confirmar a documentação da sua distribuição.

steps.title: Instalar Steam
steps.explanation: Instala o pacote Steam disponibilizado pelo ecossistema pacman.
steps.warning: Confirme o pacote e as dependências que o gerenciador apresentar antes de aceitar.

guides.title: Instalar Steam via Flatpak na família Fedora
guides.description: Caminho de aplicativo isolado para Fedora, Nobara e outros sistemas que usem Flatpak. Bazzite pode ter fluxos próprios documentados.

steps.title: Confirmar Flatpak e Flathub
steps.explanation: Use a documentação do seu sistema para verificar se o remoto Flathub está configurado.
steps.warning: Em imagens imutáveis, não misture instruções rpm-ostree e Flatpak sem saber onde o aplicativo será instalado.

steps.title: Instalar Steam
steps.explanation: O identificador publicado pelo Flathub para o aplicativo Steam é com.valvesoftware.Steam.
steps.warning: O Flathub classifica essa entrega como comunitária e sem suporte oficial da Valve.

guides.title: Instalar Steam via Flatpak na família Debian/Ubuntu
guides.description: Caminho isolado para Debian, Ubuntu, Pop!_OS, Mint e KDE neon quando Flatpak estiver configurado.

steps.title: Confirmar a release e Flatpak
steps.explanation: Valide a versão do sistema e a disponibilidade do Flatpak antes de instalar o aplicativo.
steps.warning: Não combine instruções de PPAs, pacotes deb e Flatpak sem identificar qual instalação do Steam você irá usar.

steps.title: Instalar Steam
steps.explanation: Instala o aplicativo do Flathub pelo identificador documentado.
steps.warning: O pacote é comunitário segundo a página do Flathub.

guides.title: Instalar Steam via Flatpak no openSUSE
guides.description: Caminho com Flatpak para openSUSE; valide se a instalação é Leap ou Tumbleweed e siga a documentação local para repositórios.

steps.title: Confirmar tipo de instalação
steps.explanation: Leap e Tumbleweed possuem ciclos e versões de pacotes diferentes; confira a documentação antes de alterar o sistema.
steps.warning: Este guia cobre o aplicativo Flatpak e não substitui instruções de repositórios zypper.

steps.title: Instalar Steam
steps.explanation: Instala o aplicativo do Flathub com o identificador Steam publicado.
steps.warning: O aplicativo é distribuído pelo Flathub como pacote comunitário.

guides.title: Diagnosticar Vulkan antes de ajustar um jogo
guides.description: Coleta um resumo da implementação Vulkan disponível. Instale a ferramenta de diagnóstico apenas por um método aprovado pela sua distribuição.

steps.title: Confirmar que a ferramenta existe
steps.explanation: O comando só funciona quando a ferramenta vulkaninfo estiver instalada no sistema.
steps.warning: Não use a ausência de vulkaninfo como prova de que o driver está ausente; instale ferramentas somente pela documentação da sua distribuição.

steps.title: Registrar o ambiente
steps.explanation: Guarde versão de kernel, GPU, driver e saída resumida para uma submissão de benchmark ou report técnico.
steps.warning: Evite compartilhar identificadores sensíveis do dispositivo em reports públicos.

guides.title: Usar MangoHud e GameMode na inicialização do jogo
guides.description: Exemplo de opção de inicialização para quem já instalou MangoHud e GameMode usando o método documentado pela própria distribuição.

steps.title: Confirmar que as ferramentas estão instaladas
steps.explanation: Este guia não instala pacotes: nomes e disponibilidade variam por distribuição.
steps.warning: Não copie comandos de instalação de outra família de distribuição.

steps.title: Definir opção de inicialização

guides.title: Configurar Proton de forma básica no Steam

steps.title: Testar sem opções adicionais

guides.title: Validar ambiente Mesa/Vulkan em GPUs AMD e Intel

steps.title: Executar diagnóstico quando disponível
steps.explanation: Se a sua distribuição fornecer vulkaninfo, use o resumo para validar a implementação ativa.

guides.title: Validar ambiente NVIDIA e Vulkan

steps.title: Verificar diagnóstico Vulkan
steps.explanation: Use o diagnóstico resumido somente se a ferramenta estiver presente no sistema.
steps.warning: Não conclua que um driver está ausente apenas porque a ferramenta de diagnóstico não está instalada.

guides.title: Avaliar FSR e opções de inicialização

steps.title: Verificar suporte dentro do jogo

steps.warning: Não use uma variável de ambiente de FSR copiada de outro jogo como recomendação geral.

steps.title: Registrar resolução e método
steps.explanation: Ao comparar resultado, registre resolução interna, resolução de saída, versão de Proton e driver.
steps.warning: Não rotule uma observação pessoal como benchmark verificado sem fonte e ambiente completos.

steps.title: Relatar com contexto
steps.explanation: Inclua GPU, driver, Proton/Wine, resolução e launcher.
steps.warning: Sem ambiente completo, a observação não deve ser tratada como benchmark verificado.

guides.title: FSR e upscaling no openSUSE
guides.description: Avaliação de upscaling no openSUSE com separação entre Leap, Tumbleweed, jogo e camada de compatibilidade.

steps.title: Verificar opção nativa
steps.explanation: Use primeiro o menu do jogo ou do launcher quando houver configuração de upscaling.
steps.warning: Não há opção zypper que habilite FSR para todos os títulos.

steps.title: Registrar edição e runtime
steps.explanation: Anote Leap/Tumbleweed, GPU, driver e versão de Proton/Wine.
steps.warning: Não aplique parâmetros encontrados para outro engine sem confirmar suporte.

steps.title: Comparar de forma rastreável
steps.explanation: Mantenha resolução de saída, escala interna e preset iguais ao comparar.
steps.warning: Não apresente FPS sem fonte e método declarados.

fixes.title: Steam Flatpak não acessa uma biblioteca em outra unidade
fixes.symptoms: O seletor de biblioteca não consegue acessar a pasta desejada fora das permissões do sandbox.
fixes.possibleCauses: O aplicativo Flatpak pode não ter acesso ao diretório que contém a biblioteca Steam.

solutions.title: Conceder acesso apenas à pasta da biblioteca
solutions.explanation: A página do Flathub orienta adicionar uma permissão de filesystem para a pasta da biblioteca que o usuário escolheu.
solutions.warning: Use o menor caminho necessário e confira a pasta antes de confirmar o comando.

fixes.title: Jogo Proton não inicia
fixes.symptoms: O jogo fecha imediatamente, não abre ou retorna ao launcher sem mensagem útil.
fixes.possibleCauses: A causa pode envolver versão de Proton, runtime, dependência ausente, caminho de biblioteca, anti-cheat ou um problema específico do jogo.

solutions.title: Testar sem opções adicionais
solutions.explanation: Remova overlays, scripts e opções de inicialização para verificar se uma personalização está bloqueando o processo.
solutions.warning: Altere uma variável por vez para manter um histórico do diagnóstico.

solutions.title: Registrar versão e log
solutions.explanation: Anote a versão do Proton, distribuição, kernel e driver; use a documentação do launcher para coletar logs quando necessário.
solutions.warning: Logs podem conter caminhos locais; revise-os antes de publicar em um report.

fixes.title: Vulkan não aparece ou falha no diagnóstico
fixes.symptoms: O jogo ou uma ferramenta informa que Vulkan não está disponível.
fixes.possibleCauses: Pode haver driver incorreto, GPU sem suporte, ferramenta ausente ou conflito entre bibliotecas de 32 e 64 bits.

solutions.title: Executar diagnóstico resumido
solutions.explanation: A ferramenta vulkaninfo mostra informações da implementação quando está instalada.
solutions.warning: A ausência da ferramenta não confirma ausência de suporte do driver.

solutions.title: Conferir família e documentação
solutions.explanation: Compare GPU, driver, versão da distribuição e arquitetura com a documentação oficial antes de trocar pacotes.
solutions.warning: Não instale drivers de outra distribuição ou de um repositório não identificado.

fixes.title: Jogo falha após atualização de driver NVIDIA
fixes.symptoms: O jogo que funcionava falha, perde Vulkan ou apresenta tela preta após uma atualização.
fixes.possibleCauses: Uma combinação de driver, kernel, runtime, configuração de sessão gráfica ou biblioteca pode não estar alinhada.

solutions.title: Registrar versões do ambiente
solutions.explanation: Colete GPU, versão do driver, kernel, distribuição e versão do jogo antes de alterar o sistema.
solutions.warning: Não faça downgrade sem instrução específica e verificável para a sua distribuição.

solutions.title: Testar sem camadas extras
solutions.explanation: Desative temporariamente overlays e opções personalizadas para separar o problema de configuração do problema de driver.
solutions.warning: Preserve uma forma de reverter cada mudança.

fixes.title: Stuttering persistente durante a primeira execução
fixes.symptoms: Quedas curtas ou travamentos ao entrar em áreas novas, especialmente na primeira execução.
fixes.possibleCauses: Compilação de shaders, cache frio, uso de overlay, limites térmicos ou carregamento de armazenamento podem contribuir.

solutions.title: Reproduzir sem overlays
solutions.explanation: Teste uma sessão sem MangoHud, GameMode ou outros wrappers para verificar se eles influenciam o problema.
solutions.warning: Não trate uma observação isolada como benchmark ou dado de performance.

solutions.title: Registrar condições
solutions.explanation: Anote resolução, preset, versão de Proton, driver e momento do stutter para um report reproduzível.
solutions.warning: A correção depende do jogo e do ambiente; não há uma opção universal segura.

fixes.title: Áudio do jogo usa dispositivo incorreto ou não sai
fixes.symptoms: O jogo inicia sem som, envia áudio para outro dispositivo ou perde áudio após troca de saída.
fixes.possibleCauses: A causa pode envolver perfil de dispositivo, sessão de áudio, sandbox do aplicativo ou configuração específica do jogo.

solutions.title: Confirmar dispositivo padrão
solutions.explanation: Verifique o dispositivo padrão no ambiente gráfico e teste outro aplicativo antes de alterar configurações avançadas.
solutions.warning: Não execute comandos de servidor de áudio de outra distribuição sem documentação compatível.

solutions.title: Isolar launcher e sandbox
solutions.explanation: Compare o comportamento do launcher e da versão Flatpak, quando aplicável, sem assumir que ambos usam as mesmas permissões.
solutions.warning: Relate o tipo de pacote, a distribuição e o dispositivo afetado ao pedir ajuda.
